title: Senior Manager Brand Strategy & Creative Solutions (m/f/d) Barcelona
Senior Art Director (Beauty, Skincare, Wellness & Lifestyle)
Creative Lead (Social & UGC)
description:
**Who we are**
==============

Creative Milkshake is a remote-first performance creative agency. We make scroll-stopping short-form ads for some of the world’s most exciting DTC brands on Meta and TikTok - high-volume, fast-moving, and built to convert.

We’re a close-knit team of ~34 people spread across the Netherlands, the Philippines, South Africa, Spain, and beyond. We’ve recently joined the Fieldtrip group alongside inBeat, which means we’re growing - in ambition, in capability, and in the complexity of clients we work with.

Our Amsterdam studio is the creative heart of our production operation. Over the next 1–2 years, we’re expanding from UGC-first content toward elevated branded formats, this role is central to holding the quality bar as we scale.

**The role**
============

We make a lot of content. Across a portfolio of DTC clients, our studio shoots and edits dozens of UGC ads every week. Most of it is good. Some of it is great. And the difference between good and great is specific: the hook that actually stops the scroll, the edit that holds attention, the subtle thing that makes a piece of content feel native rather than forced. That's what this role is about.

We’re looking for a Creative Lead (Social & UGC) to be the final creative eye before work reaches clients. You'll review raw footage, storyboards, and final edits, and give the kind of specific, hands-on feedback that actually improves the work rather than just flags problems.

You’ve made content yourself. You’ve been on set, you’ve been in the edit, you know what it takes to make a 15-second video that does something to the person watching it. You bring that maker's instinct to a quality and creative leadership role, and you use it to raise the bar across a whole studio.

**Timezone preference**
=======================

For this role, we're only considering candidates based in +/ 3 hrs CET time zone.

**What you’ll do**
==================

**Hold the creative quality bar**
---------------------------------

* Review storyboards, raw footage when necessary, and final edits before they go to clients
* Be the quality gate: if something isn’t ready, you say so clearly, and you explain exactly what needs to change and why
* Build and maintain the ad example library, creative checklists, and “what good looks like” guides that codify your instinct into something the whole team can learn from
* Spot recurring patterns: editing habits that aren't working, storyboard mistakes that keep appearing, hooks that aren't landing. Address them at the root, not ad by ad

**Give hands-on creative direction in post**
--------------------------------------------

* Review raw footage after shoots and provide clear direction on what’s usable, what’s not, and what to do differently next time
* Give precise editing feedback to our video editors: pacing, cut points, text overlays, sound design, the craft layer that turns a decent edit into something that performs
* Understand design fundamentals well enough to give direction on static assets, thumbnail frames, and text treatments: what reads on a phone screen and what doesn't
* Know what a 9:16 UGC ad needs to do in the first 2 seconds, and be able to articulate it in a way an editor can act on immediately

**Support production with a creative eye**
------------------------------------------

* Review storyboards before shoots and flag what isn’t shootable as written, what talent or set requirements are missing, and where the brief and the concept have drifted
* Give production the creative context they need to go into a shoot prepared: what angles matter, what the edit is going to need, what “good” looks like for this format and this brand
* Periodically join shoots at the Amsterdam studio (+-3 times a year) when creative stakes are high or a new format is being tested
* Over time, help build a visual reference library for the studio: what set styles, lighting setups, and shooting approaches produce the most versatile footage

**Drive platform and content intelligence**
-------------------------------------------

* Maintain a genuine, current relationship with TikTok, Meta, and emerging short-form platforms: scrolling with a critical eye, not just awareness
* Curate a regular inspiration feed for the team: specific content examples with notes on why they work, what the craft decisions are, and how we could produce something similar in our studio
* Know the difference between a format worth adopting and a trend worth skipping, and be able to make the case either way
* Bring fresh creative references when the team’s output starts feeling formulaic or dated

**Build the team’s creative instinct**
--------------------------------------

* Give Creative Strategists feedback on CSPs and scripts that builds their creative eye over time, not just fixes the brief in front of them
* Run regular creative review sessions and inspiration shares that create a shared language for what “good” means at Creative Milkshake
* Be the person the team brings work to when they're not sure if it's there yet, and give them an answer they can trust

**Own CM’s creative identity externally**
-----------------------------------------

* Approve CM's own social content and website portfolio: what we put out about ourselves should reflect the standard we hold for clients
* Help define and document CM’s creative POV over time: the format instincts, the aesthetic signatures, the things that make our content recognizably ours

**Who you are**
===============

We’re not filtering on titles. We're looking for a specific type of person: someone with a sharp creative eye for what works on social, who wants to use that experience to raise the quality of an entire studio's output.

* 3–7 years of hands-on experience in video production, editing, content creation, or a creative role at a social-first agency or DTC brand. You've made things, not just briefed them
* A genuine, current feel for short-form social content: you scroll TikTok and Meta with a critical eye, you notice what’s working before it’s obvious, and you can describe the craft decisions behind it in specific terms
* Ability to understand paid media and performance marketing reports to inform creative decisions
* Real editing experience, or close enough collaboration with editors, that you speak the language of the edit
* Enough on-set or production experience to spot when a storyboard isn’t going to translate, and know what to do about it
* The ability to tell a good ad from a great one in seconds, and explain why in a way the person who made it can actually use
* Feedback that is specific, timestamped, and producible, not vague creative notes that leave people guessing
* High EQ: you can give honest creative feedback without damaging the confidence or the relationship of the person on the other end
* Comfortable with ambiguity and pace: we're building systems while operating at volume
* Fluent in English, confident presenting creative rationale to clients when needed

**Backgrounds that tend to produce this person**
================================================

There’s no single path. People who are great at this role often come from one of these places:

* A video editor or post-production lead who has developed a strong creative eye for social, and wants to work upstream on quality rather than just executing edits
* A UGC creator or content creator who has built a real, granular understanding of what performs and why, and wants to bring that instinct to a studio environment at scale
* A creative producer who sits between strategy and production, has strong taste, and wants to formalise that into a quality leadership role
* A social content lead or in-house creative at a DTC brand who has been hands-on with short-form video and wants to take their creative judgement further

**What they all share: they’ve made things, they have taste, and they can teach it.**

**You’ll thrive here if…**
==========================

* You get genuinely excited about the craft of short-form video: the hook, the cut, the text timing, the sound. You find it hard to watch a mediocre ad without knowing what you'd fix
* You want a role where your creative instinct directly improves what goes out the door every week
* You’re energised by the challenge of holding a high standard at volume: lots of content, lots of clients, fast turnarounds
* You want to shape creative culture from the inside: setting a standard, building the resources that make a team better, defining what “good” means at a growing studio
* The idea of helping a UGC studio move toward elevated social-first content over the next couple of years sounds like exactly the right moment to join

**This role isn’t for you if…**
===============================

* You’ve only worked in creative strategy or performance marketing and haven’t been hands-on with video production or editing
* Your creative background is in brand identity or traditional advertising rather than short-form, social-first content
* You prefer to stay in the strategic or conceptual space and find production and editing detail less interesting
* You’re primarily looking for a people-management role. Your influence here comes through creative expertise, not team size

**What we offer**
=================

* Creative Milkshake Stipends (mental health, healthcare & internet)
* Time Off: 21 days PTO + 7 Paid Sick Days; company closure: 2 weeks at year-end (estimated: December 22 – January 5)
* Maternity/Paternity Leave
* Yearly Salary Review
* Long Service Incentives (starting from 2 years)

title: Creative Director, Visual
description:
**Description**
**Some problems are too important for ordinary thinking.**
How do you change behavior at scale? Build trust when trust is hard to earn? Make something complicated feel simple? Get millions of people to see things differently—and do something about it?
  
  
These are the kinds of problems we work on at ICF Next. The stakes are high. The answers aren't obvious. And the work has to do more than look good.
  
  
We're looking for a
**Creative Director**
who loves that kind of challenge. Someone with a restless imagination, exceptional instincts and the ability to turn a difficult brief into an idea that feels inevitable once you've seen it.
  
  
Someone who knows great creative work doesn't happen by accident. It takes curiosity, conviction, craft and people who care enough to keep pushing.
  
  
**About ICF & ICF Next**
ICF is a global consulting and technology services company working on some of the most pressing challenges facing businesses, governments and communities. From energy and climate to public health, infrastructure and government, our teams bring deep expertise to problems that don't have easy answers.
  
  
ICF Next brings creativity into that equation.
  
  
We're writers, designers, strategists, technologists and creative thinkers working together to help organizations connect with people and move them to action.
  
  
We have the creative ambition of an agency and access to the expertise of a global consultancy. That combination gives us an unusual opportunity: to understand difficult problems from the inside, find the human story and create work that makes a difference in the real world.
  
  
There's no shortage of interesting briefs. The challenge is doing something extraordinary with them.
  
  
**The Role**
You'll lead creative across major client engagements, from the first conversation about a problem to the last detail of the finished work.
  
  
You'll find the idea that makes everything click. Set the visual direction. Push the thinking. Bring writers, designers, strategists and producers together around a shared ambition.
  
  
The work spans integrated campaigns, brand experiences, film, digital, social, experiential and whatever else the idea calls for.
  
  
You'll be expected to have a point of view, make decisions, challenge work that isn't good enough and know when to let a better idea win.
  
  
You'll also help shape the creative culture at ICF Next. Not through speeches about excellence, but through the work you make, the standards you set and the people you help develop.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Find the idea. Get beneath the brief, ask better questions and turn complicated challenges into original, compelling creative concepts.
* Set the standard. Bring a sharp eye, strong art direction and a deep respect for design, storytelling and execution. Care about the big idea and every detail that makes it work.
* Make people care. Take subjects that can be technical, sensitive or difficult to explain and make them clear, relevant and human.
* Think beyond the medium. Lead creative across digital, social, film, video, experiential, paid media, out-of-home and emerging platforms. Start with the idea, not the format.
* Make the team better. Inspire, mentor and challenge creatives. Give useful feedback. Recognize talent. Create the conditions for people to do the best work of their careers.
* Stand behind the work. Present ideas with clarity and conviction. Build relationships with clients. Know how to push without making it personal, and how to protect a strong idea while making it stronger.
* Get it made. Work across disciplines, manage competing priorities and navigate the realities of complex projects without losing sight of what made the idea worth pursuing.
* Stay curious. Explore new tools, technologies and ways of working, including AI, without confusing what's new with what's good.

**Who You Are**
You came up through art direction or design, but you've never thought of yourself as just a visual person.
  
  
You think in ideas. You understand the power of an image, the precision of a line of copy and the way everything comes together to tell a story.
  
  
You have taste. You have opinions. You can explain both.
  
  
You know the difference between a clever execution and a genuinely good idea. You can spot what's missing, see what's possible and help a team get there.
  
  
You're comfortable leading a room, but you listen. You know how to sell an idea without overselling it. And you're not afraid to roll up your sleeves when the work needs you.
  
  
You've worked on difficult briefs, with demanding clients and tight deadlines. You've learned that constraints aren't an excuse for mediocre work.
  
  
Most importantly, you still get excited when something great comes together. You haven't lost the instinct to make it better.
  
  
**What You Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of creative experience in an agency, design studio or comparable environment, including senior-level creative leadership.
* A portfolio that shows exceptional conceptual thinking, art direction, design craft and integrated creative work.

Professional Skills
  
  

* Experience leading creative teams and developing campaigns across multiple channels.
* Strong visual storytelling, strategic thinking and presentation skills.
* The ability to take ambitious ideas from concept through production while managing complex projects, stakeholders and deadlines.

**Why ICF Next**
The problems we work on aren't always easy to explain. They don't always come with glamorous briefs or obvious answers.
  
  
That's what makes them interesting.
  
  
You get to work with people who know their subjects inside out, tackle challenges that affect how people live and make decisions, and bring your creative instincts to places where they're genuinely needed.
  
  
There's room here for big ideas. For unexpected thinking. For the kind of work that makes you proud of what you do.
  
  
**If you believe the hardest problems deserve the best creative minds, we'd like to meet you.**
Show us your work. Show us how you think.
  
  
**Bot and Third-Party Applications**
Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance.
  
  
**Working at ICF**
ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.
  
  
We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.

title: Creative Director
description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

**Job Description**
===================

Location:

London, GB

Condé Nast is a global media company, home to iconic brands including Vogue , GQ , Glamour , CN Traveller , Vanity Fair , Wired , The World of Interiors , House & Garden and Tatler , among many others.

We are headquartered in New York and London and operate in 32 markets worldwide, with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers across print, digital, video and social platforms.

Condé Nast thrives on collaboration, and our teams come together in the office four days a week (Monday - Thursday).

We value diversity of background, views and cultures. We celebrate people for their personal qualities, skills and contributions, recognising the power our brands have to influence and shape culture.

Condé Nast is a global media company producing the highest quality content with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers in 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. The company’s portfolio includes many of the world’s most respected and influential media properties including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Glamour, Self, GQ, The New Yorker, Condé Nast Traveler/Traveller, Allure, AD, Bon Appétit and Wired, among others.

Based in our London office, this role helps to set the creative vision and leads the overarching delivery of global and UK branded content, advertiser partnerships, and brand marketing across Condé Nast’s editorial portfolio. As a culturally attuned, conceptual leader, you will drive 360° creative strategy that connects brands to culture at scale. You bring a track record of editorially inspired work, natural mentorship, and the capability to deputise for the Executive Creative Director—aiding in guiding the department vision, setting creative standards, and inspiring the wider team.

Reporting to the Executive Creative Director, you will partner with senior marketing, strategy, and sales leaders to shape major commercial opportunities, pitch transformative partnership ideas, and oversee cross-departmental execution with editorial teams. Success requires visionary storytelling, deep commercial strategy, and a sharp cultural perspective. The Creative Director oversees overall portfolio output, establishing the creative direction and directing senior talent on high-stakes, multi-platform briefs—from global luxury video campaigns to multi-market event sponsorships.

You excel at guiding cross-functional teams through complex, fast-paced workflows, bringing executive-level problem-solving and strategic clarity to every meeting. The ideal candidate ensures creative excellence while safeguarding Condé Nast’s brand authority, creative standards, and journalistic integrity across all commercial initiatives.

Individual & Team Responsibilities

* Develop bold multi-channel creative work that reflects the voice and ethos of all Condé Nast titles for advertisers across categories.
* Assign, collaborate with and direct the work of multi-disciplinary creatives suitable for each project (art directors, designers, etc).
* Apply strategic insights in order to craft inventive content, experiential solutions, and partnership ideas that align with audience data, brand ethos, and client objectives.
* Direct video and photo shoots with a focus on performance and editorial quality.
* Serve as the primary creative client liaison on campaigns—presenting work, managing feedback, and guiding creative integrity across production.
* Drive brainstorms and work hands-on when crafting proposals and presentations.
* Propose creative solutions that fit within the provided budgets.
* Ensure all commercial ideas authentically balance the voices and perspectives of our editorial brands with those of our advertising partners.
* Help build a thriving creative department; nurture talent, establish workflow efficiencies, and champion inclusive, forward-thinking creative culture.
* Deputise for the Executive Creative Director across key business forums, internal leadership meetings, and executive client pitches.

Essential Skills & Requirements

* 10+ years of experience as a creative lead in premium media or agency environments.
* A demonstrated appreciation for the subject matter and creativity of the brands you’ll represent at Condé Nast.
* Confidence working with and directing artists, experts, celebrities and creators as talent on commercial projects.
* Strong portfolio showcasing work across print, digital, video and events.
* Passion for brand marketing, with a sharp cultural perspective that informs consumer-facing campaigns.
* Skilled storyteller with excellent written, visual, and verbal presentation abilities.
* Extensive on-set experience and deep knowledge of video and photography production, from pre- to post-production (for digital and print).
* Demonstrated success managing creative teams and working within established systems to improve output and efficiency.
* A creative aesthetic emphasizing current standards in entertainment, fashion, luxury and design.
* Highly organized, adaptable and adept at prioritizing workloads in fast-paced environments.
* Ability to work fluently with collaborators in production - writers, DPs, photographers, editors, animators, and designers.
* Proficiency in Google Slides and treatment deck creation. Bonus: familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and editing software.

Desired Qualities:

* Culturally informed - Current on music and entertainment, luxury and fashion, as well as knowledgeable about Condé Nast brands and culture. Additionally, have awareness of relevant artists, and creative vendors.
* Highly imaginative - You’re a conceptual creative with innovative ideas that challenge outdated approaches to content and the definition of “experiential.”
* Detail-oriented - Equally obsessed with creating memorable work and impactful campaigns that solve our client’s challenges.
* Agile and adaptable - Open to taking input from others and willing to take on essential tasks needed to get the job done.
* Think critically - You strive to come up with ideas that solve brand challenges, can manage multiple projects at once, and know when to pivot if something isn’t working.
* Have an ego-less attitude - You give credit where credit is due, bring a positive attitude to work and support your teammates in gaining visibility and opportunities.
* A natural mentor - You prioritize diversity, inclusivity, and representation in every stage of the creative process and empathy in team collaboration.

What benefits do we offer?

* 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) and extra days of annual leave if you move house or want to volunteer.

* You’ll have access to a competitive pension scheme , Bupa Private Healthcare , Season ticket loans and eye tests.

* We offer a range of tools to support your wellbeing, including core hours , 10 remote days (from home or a country with a Condé Nast office location), access to our Employee Assistance Programme , corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.
* We’re a dog-friendly office , plus you’ll enjoy discounts and magazine subscriptions , keeping you up to date with all things Condé Nast.

* We encourage personal and professional growth through the Condé Nast Learning Hub, where you’ll find an extensive portfolio of learning courses and training available in local languages.
* Our Employee Resource Groups provide a platform for employees to identify shared objectives, exchange ideas, and work on community priorities for our global workforce.

**What happens next?**
======================

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.

***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

title: Head of Creative
description:
**Intro**

Founded by sisters Louisa and Rebecca, Regalrose is a British-born ecommerce jewellery retailer with over 15 years in business. Specialising in uniquely designed jewellery and accessories with a fierce edge and dreamy-dark twist, Regalrose is going from strength to strength as demonstrated by our exceptional growth over the last few years. We have built up a loyal community of passionate fans and customers, delivering our products to over 80 countries worldwide. We are now looking for an outstanding and experienced Head of Creative to join our team in our offices, located in St Albans.

**About You**

You will be a driven, self-motivated creative leader with an exceptional eye for brand and at least 10 years’ creative experience, or experience running a creative function as a Head of, Director or Senior Manager – ideally in fashion, jewellery or accessories. You will hold very high standards, make fast, confident creative calls under pressure, balance creativity with commercial awareness, and stay hands-on with asset creation while leading a team.

**Requirements and Skills**

As Head of Creative, you will be the guardian of the Regalrose brand – owning how it looks, sounds and feels across every channel, campaign and the website. Working from the founders’ vision, you will turn each collection into concepts, briefs, photography, copy and assets, lead the in-house creative team and have final creative approval on all outward-facing marketing. You will work as a peer to the Head of Marketing, who owns the commercial and go-to-market plan.

**The Role and Accountabilities**

Overall goal: Protect and grow the Regalrose brand by ensuring every piece of marketing and website output is on brand, to the highest standard and right first time.

Brand guardian:

* Final creative decision-maker, with a brand veto on any marketing output.
* Own the brand guidelines, copy and content rules, tone of voice, and social narrative and seasonal themes.
* Keep the brand culturally relevant, filtering trends and performance insight through the brand lens.

Collection & campaign launches:

* Turn the founders’ campaign vision into concepts, themes and the creative brief for every launch.
* Develop the founders’ photoshoot concepts and lead photoshoot direction.
* Own copywriting, artboard production and delivery of all assets; approve all copy, emails and assets before launch.

Channel & website creative:

* Assets, copy and tone of voice for paid media, social, CRM, blog, PR and the website (product descriptions, e-commerce imagery, banners).

Partnerships:

* Set the creator criteria across the four influencer pillars, sign off creator content and make the final call on Muse creators.
* Own the content of paid and brand collaborations; identify licence and influencer collaboration candidates.

Leadership & budget:

* Line manage the in-house creative team (currently Graphic Designer and Content Creator) and external creative suppliers.
* Own the creative production budget and decide whether new or ad-hoc go-to-market elements can be resourced.
* Present creative strategy to the founders at agreed steer points; collaborate with the Head of Marketing and other department leads.

This is not an exhaustive list of tasks.

Qualifications Required

* 10+ years’ creative experience, or experience running a creative function (Head of, Director or Senior Manager)
* Ideally from a fast-paced retail, fashion or jewellery/accessories brand; ideally degree qualified in a creative discipline
* Brand management across digital, social, CRM, web, print and packaging
* Art direction of shoots and video; strong copywriting and editing
* Hands-on with Adobe Suite (specifically Illustrator), CapCut and Klaviyo
* Creative team leadership and budget ownership

Due to the nature of our business, our peak time stretches from November to January. As a small yet growing business, annual leave must be kept to a minimum during those months.

**Regalrose Values**

At Regalrose, we don’t follow trends, we create them – putting our customers at the heart of everything we do. Together we turn ideas into reality, always pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. If you're ready to make an impact and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want you with us.

**Team Structure**

Line Manager: Managing Director

Direct Reports: In-house creative team (currently Graphic Designer and Content Creator)

Works closely with: Founders, Head of Marketing, Social Media Executive, Buying & Merchandising, Quality Control and Customer Experience.

There's nothing like a career at Entain. We're a leading, global sports betting and gaming company and we're upping the excitement and increasing player safety. We're a FTSE company with iconic brands including Ladbrokes, Coral, BetMGM, Eurobet and bwin, and we have an energy that drives us to perform at the height of our potential. Whether you're an engineer, marketer or retail specialist, a career here is a complete game changer.

**Job Description**
-------------------

As we continue to expand our in-house creative capability, Entain Creative is growing to support a broader range of brands, campaigns and activation-led ideas. We're looking for an Associate Creative Director to play a key role in shaping that output, creating culturally relevant, socially fluent and channel-agnostic ideas that connect with audiences across the full customer journey.

Working closely with our Creative Directors, the Associate Creative Director will take a senior creative role across major briefs, from initial concept and creative development through to execution. You'll turn strategic and audience insight into bold creative ideas that can live across social, digital, film, experiential, activations and wider brand communications.

This is a hands-on creative leadership role. You'll originate ideas, shape the creative narrative, provide copy and art direction, and raise the standard of the work around you. You'll present and sell ideas to senior stakeholders, while collaborating with strategy, social, design and production to bring those ideas to life. You'll also help develop other creatives and contribute to a culture where bold thinking, collaboration and high creative standards are part of the everyday.

* Lead integrated creative briefs from strategic thinking and concept development through to execution across social, digital, film, print, experiential and activations.
* Develop original ideas rooted in audience and cultural insight, translating brand platforms into distinctive campaigns, experiences and content.
* Provide strong copy and art direction, protecting the central creative idea as work moves from concept into production.
* Lead social and digital shoots, including scripting and creative direction across production teams, crew and talent.
* Present and sell creative thinking to senior stakeholders, while providing clear direction and constructive feedback to other creatives.

**What this opportunity offers**

As an **Associate Creative Director**, you'll:

* Shape highly visible creative work across a portfolio of globally recognised betting and gaming brands.
* Work across an unusually broad mix of channels, from film and social to experiential activations and real-world brand moments.
* Influence projects at an early stage rather than simply executing predetermined creative solutions.
* Help shape the creative standards and culture of an expanding in-house agency.

The role requires:

* Senior creative experience as an Associate Creative Director, Senior Creative or equivalent within an integrated, digital or creative agency environment.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating original conceptual thinking and successful 360° campaigns across multiple channels.

* Hands-on production experience, including taking concepts into shoots and working confidently with production teams, crew and talent.

title: Head of Brand & Sponsorship
description:
Capital.com is scaling fast, and this role makes sure that ambition shows up everywhere the brand does. Reporting to the Brand Director, you’ll own delivery end to end, turning brand strategy into standout campaigns and building a sponsorship and events function that makes every partnership work harder. It’s a hands-on role for someone as comfortable running a campaign timeline as negotiating a sponsorship deal or managing an event on-site. Working with the CMO, Head of Creative, PR and regional teams, you’ll have real influence over how Capital.com shows up globally as it pursues premiumisation and expansion.

### **Responsibilities:**

**Brand Campaigns**

* Own end-to-end delivery of Capital.com's big-ticket brand campaigns, turning the Brand Director's strategy into standout, well-executed work across markets
* Partner closely with the Head of Creative, who leads creative production, to ensure every campaign is built and delivered to a premium standard
* Work with market analysts and the PR team to align campaign timing, messaging and measurement
* Manage campaign budgets, timelines and sign-off across multiple markets and stakeholders
* Lead delivery across campaigns of every scale, from moments built around a global brand asset to local activity such as a UK spread betting campaign or a new performance-led campaign for the paid social team
* Feed into the strategic thinking behind paid social alongside the paid social team, for example how a new channel is seeded with initial paid support, or how an organic boosting strategy is agreed and backed with paid
* Bring imagination to how the brand shows up, finding new ways to express Capital.com's premiumisation and expansion ambitions through brand activity

**Sponsorship & Events**

* Own the sponsorship and events function end to end: evaluating and negotiating new opportunities, then delivering the activations that bring them to life
* Draw on activation support at global level from the events team and at local level from regional marketing leads and local offices, so delivery is never carried alone
* Evaluate opportunities across sport, conferences and other partnerships against clear criteria for brand fit, audience relevance and commercial value
* Lead negotiation and management of sponsorship contracts, protecting Capital.com's interests and tracking every commitment on both sides
* Build and maintain relationships with rights holders, sports marketing agencies and event partners as the primary point of contact
* Plan and deliver event activations and client hospitality end to end — suppliers, guest lists, merchandise, booths — working with the design team so every physical presence reflects the brand
* Collaborate with the CMO, regional marketing managers and regional CEOs to align sponsorship priorities across markets and activate global properties locally
* Work with Compliance and Legal to ensure all sponsorship and event activity meets regulatory requirements across Capital.com's jurisdictions
* Track and report on sponsorship performance and ROI, and build out the sponsorship and events team as the function grows

### **Requirements:**

* **Senior experience delivering brand campaigns end to end.**
* **Experience within a financial services or fintech business.**
* **Proven experience delivering sponsorship activation end to end, from deal negotiation through to on-site activation.**
* Breadth beyond sport (e.g. culture, academia, thought leadership) and integrated activation skills across social, content and brand campaigns, not just hospitality.
* Experience activating global properties across multiple markets.
* Strong commercial focus: you can articulate the value a sponsorship brings to the business and use it as a vehicle to drive acquisition.
* Experience in our industry or regulated financial services.
* Confidence negotiating commercial contracts and evaluating opportunities critically rather than just enthusiastically.
* Excellent relationship management across rights holders, creative partners and senior stakeholders in a multi-market structure.
* Comfortable building a function from a small base, with willingness to travel roughly 20% of the time.

### **Nice to have:**

* Existing relationships with sports rights holders, conference organisers or sports marketing agencies
* Agency-side background in sponsorship, experiential or brand campaign delivery
* Experience managing brand or sponsorship activity across multiple international markets simultaneously

### **What you will get in return:**

* Competitive Salary: We believe great work deserves great pay! Your skills and talents will be rewarded with a salary that makes you feel valued and motivated.
* Work-Life Harmony: Join a company that genuinely cares about *you*—because your life outside of work matters just as much as your time on the clock.
* Annual Performance Bonus: Your hard work doesn’t go unnoticed! Celebrate your achievements with a well-deserved annual bonus tied to your performance.
* Generous Time Off: Need a breather? Our annual leave policy lets you recharge and enjoy life outside of work without a worry.
* Employee Referral Program: Love working here? Share the love! Bring your talented friends on board and get rewarded for growing our awesome team.
* Comprehensive Health & Pension Benefits: From medical insurance to pension plans, we’ve got your back. Plus, location-specific benefits and perks!
* Workation Wonderland: Live your digital nomad dreams with 30 extra days to work remotely from anywhere in the world (some restrictions apply). Adventure awaits!
* Volunteer Days: Make a difference! Take two additional paid days each year to support causes you care about and give back to the community

**This role sits at the intersection of politics, policy and marketing.**

We're looking for an exceptional marketing leader who has significant experience operating in a political environment and understands how to navigate complex policy issues, stakeholder relationships and media scrutiny.

As Mayoral Head of Marketing and GLA Brand Strategy, you'll lead the campaigns that help shape London's future, working directly with the Mayoral appointees and senior leaders across City Hall to engage millions of Londoners on some of the capital's biggest priorities.

One day you could be developing a campaign to support the transformation of Oxford Street. The next, helping Londoners access new youth services, tackling homelessness, improving air quality, promoting major city events, or encouraging public participation in policies that affect communities across the capital.

You'll oversee a talented team with a reputation for delivering award-winning, nationally recognised campaigns. Your client is London itself: its residents, communities, businesses and visitors. The work is high-profile, fast-paced and frequently in the national spotlight, offering a unique opportunity to combine creativity, policy, politics and public service.

This role is perfect for someone who is passionate about London, with deep expertise and experience in how politics and policy-making works, and is excited by the challenge of turning complex issues into campaigns that inform, engage and inspire action. We are looking for a strategic leader who can navigate a complex political environment while championing bold, innovative and effective marketing that reaches London's diverse audiences.

If you want to lead campaigns that genuinely make a difference to the lives of Londoners and help shape one of the world's greatest cities, we'd love to hear from you.

  

**The Mayor’s Office**

The Mayor's Office is responsible for supporting the Mayor of London, Sadiq Khan.

Supporting the Mayor, Deputy Mayors and lead advisors such as the Chief Digital Officer, the Mayor’s Office is organised into four small units:

* Communications
* Mayoral Operations
* Policy and Delivery
* Political and Public Affairs.

**About the role**

To direct and have overall responsibility for marketing strategy and delivery, providing high-level strategic marketing, brand and communications advice to the Mayor of London and Mayoral appointees including Deputy Mayors and Mayoral Directors

**The postholder will:**

* Lead and be accountable for the delivery of marketing and integrated communications, developing the strategy to support the priorities and objectives of the Mayor and the GLA, in collaboration with senior colleagues at the GLA and functional bodies.
* Direct the GLA marketing campaigns and strategic communications teams, and work across the GLA Group to develop the brand strategy and achieve effective marketing on behalf of the Mayor.

**What your day will look like:**

* Provide high level strategic advice to the Mayor, mayoral appointees and senior GLA officers on all matters that may have a bearing on the marketing and brand policy and practice of the Mayor, the GLA and mayoral projects.
* Working closely with the Mayoral Director, Communications, direct and be accountable for the strategic development, creative development and implementation of the marketing strategy, advertising strategy and brand strategy across the GLA, ensuring all work delivers on Mayoral priorities and objectives, and ladders up to central strategic messages
* Direct and devise marketing campaigns to support the Mayor’s policy agenda, working closely with the Mayoral Director, Communications, the Mayor’s Office, senior GLA officers including colleagues from Government Relations, External Relations, the Mayor’s Office and, as required, the functional bodies and London stakeholders.
* Lead on specific high-priority integrated campaigns and communications, working with the Chief Digital and Creative Strategist, the Senior Adviser to the Mayor, News Media and the Head of Strategic Communications.
* Direct marketing and brand evaluation and insights work across the GLA to ensure the GLA pursues the most effective communication strategies and plans, and has a framework to measure overarching success
* Commission and sign-off Mayoral communications and creative across the GLA to ensure impact, message consistency and alignment with Mayoral priorities.

**Skills, knowledge and experience**

To be considered for the role you must meet the following essential criteria:

* In-depth knowledge and experience of working at a senior strategic and political level directing marketing, creative and brand strategy in a large, high-profile organisation regularly in the media eye.
* Deep experience working in political, governmental or highly politically sensitive environments with excellent political judgement and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving, high-profile environment.
* A track record of developing and leading outstanding marketing campaigns, with significant experience of delivering high-impact integrated media campaigns and advertising across different mediums, including news media, soft media, paid advertising channels, and social media.
* Strong understanding of how policy is developed, communicated and delivered, and evidence of success in promoting policy through a variety of marketing and communications channels, including on complex issues for a range of different audiences.
* The creativity to turn complex policy issues into compelling public engagement campaigns, with significant experience of developing marketing campaigns and overarching brand and communications strategies in a high-profile organisation.
* Evidence you can advise senior political leaders and influence decisions at the highest level.
* Substantial practical experience of working with partner organisations to create and deliver high-profile effective marketing campaigns that deliver to an overarching strategy.

##### **Job Description**

* Direct and devise marketing campaigns to support the Mayor’s policy agenda, working closely with the Mayoral Director, Communications, the Mayor’s Office, senior GLA officers including colleagues from Government Relations, External Relations, the Mayor’s Office and, as required, the functional bodies and London stakeholders.

* Direct marketing and brand evaluation and insights work across the GLA to ensure the GLA pursues the most effective communication strategies and plans, and has a framework to measure overarching success.

* Commission and sign-off Mayoral communications and creative across the GLA to ensure impact, message consistency and alignment with Mayoral priorities.

* Working closely with the Mayoral Director, Communications, advise on the Strategy & Communications Directorate’s organisational change, shaping the External Relations function to reflect the evolving communications environment and adapt to the changing needs of Londoners.

* Liaise with senior government officials and with London partners and stakeholders regarding marketing campaigns.

* Deputise for the Mayoral Director, Communications, where appropriate.

* Manage staff and resources allocated to the job in accordance with the Authority’s policies and Code of Ethic and Standards.

* Realise the benefits of London’s diversity by promoting and enabling equality of opportunities and promoting the diverse needs and aspirations of London’s communities.

* Realise the benefits of a flexible approach to work in undertaking the duties and responsibilities of this job, and participating in multi-disciplinary, cross-department and cross-organisational groups and project teams.

* **Key relationships**

Accountable to:

Mayoral Director, Communications

  

Accountable for:

Staff and resources allocated to the job

  

Principal contacts:

The Mayor; Mayoral Advisors; officers in the Mayor’s Office, GLA External Relations teams; senior GLA policy officers; functional bodies’ senior marketing officers; partner agencies.

* **Person specification**

**Technical requirements**

* In-depth knowledge and experience of working at a senior strategic and political level directing marketing, creative and brand strategy in a large, high-profile organisation regularly in the media eye.

* Significant experience of developing marketing campaigns and overarching brand and communications strategies in a high-profile organisation.

* Substantial practical experience of working with partner organisations to create and deliver high-profile effective marketing campaigns that deliver to an overarching strategy.

* Significant experience of delivering high-impact integrated media campaigns and advertising across different mediums, including news media, soft media, paid advertising channels, and social media.

* Evidence of success in promoting policy through a variety of marketing and communications channels, including on complex issues for a range of different audiences, across a range of budgets.

A deep understanding of complex political environments and significant experience at a high level of operating effectively within them.  



* Ability to demonstrate a high level of analytical and constructive thinking to cope with the varied and challenging situations required by the role.

* An understanding of how the GLA’s wish to take a strategic lead in combating discrimination and promoting equality of opportunity throughout London can be enhanced and supported by this role.

**Behavioural Competencies**

  

**Building and Managing Relationships**

…is developing rapport and working effectively with a diverse range of people, sharing knowledge and skills to deliver shared goals;

  

Level 4 indicators of effective performance

  

* Identifies and engages a diverse range of influential contacts within stakeholder and community groups, and partner organisations
* Builds alliances to establish mutually beneficial working arrangements, openly sharing knowledge and insights
* Actively challenges and addresses ‘silo attitudes’ to encourage effective relationship building inside and outside the GLA
* Understands the complexities of political dynamics and uses this to manage relationships and resolve conflict effectively
* Identifies clear win-win situations with external partners

**Communicating and Influencing**

…..is presenting the information and arguments clearly and convincingly so that others see us as credible and articulate and engage with us;

  

Level 4 indicators of effective performance

* Articulates self with credibility and conviction, encouraging buy-in to corporate position
* Influences the thinking of other organisations, encouraging them to deliver in line with the GLA
* Ensures that the organisation communicates inclusively with staff and external stakeholders
* Acts as a credible and convincing spokesperson and negotiator for the GLA
* Instils a corporate commitment to accessible communication

**Problem Solving**

… is analysing and interpreting situations from a variety of viewpoints and finding creative, workable and timely solutions.

  

Level 4 indicators of effective performance

  

* Seeks multiple perspectives to understand the breadth and depth of complex issues
* Produces strategies to solve organisation-wide problems, considering the practical and political concerns associated with the implementation of solutions
* Enables the GLA to continuously improve and innovate in the long term
* Solves problems jointly with others to stimulate innovation
* Turns ambiguous or difficult situations into opportunities

**Strategic Thinking**

…is using an understanding of the bigger picture to uncover potential challenges and opportunities for the long term and turning these into a compelling vision for action

Level 4 indicators of effective performance

* Develops a positive and compelling vision of London’s future potential, demonstrating confidence in the strategic direction of the GLA
* Translates an understanding of the compel and diverse threats and issues facing London into positive action
* Proactively involves partners in strategic thinking, incorporating their views into plans and working with them to align strategic priorities
* Sets organisational priorities by identifying where time and investment is needed most
* Generates and leads strategic initiatives that reflect the GLA’s position as a regional authority

**Decision Making**

…is forming sound, evidence-based judgements, making choices, assessing risks to delivery and taking accountability for results

  

Level 4 indicators of effective performance

  

* Makes difficult decisions for the long-term benefit of the organisation
* Presents and instils confidence in strategic decision-making
* Consults stakeholders early in critical organisation-wide decisions
* Stands by the decisions and actions of the GLA
* Accepts and promotes accountability for the GLA’s decision making
* Ensures the organisation balances effective risk management with the need for timely actions

**Planning and Organising**

… is thinking ahead, managing time, priorities and risk, and developing structured and efficient approaches to deliver work on time and to a high standard.

Level 4 indicators of effective performance

* Takes accountability for monitoring delivery of the GLA’s commitments
* Uses quality assurance processes across the organisation as a feedback mechanism to improve performance
* Takes responsibility for ensuring tools and techniques are available for the effective management of programmes
* Realigns GLA objectives to respond to changing external and internal agendas
* Uses feedback from all sectors as a performance measure for GLA work

**Organisational Awareness**

…is understanding and being sensitive to organisational dynamics, culture and politics across and beyond the GLA and shaping our approach accordingly

  

Level 4 indicators of effective performance

* Focuses on the needs of Londoners, promoting organisational awareness of how they impact GLA priorities
* Anticipates and responds appropriately and professionally to political pressure, inspiring confidence and trust from politicians
* Shapes senior stakeholders’ perceptions of the GLA, using their influence to support the GLA agenda

title: Creative Strategist, Mexico
description:
**Job Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
  
  
Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
  
  
**Where And How You Can Work**
Alongside our global campuses, we also collaborate with talented contractors and freelancers from all over the world to help us achieve our crazy big goals. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role we’re focusing on Mexico City so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.
  
  
This role is a 12 month engagement, working full time hours per week.
  
  
**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
As Creative Strategist for Mexico, you’ll be the creative performance engine behind Canva’s paid marketing in the region.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of Creative, Growth, and Data - combining cultural insight, analytical depth, and creative instinct to continuously improve our performance marketing output. You won’t be running bids day-to-day - you’ll be driving the creative strategy that makes those campaigns win.
  
  
If you love decoding what makes a hook scroll-stopping, turning insights into structured testing, and raising the creative bar sprint after sprint, this role is for you.
  
  
**At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On**

* Leading the full creative cycle - research, briefing, production, and performance review — running weekly sprint cycles that balance quick-win iterations with bigger creative swings, and feeding learnings back to the broader team after every sprint
* Digging into performance dashboards to spot winning patterns, diagnose underperformance, and translate insights into clear, actionable creative direction that drives the next round of concepts
* Directing and collaborating with video editors, designers, writers, and local creators to produce high-quality work across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging channels - briefing and reviewing content to keep it on-brand, culturally relevant, and platform-optimised
* Bringing deep cultural fluency to every brief - identifying Mexican audience behaviours, regional trends, and platform dynamics that shape compelling, locally resonant storytelling
* Working closely with media buyers, data science, and the LatAm Growth Marketing Lead to make sure creative insights translate into measurable business outcomes
* Driving CRO initiatives that improve acquisition journeys and lift conversion efficiency across key touchpoints
* Using AI tools to accelerate ideation, research, asset generation, and analysis - and staying across emerging formats and creative tech that give the team an edge

**You’re Probably a Match If**

* You have solid experience in growth or performance marketing with a strong focus on creative strategy - and you've worked hands-on across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube
* You can lead structured creative testing and sprint frameworks, analyse what's working, and turn those learnings into clear briefs for the next cycle
* You have strong creative instinct - you know what makes a hook scroll-stopping, a format compelling, and a concept scalable across channels
* You're fluent in Spanish and English, with a sharp eye for tone, nuance, and cultural resonance for Mexican audiences
* You have experience briefing, directing, and iterating with creative talent — video editors, designers, writers, and creators - coaching them to produce performance-driven work
* You're confident using dashboards and analytics tools to inform decisions and optimise creative at scale
* You use AI tools to accelerate your workflow and improve output quality

**Meet the team**
We're Canva's LatAm Marketing group, and our mission is to make Canva the most loved brand in the region. We build culturally resonant, high-impact marketing across Latin America - combining bold creative storytelling with sharp performance thinking to drive visibility and growth, market by market. Mexico is a key focus for us right now, and this role sits right at the heart of that ambition.
  
  
**How We Hire**
We make decisions to engage contractors based on your experience, skills and passion.
  
  
When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
  
  
We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above - we still want to hear from you!
  
  
Please note that all interviews are conducted virtually.

title: Art Director — Editorial Photography & Motion
description:
Maison Sportiefs | Sportiefs Matcha

About Us

Sportiefs Matcha is a premium matcha collection under Maison Sportiefs, a lifestyle and wellness brand bringing together sport, culture, and everyday rituals.

We believe in creating experiences that extend beyond the product itself. Our creative approach emphasizes thoughtful design, refined aesthetics, and compelling visual storytelling.

As we continue developing our visual identity, we’re looking for an Art Director who can bring original concepts to life through photography, motion, and experimental visual production.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly creative, detail-oriented Art Director with expertise in editorial product photography, stop-motion animation, and mixed-media content production.

This is a hands-on creative position for someone who can take an idea from initial concept through production and final delivery.

The ideal candidate combines a strong artistic perspective with technical production skills and an understanding of premium consumer brands.

You’ll help shape the visual direction of Sportiefs Matcha across digital campaigns, product launches, e-commerce, and social media.

We are particularly interested in creatives who enjoy experimenting with composition, lighting, movement, textures, and unconventional storytelling techniques.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Direction & Concept Development

* Develop original creative concepts for product campaigns, seasonal launches, and digital storytelling.
* Translate brand references, mood boards, and creative briefs into distinctive visual concepts.
* Establish cohesive visual direction across photography, video, and motion projects.
* Explore innovative approaches to product presentation, animation, and visual storytelling.

Editorial Photography & Studio Production

* Conceptualize, style, and execute editorial product photography.
* Produce high-quality still-life imagery for website, e-commerce, advertising, and social platforms.
* Direct studio lighting, composition, backgrounds, props, and set styling.
* Capture product details, textures, and packaging with precision.
* Create visually compelling imagery while maintaining accurate product representation.

Motion & Mixed-Media Production

* Develop and produce stop-motion sequences, mixed-media animations, and short-form brand films.
* Combine photography, video, animation, and experimental techniques to create engaging visual content.
* Direct product movement, transitions, and visual effects.
* Edit and refine content for digital campaigns, website features, and social media.
* Experiment with creative production techniques that elevate traditional product advertising.

Post-Production & Creative Execution

* Oversee photo retouching, color correction, video editing, and animation.
* Maintain consistency in visual quality across all deliverables.
* Prepare final assets in appropriate formats for websites, digital advertising, and social media.
* Manage production timelines, creative assets, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with additional photographers, stylists, editors, or other creatives when required.

Qualifications & Experience

* A strong portfolio demonstrating editorial product photography, art direction, and visual storytelling.
* Experience producing stop-motion, mixed-media animation, or experimental motion content.
* Strong understanding of studio lighting, composition, color, texture, and product styling.
* Proficiency with professional photography and video equipment.
* Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, including Photoshop, Lightroom, Premiere Pro, and/or After Effects, or equivalent professional software.
* Ability to independently conceptualize, shoot, edit, and deliver creative projects.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple creative deliverables.
* Excellent attention to detail and a refined visual aesthetic.
* Experience creating campaigns for beverage, beauty, fashion, wellness, or lifestyle brands is highly desirable.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re interested in someone who:

* Has a distinctive creative perspective and a strong visual portfolio.
* Understands how to make everyday products feel visually compelling.
* Can balance artistic experimentation with commercial brand objectives.
* Enjoys working with lighting, textures, movement, and unexpected compositions.
* Takes ownership of projects from concept through execution.
* Brings fresh ideas rather than relying exclusively on existing creative trends.
* Understands the importance of maintaining a cohesive brand identity.

Creative Focus

Projects may include:

* Editorial product photography and studio campaigns
* Stop-motion product animations
* Mixed-media brand films
* E-commerce product imagery
* Product launch campaigns
* Short-form motion content
* Creative set design and product styling
* Website visuals and digital advertising assets

How to Apply

Please submit the following to info@sportiefs.com:

* Your portfolio or website showcasing relevant creative work.
* Examples of editorial product photography, stop-motion, or mixed-media projects.
* A brief introduction describing your creative background and areas of expertise.
* Your location, availability, and preferred working arrangement.

Email subject: Art Director Application — Your Name

We are especially interested in portfolios that demonstrate originality, technical execution, and a thoughtful approach to visual storytelling.

We look forward to discovering creatives who can help bring the Sportiefs Matcha visual world to life.

Pay: From $1,000.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

title: CREATIVE DIRECTOR
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

This role leads the Jack Design Studio, overseeing internal creative talent and external partners to deliver distinctive, high-quality brand experiences across every customer touchpoint. As the steward of Jack in the Boxs visual identity and creative standards, this leader shapes and evolves the brands design language while translating creative vision into compelling, culturally relevant work across campaigns, digital channels, packaging, merchandising, and restaurant environments.

**KEY DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Creative Leadership & Brand Identity**

Owns and stewards the visual identity of Jack in the Box across all consumer-facing touchpoints, ensuring the brand is distinctive, recognizable and consistently executed which includes typography, color, graphic language, photography, illustration, iconography, motion and other core design elements.

Establishes the creative vision and design principles for the Jack Design Studio and sets a high bar for creative excellence, craft and originality.

Develops and maintains brand identity guidelines, creative toolkits, templates and design systems that enable consistent execution across internal teams, agencies, franchisees and external partners.

Protects brand consistency without allowing the brand to become formulaic, ensuring creative continues to feel fresh, culturally current and surprising.

**Jack Design Studio Leadership**

Creates a highly collaborative internal creative culture built around strong ideas, exceptional craft, speed and constructive creative feedback.

Establishes effective creative workflows, intake processes, prioritization and review standards in partnership with Marketing Operations.

Balances high-volume production needs with higher-order brand and creative development, ensuring the Studio operates as a creative engine rather than simply a production service.

**Restaurant Merchandising, Menu Boards & Point of Purchase**

Leads creative development and production of restaurant merchandising and point-of-purchase materials, ensuring every in-restaurant execution delivers against the brand identity and commercial objectives.

Oversees design and production of menu boards, promotional menu panels, window clings, counter materials, signage and other restaurant merchandising.

Partners with Menu & Product Marketing, Operations and Marketing Operations to translate marketing programs, menu innovation and value initiatives into compelling restaurant communication.

Develops scalable creative systems capable of supporting national programs, market-level differences, tests and rapid promotional changes.

**Digital & Customer Experience Design**

Oversees brand design across digital touchpoints, including web, app, CRM, paid digital media, social content and other digital customer experiences.

Partners with Digital & Growth Marketing to ensure the brand identity translates effectively into performance-oriented and transactional environments.

Establishes flexible digital design systems that enable high-volume content creation, versioning, localization and rapid optimization.

Ensures performance creative remains unmistakably Jack while meeting the functional requirements of digital channels.

**Integrated Campaign Creative & Agency Production**

Partners closely with Brand Marketing and external creative agencies in the development and production of integrated campaigns.

Represents the internal creative point of view throughout campaign concepting, design, production and adaptation.

Collaborates with agency partners on photography, content production, video, digital, social, experiential and other campaign assets.

Helps determine which creative work should be developed internally versus externally based on capabilities, complexity, speed and business need.

Ensures agency-developed campaigns translate seamlessly into the broader Jack visual ecosystem across restaurant, digital, CRM, merchandising and owned channels.

**Copy, Voice & Brand Expression**

Oversees internal copywriting resources and partners with Brand Marketing and external agencies to ensure copy reflects Jacks distinctive brand personality.

Helps translate brand positioning and creative strategy into recognizable verbal and visual expression.

Ensures headlines, merchandising copy, menu communication and tactical messaging are clear, compelling and consistent with the brand.

Partners with Public Relations, Social and Brand Marketing to maintain cohesion across visual and verbal brand expression.

**Marketing Calendar & Speed-to-Market**

Partners with Brand Marketing and Marketing Operations to anticipate creative requirements across the annual marketing calendar.

Develops modular creative assets and toolkits that enable faster local and franchisee execution while protecting brand consistency.

Identifies process improvements that reduce unnecessary rounds, handoffs and production complexity.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

Partners closely with Brand Marketing, Product Marketing, Digital & Growth, Public Relations, Social, Culinary/Product Development, Consumer Insights, Operations and Marketing Operations.

Serves as the organizations internal authority on visual brand expression and design quality.

Translates strategic and commercial objectives into compelling creative solutions rather than treating creative execution as an isolated downstream activity.

**Budget & Production Management**

Partners with Marketing leadership and Marketing Operations to manage Studio resources and external production investments effectively.

Oversees vendor selection and management for printing, photography, design, production and specialized creative capabilities.

Maintains appropriate quality-control standards across high-volume print and digital production.

Performs other related duties, tasks and responsibilities as required, assigned and directed.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Education** - Bachelors degree in Graphic Design, Advertising, Communications, Marketing, Fine Arts or a related field preferred.

**Experience** - Significant creative leadership experience within a consumer brand, restaurant, retail, entertainment, agency or similarly fast-paced marketing environment. Experience developing or evolving visual identity systems for a recognizable consumer brand. Restaurant, retail or other multi-location consumer experience required, particularly experience with menu boards, merchandising, signage and point-of-purchase communication.

**Leadership Competencies**

Fosters a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and learning.

Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity and drive organizational alignment.

Champions cross-functional collaboration and teamwork.

Develops talent and creates an environment of inclusion, engagement, and growth.

Builds trust through transparency, consistency, and strong decision-making and high standards of integrity and accountability.

Strong collaborator who can influence senior stakeholders while maintaining a clear creative point of view.

**Skills/Knowledge/Abilities**

Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams across brand design, graphic design, copy and production.

Strong portfolio demonstrating outstanding brand identity, integrated campaign, digital and physical or retail design work.

Exceptional creative judgment and a highly developed eye for design, typography, photography, visual storytelling and craft.

Ability to build brands as systems, creating clear design principles that can flex across hundreds of executions without losing distinctiveness.

Strong understanding of contemporary culture, design, entertainment, social and consumer trends.

Ability to move comfortably between big creative ideas and highly tactical execution.

Strong creative-directing skills and ability to give clear, inspiring and actionable feedback.

Strong understanding of print production, digital design, content production and asset development.

Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with multiple overlapping marketing programs and deadlines.

Comfortable challenging convention and advocating for bold ideas while remaining open to feedback and iteration.

Excellent communication, presentation and storytelling skills.

Proficient knowledge of personal computers and Microsoft Office 365 (i.e., Word, Excel).

Demonstrates integrity and ethical behavior.

**Physical Requirements** Ability to communicate clearly in person and on the telephone. Ability to operate a computer keyboard. Ability to travel approximately 20-25% of time as business needs require.

title: Creative Director
description:
The Creative Director is the face of creative on their accounts. They lead concept development and the campaigns that grow out of it. On some of that work, they execute hands-on at a senior level. For the rest, they manage and develop the creative team producing it. They immerse themselves in their clients' businesses, technologies, and markets deeply enough to own the work and the relationship, and they hold the line on quality whether the work is theirs or the team's.

**Who You Are:**
================

* A creative leader who owns the work on your accounts, directing the team's output and holding the standard on everything that reaches a client.
* Still hands-on in the craft, executing at a senior level on the work that calls for it, and setting the bar by what you make as much as what you direct.
* Able to take a complex B2B business and find the idea that makes it land with real people, then sell it in the room.
* A developer of people, giving direct feedback, creating real opportunities, and taking your team's growth personally.
* Commercially sharp, running creative on your accounts profitably and building client relationships that grow.
* Ahead of the problem, whether that's work drifting off strategy, a team stretched too thin, or a client losing confidence.

**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================

Creative Direction & Craft

* Execute at a senior level on a subset of client work, from concept through production-ready files, taking on the projects that most need your hands.
* Lead the development and presentation of campaign concepts and key creative executions on your accounts.
* Deliver creative that meets clients' marketing and communications objectives, not just their aesthetic preferences.
* Write and present persuasive rationales for campaign approaches and defend the work in the room.
* Own brand consistency and unification across everything your accounts produce.
* Set the visual direction on your accounts, making the calls on typography, color, imagery, and how a piece moves the eye, and giving designers and art directors what they need to execute it.
* Make sure art and copy work together from concept through execution.

Team Leadership

* Manage and develop art directors, designers, and writers on your accounts, owning the quality of their work.
* Direct and review creative before it reaches clients, giving the feedback that makes the work and the person better.
* Own your direct reports' development through regular one-on-ones, growth plans, and stretch assignments.
* Lead critiques, ideation sessions, and creative reviews that raise what the team believes is possible.
* Balance assignments and capacity across your accounts and get ahead of workload risk before it reaches clients.
* Run creative on your accounts efficiently and profitably, working with project management on scope, resourcing, and timelines.

Account & Agency Partnership

* Serve as a core team member on your accounts alongside account, strategy, and channel leads.
* Immerse yourself in your clients' business, technology, products, and markets, and keep that knowledge current.
* Partner with strategy so creative is built on insight rather than assumption.
* Bring creative thinking to growth conversations and contribute to new business where your accounts or expertise fit.
* Keep the VP of Creative and account leadership informed on creative health, client relationships, and anything that could turn.

AI Leadership

* Identify workflows and task types across your team that could benefit from new AI tools or approaches.
* Test and pilot new tools, evaluating quality before recommending broader use.
* Support your team in applying approved tools appropriately, including where a tool should and shouldn't be used, and make sure they have the training and guidance.
* Reinforce Godfrey's AI usage policies and guidelines, and the expectation that AI output gets reviewed for quality, accuracy, and originality before it's relied on or shared.
* Surface promising tools, risks, and adoption concerns to the VP of Creative.

**Qualifications:**
===================

* Extensive agency creative experience, including leading campaign concepting and execution across print, digital, and web. B2B experience preferred.
* Experience managing and developing creative talent, including art directors, designers, and writers.
* Proven ability to judge concepts, art, and copy, give direction that makes the work better, and execute at a senior level yourself.
* Strong command of marketing principles and how creative connects to client business objectives.
* Experience presenting and selling creative work to client leadership.
* Digital and content fluency, including how creative performs across channels.
* Experience running creative profitably, including scope, resourcing, and timelines.
* Experience evaluating or rolling out tools and workflows across a team, including AI.
* Portfolio showing range, craft, and ideas that moved client businesses.

At Godfrey, we are guided by 5 core values that all team members are expected to embrace: Fascination, Drive, Partnership, Transparency and Community. By following these principles, we have become the driving force behind many B2B brands’ success stories.
