title: BIM Modeller - AI Product Platform
description:
**About the role:**

**About Janus Digital** Janus Digital ™ is the agentic AI platform that runs the world's real assets. We earn only on the additional value we create. Built on 15+ years of R&D, 76 granted patents and US$100M+ invested, the platform is live across 10,000+ building datasets in 253 cities with Fortune Global 500 owners, sovereign funds and hospitality groups.

**Strategic Context** Every building we make intelligent starts with accurate information about how it is built. High-detail BIM models, and MEP models in particular, are the foundation for digital twins, predictive maintenance and autonomous building operations. Janus Digital is now building its own AI BIM platform to create, check and enrich these models far faster than traditional workflows allow.

This role sits at the centre of that effort. You will deliver production-grade MEP and commercial BIM models using AI tooling to speed up every step, while giving the Chief Platform/Product Officer a practitioner's view of the AI-for-AEC market and the requirements our own platform must meet.

**Position Overview** We seek an experienced BIM Modeller specialising in MEP and commercial buildings, reporting directly to the Chief Platform/Product Officer. This hands-on role combines high-detail model delivery with structured market research into AI tooling and platforms, directly guiding the build of the Janus AI BIM platform.

Your time will split roughly 60% production BIM and 40% platform intelligence. You will model to LOD 350-400 under ISO 19650, measure the time AI and automation save against manual baselines, evaluate emerging AI tools on real project data, and translate real modelling workflows into product requirements, datasets and acceptance criteria.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Produce federated MEP models (HVAC, plumbing and drainage, fire protection, electrical, ELV and low-current systems) for offices, retail, hospitality, mixed-use and data-centre projects
* Model to LOD 350-400, including fabrication-ready ductwork, pipework, containment, hangers and supports where required
* Build and maintain parametric Revit families, shared parameters and project templates aligned to Janus Digital standards
* Run clash detection in Navisworks and BIM Collaborate Pro across architectural, structural and MEP models
* Apply AI and automation across the modelling workflow: auto-routing, family generation, drawing and sheet automation, model checking and scan-to-BIM
* Write and maintain Dynamo and pyRevit/Python scripts, using AI coding assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to build them faster
* Map the AI-for-AEC landscape and run structured, hands-on evaluations of shortlisted tools on real Janus Digital project data
* Work closely with the Chief Platform/Product Officer to shape platform priorities from a practitioner's perspective
* Apply ISO 19650 information management: BEPs, MIDPs/TIDPs, naming conventions and CDE workflows
* Work with the Product team on developing an AI automation BIM tool.
* Highly skilled in testing and trailing new AI tool kits to build.

  
**Requirements**

**Experience**

* 6+ years of BIM modelling, with at least 4 years focused on MEP in commercial projects
* Portfolio of coordinated LOD 350+ MEP models on at least 3 delivered commercial projects
* Proven delivery on ISO 19650 projects, including multi-disciplinary clash coordination
* Demonstrable use of scripting or AI tools to speed up modelling, with before-and-after evidence

**Technical Expertise**

* Expert in Autodesk Revit (MEP); proficient in AutoCAD
* Navisworks Manage, clash detection and BCF issue tracking
* Autodesk Construction Cloud / BIM 360 and BIM Collaborate Pro
* ISO 19650, BEP/MIDP/TIDP, Uniclass or OmniClass classification and IFC export
* Dynamo scripting and working knowledge of Python
* Daily use of LLM assistants for scripting, documentation and research

**Core Competencies**

* Precision: models are right first time, with clashes and data errors caught before issue
* Builder mindset: automates any task done more than twice and shares the tool with the team
* Critical evaluation: tests AI vendor claims on real data and reports results without hype
* Product thinking: turns modelling pain points into clear problem statements the product team can build against

**Preferred Qualifications**

* pyRevit, Revit API (C#), Grasshopper / Rhino.Inside or Autodesk Platform Services (APS) APIs
* Hands-on experience with AI-for-AEC tools in generative design, auto-routing, drawing automation, AI model checking or scan-to-BIM
* Point cloud import and modelling to scan
* Fabrication parts (Revit Fabrication / MEP Fabrication) and data-centre or healthcare services experience
* Solibri, Revizto or BIMcollab; COBie, IDS and bSDD; Dubai Municipality BIM e-submission experience
* Prior work at a software, PropTech or construction-tech company, or on an internal digital tools team

  
**Benefits**

This role can be based in our UAE office or fully remote, within a 4hr/+- window of Gulf Standard time

title: Mobile Engineer - React Native (100% Remote) - Worldwide
description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

We have launched Keet Mobile on iOS and Android, bringing our full P2P technology stack to everyone. Keet Mobile is not your average app: it’s heavy lifting is performed by a custom JS runtime specially designed for peer-to-peer usage (in fact, it reuses 100% of Keet Desktop’s code!). The UI logic, on the other hand, is 100% React Native, giving us flexibility and the ability to iterate quickly.

We believe this pattern opens the door to huge possibilities in the future, and we need your help getting there!

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. Keet Mobile is built with React Native and Expo, and its P2P core runs on the device itself in a Bare worklet. You'll own features end to end, from UI/UX implementation to using the P2P core apis.  
  
You will:  

* Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup
* Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android
* Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use
* Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting
* Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality

  

* Significant experience with React Native, Redux for state management and Redux-Saga

* Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.
* Experienced with WebSockets, RESTful based APIs.
* Knowledge in native languages (Swift/Kotlin) and familiarity with native build tools (Xcode/Android Studio) is advantageous.
* Experience working with a remote team
* Interested in modernizing and optimizing different mobile or web applications.
* Bonus points if you have any built something amazing on any p2p frameworks .

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

title: AI-Native Business Analyst / Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
### **Why Keyrus, Why Now!**

Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: **AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.**

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: **we operationalise intelligence.**

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: **understanding, deciding, designing, and creating.**

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a **Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.**

**Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.**

### **Role Details**

**Job location:** Barcelona, Spain (Onsite model)  
**Contract type:** Employee / Contractor B2B  
**Target start date:** Early January 2027  
**Working hours:** Full-time
  
**Compensation:** €45,000–€60,000 gross per year  
**Languages:** Spanish and English

**Note:** All applications and CVs must be submitted in English.

#### **What You'll Architect**

As an **AI-Native Business Analyst / Forward Deployed Engineer**, you will help organisations transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining **business analysis, data, AI-enabled ways of working, and human decision-making**.

Working closely with **business stakeholders and digital delivery teams**, you will help identify the real problem behind a request, challenge assumptions constructively and **translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements.** You will also bring a practical **AI-first approach** to your work, exploring how **AI and Generative AI can accelerate analysis, improve processes and help teams** validate solutions more effectively.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working at the **intersection of business, data and technology**, and who is curious about better ways to turn ideas into outcomes.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

* Engage directly with business stakeholders to understand **processes, challenges, and desired business outcomes**.
* Translate business needs into **clear requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria** for digital delivery teams.
* Challenge requirements constructively to ensure teams solve the **right business problem**, rather than simply implementing requested features.
* Act as the bridge between **business stakeholders and technical delivery teams**, ensuring alignment throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Apply an **AI-first mindset** to identify opportunities where **AI and GenAI can accelerate analysis, improve requirements quality, support prototyping, or optimise business processes**.
* Leverage AI tools as part of your daily work to increase speed, quality, and effectiveness in analysis and documentation.
* Help teams rapidly explore and validate alternative approaches rather than defaulting to traditional solutions.
* Understand and consider **data dependencies, data quality considerations, and governance implications** when shaping requirements.
* Collaborate effectively with distributed teams across **France, Spain, India, and the Philippines**.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders through an active on-site presence in Bangalore.

#### **Who You Are**

* You are naturally curious and constantly looking for better ways to solve business problems.
* You do not see AI as a separate capability. Instead, you instinctively think **AI-first**, using AI tools to improve analysis, accelerate delivery, and challenge traditional ways of working.
* You enjoy understanding business processes, questioning assumptions, and uncovering the underlying problems that need to be solved.
* You are comfortable working between **business** and **technical teams,** helping both sides reach clarity and alignment.
* You are a**nalytical and structured**, but also p**ragmatic and focused** on outcomes.
* You are **confident challenging stakeholders constructively** when requirements, assumptions, or proposed solutions can be improved.
* You **thrive in collaborative and international environments** and enjoy working with people from different backgrounds and functions.
* You are **self-directed, take ownership of your work, and are comfortable operating autonomously** within a global organisation.
* You communicate clearly and effectively with both business users and technical teams.

#### **️** **What You Bring**

##### **Qualifications & Experience**

* Relevant academic background or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong Business Analyst experience with **strong data / CRM / Salesforce exposure**.
* Experience gathering, analysing, documenting, and refining business requirements.
* Experience producing high-quality **user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria**.
* Ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams including business stakeholders, developers, product teams, and data specialists.
* Experience operating within international or distributed organisations.
* Professional proficiency in **English**.
* Able to work **on-site in Bangalore.**

##### **Technical & Professional Skills**

* Excellent **requirements engineering and business analysis capabilities**.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate business challenges into clear and actionable delivery requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience working closely with technical delivery teams and understanding technology constraints and opportunities.
* Practical experience using **AI and GenAI tools** to improve productivity, analysis, documentation, requirements engineering, or delivery effectiveness.
* Strong understanding of the value AI can bring to business analysis, process optimisation, and solution design.
* Ability to challenge both business and technical stakeholders constructively.
* Understanding of **data dependencies, data quality considerations, and governance principles**.
* Comfortable working autonomously while managing multiple stakeholder relationships.

##### **Particularly Valuable Experience**

* Experience using tools such as **Microsoft Copilot, Copilot for Microsoft 365, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar LLM-based assistants** to improve analysis, documentation, problem-solving, and delivery workflows.
* Ability to demonstrate how AI meaningfully changes and improves your approach to business analysis rather than simply using AI occasionally.

##### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with **data-intensive applications**, analytics platforms, or data transformation programmes.
* Understanding of **data governance, data lifecycle management, and data quality frameworks**.
* Experience in a **Technical Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Forward Deployed Engineer, or similar hybrid role**.
* Exposure to **industrial, manufacturing, energy, or services environments**.
* Experience working in **Agile product delivery environments**.
* Familiarity with using AI to support **requirements engineering, business analysis, solution exploration, documentation, or rapid prototyping**.

#### **What Makes You Successful**

* You focus on **understanding the business problem** before defining the solution.
* You use **AI naturally as part of your workflow**, enabling faster analysis, better requirements, and more informed decision-making.
* You challenge assumptions respectfully and help stakeholders explore alternatives that may create greater value.
* You balance business needs, technical realities, and delivery constraints to arrive at practical solutions.
* You can move **comfortably** between **strategic conversations** anddetailed **requirements definition**.
* You **build trust with stakeholders** through clear communication, curiosity, and consistent delivery.
* You understand that requirements are rarely perfect on day one and are comfortable working through ambiguity to create clarity.
* You proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, accelerate delivery, and **enhance outcomes through AI-enabled approaches.**
* You contribute to collective intelligence by **sharing knowledge,** **encouraging better ways of working**, and **helping teams become more effective.**
* You combine the mindset of a **Business Analyst, Product Analyst, and AI practitioner**, using technology not as an end goal, but as a way to solve meaningful business challenges.

#### **What We Offer at Keyrus Spain**

* **Competitive salary**, paid in **14 instalments** (option for **12 from day one**).
* **Annual performance bonus**.
* **Meal allowance** (Restaurant Tickets): **€1,800/year net,** distributed over 11 monthly reloads
* **Flexible retribution plan**: transport & daycare tickets
* **Private medical insurance with Sanitas** (no copays, dental included)
* **22 days of annual leave**, increasing every 3 years (up to 26 days)
* **14 public holidays** (Madrid calendar)
* December **24th** and **31s**t are considered **company holidays when they fall on working days**
* Continuous learning via **KLX – Keyrus Learning Experience**
* A collaborative, international, and human-centred work environment

#### **How Our Salary Ranges Work**

At Keyrus, salary ranges reflect **different levels of mastery and impact within the same role** — not different job titles.

* **Bottom of the range**  
  You meet the core requirements and will need ramp-up time and support.
* **Middle of the range**  
  You are fully autonomous from Day 1 and deliver consistently.
* **Top of the range**  
  You are a reference for the role, mentor others, and raise the bar for the team.

Final offers are based on **experience, autonomy, scope, and market context**, and are discussed transparently during the process.

#### **Responsible AI & Recruitment**

**At Keyrus, all stages of our recruitment process are conducted and evaluated by human recruiters and interviewers.**  
To support accuracy and efficiency, AI may occasionally be used internally by our team exclusively for **note-taking purposes during interviews**. AI is **never** used to make decisions.

To ensure **fairness, authenticity, and the protection of confidential and proprietary information**, the use of AI tools by candidates during the recruitment process is **strictly prohibited**.

Our commitment to **responsible AI practices** ensures that hiring decisions are based solely on each candidate’s own skills, experience, judgment, and expertise.

️ **Any use of AI assistance during the interview process may result in immediate disqualification from the recruitment process.**

#### **Equal Opportunity Statement**

We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and encourage applications from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO) | Hydrogen
description:
*Lead the technological core of Kerionics: the development and industrialization of the SOEC technology you'll bring to market in 2028.*

### **About us**

At Kerionics, we accelerate industrial decarbonization through technologies that make cleaner, more efficient energy possible. We are a spin-off from ITQ (UPV-CSIC), born from scientific knowledge with a clear goal: turning research into real industrial solutions.

Our SOEC (solid oxide electrolysis) technology produces hydrogen with high energy efficiency where it is needed most: energy-intensive industries such as steel, petrochemicals, cement, ceramics and paper, where replacing fossil fuels remains a major challenge. We are a multicultural team of more than 40 people, united by a shared purpose.

### **What we are looking for**

We need a CTO to lead the development and industrialization of our SOEC technology, with our 2028 go-to-market in sight. Over the coming years we will scale the technology by orders of magnitude. You would join at a critical point: not at the beginning, where everything is exploration, nor at the end, where everything is execution, but where scientific rigor and industrial discipline must coexist every day.

We want someone who combines the scientific rigor to solve the open challenges in MEA (Membrane Electrode Assembly), Stack and Balance of Plant (BoP) with the discipline of New Product Introduction (NPI) to take the technology from the lab to an industrial product.

You will lead three managers, one each for MEA, Stack and BoP: people with judgment, autonomy and deep knowledge of their fields. Your challenge is not to build a team from scratch, but to take it to the next level: aligning everyone around the roadmap, professionalizing how we develop product and building a technical culture together.

This is not a role for silent execution. You will be **the CEO's technical right hand**: following the defined strategy and, when needed, challenging it with arguments if you believe something has been decided wrongly. You report to the CEO, but we expect you to co-build, not just execute. That technical honesty is part of the job.

### **Why this role matters**

* **Technical leadership of a European deeptech scale-up**, with technical, commercial and environmental impact at the same time.
* **A project with real backing**: financial support from deeptech-specialized funds such as InnoEnergy, top-tier industrial and scientific partners, participation in strategic European projects, and new conversations with private investors for the next phase.
* **A real voice in strategy**: you sit on the management committee, take part in strategic and investment decisions, and your technical opinion carries weight.
* **The full transition to market**: from prototype to product, from lab to industrial plant, from first customer to deployment.

### **What you will do**

* **Product development:** lead the cross-functional development of our SOEC technology across MEA, Stack and BoP; make sure it follows an NPI logic with clear stage gates, technical pass/fail criteria and traceability of decisions; lead the transition from R&D to industrialization.
* **Team and culture:** lead the MEA, Stack and BoP managers directly, unblock what they need, build a technical culture grounded in data, honesty and accountability, and take an active role in technical hiring.
* **Critical technical problems:** provide top-level judgment on open challenges and lead decisions that cut across areas, even with incomplete data.
* **Strategy:** be the technical reference in the management committee, give the CEO honest judgment, and represent Kerionics before partners, investors and customers.
* **Industrialization and quality:** coordinate with the Industrial Project Manager on the future plant, and with the Quality & Testing Manager to align validation criteria with the product.

### **What we expect in your first 12 months**

1. **Own the technical roadmap:** understand the current state of the product and the commitments made to partners and investors. By the end of your first quarter, present your own critical assessment of the roadmap to the CEO and the board.  
2. **Build the trust of the MEA, Stack and BoP managers and their teams**, and the cross-functional rituals and processes that do not yet exist.  
3. **Strengthen the development process:** consolidate the existing stage-gate system, refining pass/fail criteria, decision traceability and documentation.  
4. **Bring AI into how the team works**, where it adds real value, leading by example. No top-down rollout.  
5. **Deliver the next major validation milestones** of the roadmap.  
6. **Build Kerionics' technical voice externally** and position it as a SOEC reference in Europe.

### **How we work**

We work **on-site** at Parque Tecnológico de Paterna (Valencia), close to the product: lab, workshop, prototypes and test benches. We usually start early (around 7:30), which leaves your afternoons free for sports, family or whatever you prefer.

### **What we ask for**

**Must-haves**

* Advanced degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Materials, Energy), Materials Science or Chemistry. A PhD will be highly valued.
* At least **5 years** in electrochemical or hydrogen technologies (electrolysis, fuel cells or equivalent). Direct SOEC experience is not required: we value deep knowledge of stacks, MEAs or systems that you can bring to ours.
* At least **3 years** leading product development from R&D toward industrialization.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams.
* Solid knowledge of at least one pillar: MEA and electrochemical materials, stack design and validation, or BoP in complex energy systems. We do not expect equal depth in all three, but you must hold demanding technical conversations across them.
* Fluent English, spoken and written, for technical discussions and for representing the company.
* Availability to relocate to Valencia within 2-3 months. If you need more time for family reasons, let's talk.
* Valid work permit for Spain, or eligibility to obtain one. For the right candidate, we support the paperwork.

**We are looking for someone who...**

* Has the judgment to say no to a good project that doesn't fit the strategy, and yes to a hard one when the evidence supports it.
* Decides under uncertainty without falling into paralysis or improvisation.
* Challenges the CEO with arguments when needed, while staying loyal to the agreed strategy.
* Leads through context and example, not micromanagement, and stays hands-on when needed.
* Stays current with AI and uses it critically.
* Can join an already formed team and earn its trust through knowledge and respect, not hierarchy.

**Not required, but you'll surprise us if you also...**

* Have direct experience with SOEC or SOFC, or high-temperature ceramic materials.
* Have been a CTO, VP of R&D or Head of Technology in a deeptech scale-up.
* Have lived a complete industrial scale-up (TRL 5-6 to TRL 8-9) in electrochemical, energy or advanced materials technologies.
* Know our target sectors (steel, cement, petrochemicals, ceramics, glass, paper).
* Speak Spanish.
* Have your own network in the European hydrogen, SOEC/SOFC or industrial decarbonization ecosystem.

**A note before you decide...**

This list describes an ideal profile, not a checklist. People from groups underrepresented in deeptech and engineering tend to be harder on themselves when reading job descriptions. Don't decide for us: send us your CV, and let us decide whether there's a fit.

### **What we offer**

* **€70-90K gross per year**, depending on experience and fit.
* **Variable bonus of up to €20K**, linked to the technical milestones of our roadmap. Details shared during the process.
* **Stock option plan.** Full terms shared during the process.
* **Permanent contract**, with a standard 6-month probationary period.
* Relocation support package for candidates moving to Valencia.
* 22 working days of holiday.
* Language lessons (Spanish or English) if you want to strengthen your language skills.
* Annual training budget tailored to your needs.
* A multicultural team: colleagues from India, the UK, France, Pakistan, Mexico, Uruguay, Colombia, Ecuador...
* Every Friday, 11:00 to 12:00, a good Valencian esmorzaret to disconnect and celebrate the week's small wins.

### **How our selection process works**

1. A video call with our Head of People & Culture.  
2. A video call with our CEO, to explore your technical vision and how it fits with Kerionics' strategy.  
3. A video call with an external expert.  
4. A video call with a member of our Board, focused on long-term vision and an independent view of strategic fit.  
5. A full-day visit to our facilities in Paterna (Valencia), where you will see the product and meet the MEA, Stack and BoP managers, your future direct reports. We cover your travel and accommodation.

We will update you within 5 working days after each step and treat your candidacy with full confidentiality.

title: SDR Manager
description:
We are looking for a hands-on sales development leader to build and run Oppizi's outbound engine from Barcelona. You will manage our SDR team, carry your own pipeline target, and own the outbound motion end to end: lists, sequences, deliverability, coaching, and conversion. If you know outbound as a craft and not just as a dashboard, and you want to build the machine rather than inherit it, we want to hear from you.

**What's Oppizi**

Oppizi is the first major multi-channel player in offline performance marketing. We have built a technology platform that enables the tracking, scaling and optimisation of flyering, door-to-door, direct mail, and insert media campaigns. We operate in 14 countries, including the US, UK, Canada, Australia, France, Germany, Spain, and more. We are proud to work with flagship accounts such as Uber, DoorDash, Chipotle, Deliveroo, and many others.

Our tech team of 50 is AI-first and ships fast. We are currently building an AI agent platform that will power our product for the next five to ten years, led by a Chief AI Officer who previously worked at NASA and SpaceX. We operate in a category with very few real competitors, against incumbents who are growing at 5% a year.

**The role**

Reporting to the COO, you will lead Oppizi's SDR team in Barcelona and personally contribute to pipeline. This is explicitly a player-coach role. You will spend part of your week prospecting your own accounts and the rest managing, coaching, and building the systems that make the team better.

We do not have a finished outbound playbook. We have strong logos, a differentiated product, and a team that needs a leader who knows how to build sequences that land, coach reps who are ramping, and turn activity into qualified pipeline. That build is the job.

**Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership and Coaching**

* Manage, coach, and develop the Barcelona SDR team, owning ramp, performance, and progression
* Run weekly one-to-ones, call reviews, and pipeline reviews with a consistent methodology
* Set clear activity and outcome KPIs, and hold the team to them
* Build a performance culture grounded in accountability, feedback, and continuous improvement
* Own hiring and onboarding for the SDR team as it grows

**Personal Pipeline (The Player Half)**

* Carry your own quota for qualified meetings and pipeline generated
* Personally prospect into strategic and enterprise accounts, leading by example
* Stay hands-on in the tools every week; you should be writing sequences, not just approving them
* Run discovery calls and hand over cleanly to Account Executives and General Managers

**Outbound engine and process**

* Own the full outbound motion: list building, segmentation, sequencing, multichannel cadence, and follow-up
* Own email deliverability end to end, including domain warming, inbox rotation, and sender reputation
* Continuously test and improve messaging, subject lines, open rates, reply rates, and meeting conversion
* Build the objection handling library and the qualification framework the team runs on
* Partner with Marketing on ICP definition, ABM target lists, and campaign follow-up

**Reporting and Revenue Operations**

* Own CRM hygiene and data quality for the top of the funnel
* Report weekly on activity, pipeline generated, conversion rates, and forecast to the COO
* Run the business off data, not anecdote
* Leverage AI-powered sales tools and Oppizi's internal agent stack to raise team productivity

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* **Know outbound as a craft.** You have personally written the sequences, fixed the deliverability, and cracked the list that finally worked.
* **Coach rather than supervise**. You have taken a ramping SDR and made them good, and you can point to who and how.
* **Lead from the front.** You are comfortable carrying your own number while developing the team around you.
* **Build where there is no playbook.** You bring structure to ambiguity instead of waiting for it to arrive.
* **Move with urgency.** You operate fast, adapt quickly, and prefer shipping to planning.
* **Communicate with precision**. Whether it is a cold email, a call review, or a weekly report, you are clear and credible.
* **Are genuinely ambitious.** You want the next role after this one, and you want to earn it by building something.

**Why should I Apply?**

* **Build the engine, don't inherit it**. There is no outbound playbook here yet. You will write it, and it will carry your fingerprints.
* **Sell a genuinely differentiated product**. Oppizi operates in a category with very few real competitors and serves enterprise clients you already know.
* **Real progression**. This role sits directly under the COO with visibility across the leadership team. Strong performance opens the path to Head of Sales Development or a broader commercial mandate.
* **Work with exceptional people.** We are builders, not politicians. The Oppizi culture values directness, curiosity, and getting things done.
* **Join at the right time**. We are scaling across 14 markets with a growing enterprise client base and significant product investment.

  
**Requirements**  

* 5 to 8 years in B2B sales development or inside sales, with at least 2 years directly managing an SDR or BDR team
* Demonstrable track record of building and scaling an outbound engine in B2B SaaS, MarTech, or AdTech
* Deep hands-on expertise in outbound: sequence design, deliverability, domain and inbox management, multichannel cadence
* Proven coaching ability, with concrete examples of reps you ramped and developed
* Experience prospecting into enterprise or mid-market accounts, not just SMB volume
* Strong command of CRM and outbound tooling; experience with HubSpot, Clay, and Lemlist is a strong plus
* Comfortable being measured on both team output and a personal number
* Fluent English is mandatory.
* Based in Barcelona or willing to relocate. This is an on-site role
* Comfortable with occasional international travel
* Fluency in either French, German or Spanish is a strong plus.

  
**Benefits**

**Compensation**

  

* Competitive base salary.
* Annual performance bonus.
* Employee stock options.

**Benefits**

* Private health insurance (Alan) after successful completion of probation.
* 22 days annual leave plus 3 additional convenio days.
* Two paid volunteer days each year.

**Flexibility**

* Hybrid working model with four days per week in our Barcelona office.
* Occasional opportunities to work remotely from another location.
* Right to disconnect outside working hours, except in exceptional business situations.

**Interested? Apply now!**  
Only candidates who have been selected for an interview will be contacted.  
Thank you for understanding.

Puig is a home of Love Brands within a family company that furthers wellness, confidence and self-expression while leaving a better world. For more than a century, our entrepreneurial spirit and passion for creativity have made us a challenger in the premium beauty industry.

Puig is looking for a Global Retail Health & Safety Manager to define, deploy and continuously improve the Health & Safety strategy across the Group's worldwide retail network, with particular focus on directly operated stores and guidance for concessions, joint ventures and partner-operated retail environments.

* Deliver Health & Safety training, workshops and awareness sessions for store managers, retail employees and relevant contractors, in person and virtually
* Review, update and quality-check Retail Health & Safety training content, guidance materials, induction resources and operational communications before deployment
* Provide day-to-day technical advice and practical support to Retail Operations and country teams, helping resolve Health & Safety issues arising in stores
* Support and, when required, lead investigations of incidents and near misses, identify root causes, agree corrective and preventive actions and share lessons learned across markets
* Monitor Retail Health & Safety performance, maintain accurate data in corporate systems and prepare practical reports on incidents, findings, overdue actions, recurring risks and deployment progress

* At least 5 years of Health & Safety experience, including substantial responsibility in a global or multi-country retail, luxury, consumer goods, hospitality or similarly customer-facing environment. Experience managing a geographically dispersed network of stores is essential
* Strong knowledge of occupational Health & Safety management systems, ISO 45001, risk assessment, legal compliance, audits and inspections, incident investigation, contractor management, emergency preparedness and continuous improvement
* Technical credibility with strong stakeholder management, persuasion and coaching skills. You can influence without direct authority, build effective relationships across cultures and functions, and create shared accountability for Health & Safety performance;
* English and Spanish are a must; French or other languages would be an advantage
* Availability to travel internationally
  

We welcome Creators Of All Kinds. If you are unsure of meeting all the requirements but trust you have the transferable skills to excel in this role, complete the application and our teams will get in touch if you are selected for an interview.

title: PICs@ICFO Strategic Initiative: Postdoctoral Researcher in TGV Metallization and Seed-Layer Processes
description:
As part of the **PICs@ICFO Strategic Initiative**, ICFO coordinates PIXEurope, a flagship **Pilot Line funded under the European Chips JU program**, focused on Advanced Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) through which ICFO is advancing frontier technologies, including optical interposers for Co-packaged optics for next-generation optoelectronic and photonic devices.

To strengthen this initiative, ICFO is seeking a highly motivated Engineer/Scientist with strong expertise in thin-film deposition and metallization of high-aspect-ratio Through-Glass Vias (TGVs).

**Position Overview:**,

We offer a post-doctoral position to a scientist with hands-on experience in thin-film deposition, surface preparation, and metallization for semiconductor, MEMS, or advanced-packaging applications. The successful candidate will develop, optimize, and scale reliable adhesion, barrier, and conductive seed layers inside high-aspect-ratio glass vias, ensuring continuity and compatibility with subsequent copper plating and interconnection processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**,

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Develop and optimize seed-layer deposition processes for high-aspect-ratio Through-Glass Vias
* Develop substrate cleaning, glass-surface activation, and adhesion-promotion processes
* Develop adhesion, barrier, and conductive seed stacks such as Ti/Cu, Cr/Cu, TiW/Cu, and related systems
* Optimize sputtering, evaporation, electroless, ALD or CVD-assisted, and hybrid deposition approaches
* Achieve continuous and conformal seed coverage along via entrances, sidewalls, and exits
* Characterize thickness, morphology, resistivity, adhesion, continuity, and wafer-level uniformity
* Identify and mitigate shadowing, seed discontinuity, oxidation, delamination, and cracking
Coordinate with the laser and glass team to align via geometry and surface condition with seeding, plating, and interconnection requirements  

  
This position will report to the **Prof. Dr. Valerio Pruneri, Director of the European Chips JU Pilot Line PIXEurope.**

PIXEurope is co-funded by the Chips Joint Undertaking and national funding authorities of the Participating States, Spain, Ireland, The Netherlands, Finland, Belgium, Portugal, Poland, Austria, France, Italy, United Kingdom. In particular, it is co-funded by Spain through the Ministry for Digital Transformation and Civil Service under reference CJU-010000-2025-0005, as part of the Recovery, Transformation and Resilience Plan (PRTR).

Applicants must hold a PhD in materials science, chemistry, chemical engineering, electrical engineering, microelectronics, physics, microengineering, or related fields, or equivalent research experience.

Candidates should demonstrate expertise in the following areas (not all mandatory, but strongly preferred):

* Thin-film deposition by sputtering, evaporation, ALD, CVD, or electroless methods
* Metallization processes for semiconductor, MEMS, microfabrication, or advanced-packaging applications
* Surface preparation, activation, and surface chemistry of glass or dielectric materials
* Metal-to-dielectric adhesion and adhesion/barrier/seed-layer material systems
* Metallization or coating of high-aspect-ratio three-dimensional structures
* Redistribution layer patterning and fabrication
* Electrical and structural characterization of thin films and interconnects
* Cleanroom processes, safety procedures, and fabrication protocols
Process optimization, reproducibility, failure analysis, and wafer-level uniformity

* Fluent in English

Your Team
  
The Iberia Claims team supports customers at the defining moment of our service: when a loss occurs. The team combines technical excellence with solution-oriented thinking to provide a superior claims experience before, during and after a loss.
  
Working across follow business claims, the team collaborates with brokers, clients, loss adjusters, third-party administrators and internal stakeholders. Reporting to the Regional Head of Claims Iberia, you will support the effective management of follow business claims across Iberia. Your focus on accurate registration, disciplined follow-up, bordereaux processing, documentation governance and reliable data will help claims progress efficiently and support sound operational reporting. You will also contribute to simplifying, standardising and automating recurring claims activities through digital tools, workflow solutions and artificial intelligence.

* You will register, update and maintain follow of business claims accurately and on time in the relevant claims systems, including documentation, diary management and claim status updates.
* You will process, review and reconcile bordereaux information, identify missing or inconsistent data, and coordinate corrections to support complete and reliable records.
* You will maintain strong administrative control over claim files, pending actions, payment tracking, reserves, recoveries, closure processes, and portfolio cleanliness.
* You will follow up with brokers, clients, loss adjusters, third-party administrators and internal teams to obtain information, monitor next steps and support timely claim progression.
* You will support operational reporting, management information, key performance indicator monitoring, and file quality reviews in line with internal claims guidelines and delegated authority.
* You will identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, or automate recurring administrative tasks using dashboards, workflow solutions, Power Platform, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools where appropriate.
* You will contribute to process optimization and continuous improvement across administrative and bordereaux-driven claims activities.

What You’ll Bring to the Role
  
  

* You have experience in an administrative or process-oriented role, ideally within insurance, claims operations, bordereaux management, third-party administrators, brokers, shared services or operational support.
* You demonstrate strong organizational discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to manage structured processes, deadlines, documentation, controls, and data quality requirements.
* You have a good command of Microsoft Excel and confidence working with reports, lists, bordereaux, claim registers, operational dashboards, and data reconciliation activities.
* You have a basic understanding of claims administration concepts, including claim registration, reserves, payments, recoveries, documentation standards, and closure processes.
* You have experience with, or a strong interest in, automation tools, process optimization, workflow solutions, Microsoft Power Platform, or other digital tools that reduce manual effort.
* A willingness to learn and explore how AI can enhance your role and the broader organization is expected.
* You demonstrate a collaborative, proactive, and service-oriented mindset, with clear communication across internal teams and external stakeholders.
* You have fluent Spanish and English language skills; Portuguese language skills would be an advantage.

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the global advertising product end-to-end. This means everything from the ad-core stack (serving, auction, targeting, measurement) to growing revenue beyond listings through self-serve advertiser tools, programmatic demand, and retail-media formats. You'll also shape how advertising integrates into AI-native surfaces — balancing monetisation yield against buyer experience.

  

This is a role for someone who has built advertising products at scale, understands the programmatic ecosystem, and is excited about using AI to create new advertising experiences. You'll work closely with business and commercial stakeholders to grow revenue, while ensuring our advertising never compromises the trust our users place in the platform.

  

This role reports to the Head of Product.

What you'll do
--------------

* Own the global advertising product end-to-end: ad-core stack (serving, auction, targeting, measurement) across all marketplaces and platforms
* Drive growth of advertising revenue beyond listings, including self-serve advertiser tools, programmatic demand, and retail-media formats such as sponsored listings, native, and video
* Own integration of ads into AI-native surfaces such as AutoIQ and agentic search, balancing yield against buyer experience
* Define and track advertising success metrics: revenue, fill rate, eCPM, advertiser ROI, buyer experience impact
* Partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, and Sales teams to build the product capabilities that unlock revenue growth
* Represent the advertising product at the leadership level, presenting strategy and results to executive audiences

What we're looking for
----------------------

* Significant product management experience in digital advertising, ad-tech, monetisation, or revenue product at scale
* Proven track record of building and scaling advertising products — programmatic ads, third-party ads, billing systems, or ad-serving platforms
* Experience taking advertising or monetisation products from early-stage to meaningful revenue
* Ability to balance monetisation yield with user experience — making evidence-based trade-offs between revenue and buyer trust
* AI-native: you build with AI, not just use it for productivity. You experiment with AI tools outside of work and bring that curiosity into your product craft
* Zero-to-one: you see opportunities, not just optimisations. You spot problems, build prototypes, and ship
* Comfortable with ambiguity: you don't wait for perfect clarity — you create it
* Strong stakeholder management across commercial, engineering, and executive audiences

  

**Preferred**:

  

* Experience with retail media, sponsored listings, native advertising, or video ad formats in a marketplace or e-commerce context
* Familiarity with AI-native product surfaces and how advertising integrates with AI experiences
* Multi-market experience across different regulatory and commercial environments

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX**

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

*OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. For more details on how your application data will be processed please check our* *Privacy Statement**.*

title: Head of Global Events and Travel (100% REMOTE)
description:
The Head of Global Events & Travel leads the strategy, governance, and execution of our global events and corporate travel function. This role oversees three interconnected areas:

* **Flagship, VIP, High-Complexity & Client/client’s customers-Facing Events** (client and client’s customers events, executive dinners, and high-touch VIP gatherings);
* **Internal Meetings & Corporate Travel** (global gatherings, executive offsites, collaborators travel program); and
* **Dedicated Financial Control & Commercial Management**.

The Head is accountable for the full events and corporate travel portfolio, consolidated budgets, strategic supplier agreements, service standards, and duty-of-care governance. Serving both internal teams and external stakeholders (clients, prospects, and partners), the Head sets priorities, builds team capability, and manages major commercial decisions and C-level/client escalations. Financial oversight is supported by the Event & Travel Finance Lead in alignment with central Corporate FP&A.

A key initial priority is leading the implementation and transition to our enhanced travel operating model. Once established, the Head provides oversight through periodic performance reviews and exception management, delegating routine operations to the team and Travel Management Companies (TMCs).

**Responsibilities**

* **Function Leadership:** Lead and develop the Team. Recruit open roles, establish team cadence, and build capabilities across the function. Strategic resource planning across agencies, production vendors, and internal talent to execute both internal and client-facing events seamlessly.
* **Flagship, VIP & Client/client’s customers-Facing Events:** Execute on objectives, budgets, and brand standards set by C-Level leadership for 5,000-attendee conference, VIP executive receptions, and regional customer summits. Manage delivery through the internal Team, supported by event specialists and external agencies. Lead venue selection, production, security, contract negotiations, and attendee experience for both internal and external audiences.
* **Internal Meetings & Offsites:** Oversee the internal gathering strategy and delivery. Standardize playbooks for routine company meetings and regional leadership offsites.
* **Travel Operating Model Transition:** Lead the implementation of our approved global travel operating model, including RFPs and contracts for multi-region TMCs, unified policy and expense frameworks, approvals, reconciliation, and dual quoting. Coordinate phased migration corridor-by-corridor, validate vendor acceptance, protect service continuity, and establish an operational handover once stable.
* **Corporate Travel Oversight:** Own global travel strategy, master agreements, and major operational escalations. Oversee daily fulfillment, group flights, hotel blocks, rebooking, and high-touch support for executives, clients, and guest speakers managed by TMCs and the Travel & Logistics Coordinator.
* **Budget Accountability & Resource Stewardship:** Own the consolidated events and travel budget, as well as revenue/cost-recovery models for sponsored or client-facing events. Act as a steward of company resources, prioritizing expenditure against strategic business objectives, maximizing ROI on client events, identifying cost-saving opportunities, and escalating forecast overruns early with mitigation plans.
* **Financial Governance & Client Billing:** Work through the Team to manage annual budgets, rolling forecasts, vendor deposits, event ledgers, cross-charging/client billing, invoice reconciliation, and post-event financial reviews. Maintain strict approval thresholds, separation of duties, purchase orders, payment terms, and international VAT/GST recovery.
* **Strategic Suppliers & Commercial Partnerships:** Lead major RFPs and negotiations with TMCs, airlines, hotel chains, event venues, registration platforms, and production partners. Maintain competitive discipline, set service expectations, and delegate routine vendor management while remaining the key point of contact for material escalations.
* **Policy, Duty of Care & Risk Management:** Own the global events and travel policy. Establish traveler assistance, emergency response, data privacy, and incident escalation frameworks in coordination with People Ops, Legal, IT, and Security, ensuring comprehensive coverage for collaborators, clients, and external VIP guests.
* **Cross-Functional & Client Partnership:** Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on client event revenue targets, sponsorships, client experience, and commercial outcomes. Collaborate with C-Level executives on internal event agendas, keynotes, and executive participation. Partner with Finance, Legal, and People Ops to streamline global delivery.
* **Events & Travel Leadership:** 8+ years leading corporate events and managed travel programs, including 3+ years leading a global function in a fast-growing, international environment.
* **Client & Internal Event Expertise:** Proven track record running both internal company meetings/offsites and high-impact, client- or customer-facing events (e.g., user conferences, client advisory boards, sponsored summits, roadshows).
* **Large-Scale Event Execution:** Proven experience directing large conferences (5,000+ attendees) end-to-end, covering budgets, venue sourcing, registration tech, production, speaker/VIP management, and vendor teams.
* **Travel Program Transformation:** Hands-on experience implementing or re-platforming corporate travel frameworks (TMC selections, booking/expense integrations, phased migrations, and duty-of-care rollouts). Multi-TMC or hybrid experience preferred.
* **Travel Industry & Commercial Fluency:** Strong understanding of airline/hotel distribution economics (GDS, NDC, dynamic pricing, corporate direct programs) and commercial contracting for high-value event venues and suppliers.
* **Financial & Commercial Acumen:** Demonstrated budget ownership, financial forecasting, ROI tracking, vendor negotiations, and client event billing/cost recovery. Experience with virtual-card systems or modern payment settlements is a plus.
* **Executive & External Presence:** Exceptional communication and presentation skills; comfortable engaging directly with C-Suite executives, enterprise clients, sponsors, and key industry partners.
* **Data Privacy & Duty of Care:** Solid understanding of global travel safety protocols, crisis management, GDPR compliance, vendor DPAs, and attendee data privacy standards.
* **Language & Mobility:** Professional fluency in English (Spanish and/or Italian are strong pluses). Willingness to travel internationally up to 40% and operate across European, Middle Eastern, and Americas time zones.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

title: Trial Clinical Delivery Lead
description:
Senior Project Manager

At ICON Strategic Solutions, you will work in a sponsor-dedicated model, supported by ICON’s global expertise.

  

As the world’s largest FSP organisation, with over 90 sponsor partnerships, we offer stability, career development and a collaborative environment where your work contributes to the development of treatments that benefit patients worldwide.

* Promote solution-orientated thinking and issue resolution at the country/study/program team level. Provide an escalation pathway to ensure program/study-specific major observations from CSLs/CRMs are relayed to and followed up by the appropriate internal and/or external business partners

* Support program/product/study-specific onboarding for new ICSO team members and contribute to enhancing their site/study management capabilities/skills

* Promote product knowledge, collaboration and information channelling; contribute to best practice guidance to drive consistency in the management of sites/studies

* Provide link between CSLs/CRMs and Global functions, being single point of contact for operational topics and escalations, support information channeling and facilitating solutions at the program level

* Lead regular calls with CSLs/CRMs working on study and/or other activities within the assigned program(s)

* Other accountabilities as assigned by Functional Manager in support of the business
  

**Clinical Development Studies**

* Utilise site performance and quality data analytics to drive risk-based sponsor oversight activities for investigational sites in outsourced studies
  

* Represent the CSL group at the Clinical Operations Team (COT)/Trial Team (TT) via:

* Regular review meetings of study/site performance and quality metrics and the associated strategic action planning

* Ad hoc interactions to address immediate issues

* Other COT/TT meetings as appropriate e.g. kick-off meeting

* ### **Consolidate data-driven, CSL assessment of country and site selection proposals, ensuring quality and consistency across regions and countries to support TT decision making; inform CSLs of resulting choices of regions/countries/sites**

* Design country start-up strategy in consultation with the Start-up Solutions Team and Country Start-up Specialists (CSS), and in alignment with the CTL(s) and CRO(s). Work closely with the CSS to oversee and ensure delivery at the site and country level
  

* Establish monitoring strategy, including management of identified risks, in collaboration with the CTL(s) and CRO(s) and incorporating principles of a risk-based quality management approach. Ensure monitoring strategy is updated in response to changes of external environment and/or availability of internal data
* Develop, implement and follow up on robust Site Oversight Plans, in collaboration with the CTL(s) and working closely with the respective CSLs

Identify and encourage use of data-driven oversight tools and methods at the site, study & program level  

  

**Local/Regional Studies and Early Access**

**Strategic Impact**

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**¿Todo listo para tu nueva aventura?**

En blue banana creemos firmemente que las personas son el centro de nuestro desarrollo como marca.

Por ello, nuestro objetivo es atraer el mejor talento para seguir creciendo en este proyecto sin límites, donde trabajamos para empoderar a las nuevas generaciones a hacer de sus vidas una aventura. ¿Te identificas con nuestra pasión y propósito? Si es así, sigue leyendo y descubre cómo puedes ser parte de esta emocionante misión.

Buscamos un perfil senior en marketing, fuerte en capacidad analitica, interpretación de  
datos y orientación a negocio, que contribuya a la toma de decisiones del área y reporte  
directamente al Head of MKT.  
Una persona capaz de analizar datos, conectar estrategia, activación y resultados  
comerciales.

Tus contribuciones a blue banana serán excepcionales si logras desarrollar las siguientes funciones:

**Análisis de negocio y marketing**

  mejora y palancas de crecimiento.
* Proponer recomendaciones estratégicas basadas en datos, priorizando las

  analizando su contribución a las ventas, captación de clientes y recurrencia y la

* Preparar análisis, recomendaciones y propuestas estratégicas para apoyar la toma  
  de decisiones siguiendo el retail calendar y los hitos del mercado.
* Accionar planes de medios y campañas para adquisición de nuevas audiencias

* Diseñar y potenciar campañas de marketing de performance y afiliación para

  comunidad alineada con el brand equity.
* Dominio del uso de IA para aplicar a la toma de decisiones, transformación de ideas

* Ownership del presupuesto y objetivos del area de mkt
* Liderazgo para visibilizar el impacto de MKT.

* Ownership de presupuesto.

* Idiomas: español e inglés (hablado y escrito). Se valorarán otros idiomas, especialmente portugués.
* **Skills o competencias clave**:

* Capacidad de planificación y priorización.
* Capacidad de ejecución y seguimiento de KPIs.

title: Lead Producer | Fully Remote
description:
**What we are looking for:**

We are looking for a seasoned Lead Producer to lead the development of our new IP. This role will play a vital part in the successful delivery of a major new title. The ideal candidate will have experience at the highest levels of project leadership, building new IP, growing teams, and supporting the creative leaders in the realization of their vision.

**What we will do together:**

* Manage internal and external teams across multiple locations to meet production schedules and deliver the project to quality, time, and budget expectations.
* Support the Creative Director in the maintenance of a coherent creative vision throughout the entire development life cycle.
* Work closely with Producers to develop product budgets and schedules across the team.
* Partner with the VP of Product to ensure core development processes are adhered to with consistency.
* Mentor producers at all levels of the team, taking a keen interest in their growth and career development.
* Ensure that coherent goals are set for the team from milestone to milestone, and that they are understood and executed upon
* Coordinate and assist with focus testing, outsourcing and other external parties as required.

**What you will bring:**

* 10+ years in internal game development
* Experience building and leading teams across multiple locations.
* Experience building AAA Games
* Comfortable guiding and leading staff across both production and creative disciplines, ensuring there is a healthy level of push and pull.
* An excellent communicator and emotionally intelligent leader capable of rallying a team.
* A calm and stable voice capable of managing complex problems with a cool head.
* Ability to interface with all levels of the organization.
* Resourceful, self-motivated, and capable of acting autonomously.
* Capable of balancing production and creative needs in support of making informed decisions.
* Ability to identify and analyse risk while providing mitigation.

**Interested… a bit about Escape Velocity:**

Escape Velocity is a team of passionate, talented developers working at a studio that offers excellent benefits, on what we believe is a once-in-a-career project with a committed publisher. But that doesn't necessarily make us unique. What does make us special? We value the time, energy, and talent of our players and our colleagues. We want every hour spent developing and playing our games to be an incredibly rewarding and worthwhile use of your time. To that end, we are 'Fully Remote' and support team members nearly anywhere in the world. We prioritize honesty, even when that means sharing bad news. We strive to give everyone autonomy so they can determine how best to work and play, and we care more about what you bring to the game and studio than how many hours you're clocking. We're dedicated to building a culture of play, which not only makes us better game makers, but also strengthens the bonds between us all. Senior UX/UI Designer
description:
Terra’s Creative team is a tight-knit, collaborative group that thrives on solving diverse creative problems for our clients. We are seeking an experienced Senior UX/UI Designer with a strong portfolio, exceptional design skills, and a passion for creating intuitive, engaging, and visually compelling digital experiences.

This role is ideal for a designer with 5+ years of professional experience who is ready to take greater ownership of complex website projects, contribute to strategic design decisions, and help elevate the quality of work across the team.

As a Senior UX/UI Designer, you will independently lead the design execution of assigned projects, from initial concepts and wireframes through high-fidelity designs and developer handoff. You'll collaborate closely with creative leadership, project managers, developers, and other designers to deliver thoughtful, user-centered solutions that balance functionality, aesthetics, and client objectives.

You will also play an important role in maintaining high design standards, contributing to client presentations, and providing guidance and constructive feedback to fellow designers, without formal team management responsibilities.

Portfolio required for consideration.

### **Who You Are**

* You have 5+ years of professional experience in a UX/UI design role, ideally at an agency or in a fast-paced, client-focused environment, with a strong portfolio showcasing intuitive, visually compelling, and user-centered digital experiences.
* You are proactive, highly organized, and capable of independently managing complex design assignments, balancing multiple priorities, and meeting deadlines.
* You have strong communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to articulate design decisions and explain your creative rationale to internal stakeholders and clients.
* You have a proficient level of English and Spanish, both written and spoken.

* Design responsive, intuitive, and visually compelling websites and digital interfaces that balance usability, accessibility, visual storytelling, and business goals.

* Work closely with developers throughout implementation, providing clear design specifications, supporting handoffs, and resolving UX/UI challenges to ensure design quality and feasibility.
* Participate in and help guide internal design reviews and client presentations, communicating design concepts, rationale, and recommendations.
* Guide fellow designers through specific projects or design challenges, providing constructive feedback and helping maintain high standards of design quality and consistency.
* Proactively coordinate with project leads to manage timelines, communicate progress, identify potential challenges, and ensure deliverables meet project requirements and client expectations.

* Indefinite contract following a trial period of 6 months
