title: Senior eCommerce Content Strategist
description:
**About Us**  
Since 2003, Luzern eCommerce has been helping leading global brands grow their online business. We partner with brands including Panasonic, Reebok, Stokke, KIKO, Next, Twining's, Canon, Bondi Sands and Philips, helping them accelerate growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences across major marketplaces including Amazon and Zalando, branded webstores and social platforms.

Backed by significant investment, Luzern is an international, technology-led eCommerce business with anambitious growth strategy. Our AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels.  
As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development.

The Senior eCommerce Content Strategist owns content strategy and execution across Amazon and the wider commerce ecosystem for Luzern's enterprise brand clients. Amazon is the primary focus — listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related content — but the role is deliberately platform-agnostic in outlook, extending strategy and content guidance to other marketplaces, retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando,Otto) and D2C.

The role is audit-led: content strategy is built from a structured read of customer and platform signals — reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers put to AI assistants and platform agents — combined with a quality assessment of current content (using a framework such as IDQ or equivalent) against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. Strategy, messaging and content requirements follow from that evidence base, rather than from assumption.

A defining part of the role is thinking beyond traditional platform search: strategies must consider how content needs to be structured and prepared to be discovered and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g. Amazon's Rufus), alongside conventional marketplace and retailer search algorithms.

The role sits as the senior content specialist within a small delivery pod, working alongside an SEO Executive and Designers. It carries direct client-facing responsibility: estimating, briefing, managing feedback and contributing to proposals and is responsible for reviewing the pod's output before it reaches the client. It does not carry resourcing, project management or formal line management responsibility.

**Tasks**
---------

**What You’ll Be Doing**

**Content Audits & Quality Assessment**  

* Signal analysis: analyse customer reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers and AI agents put to platforms (e.g. Rufus prompts), to understand what content needs to do and where current content falls short.
* Quality benchmarking — review current platform content and score it against a content quality framework (e.g. IDQ or equivalent), benchmarking against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements.
* Findings to action — translate audit findings into a clear, prioritised view of content requirements that feeds directly into strategy.

**Content Strategy Development**  

* Amazon content ownership- develop and own content strategy and execution for listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related Amazon content, as the role's primary focus.
* Cross-platform extension — extend strategy and content recommendations to other marketplaces,retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C storefronts, adapting to each platform's content rules, algorithm and customer behaviour.
* Strategic framework - from audit findings, develop comms objectives, key messages and a messaging hierarchy for each client or category.
* Content requirements - define the content requirements, imagery and copy needed to deliverthe strategy, and the frameworks/guidelines the team and client can act on.
* Wireframes & mock-ups - develop A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups in collaborationwith the Designer, turning strategy into an executable creative direction.

**AI & Agentic Discoverability**  

* AI-ready content — build content strategies that account for how product and brand content is read, ranked and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g Rufus), alongside traditional search.
* Point of view — keep Luzern's thinking on AI/agentic discoverability current, and translate emerging platform and LLM behaviour into practical, sellable content recommendations.
* Alignment with SEO — partner with the SEO Executive so keyword and search strategy and content structure are aligned across traditional and AI-mediated discovery.

**Testing & Performance Monitoring**  

* A/B testing — recommend and run A/B tests (e.g. on A+ Content, Brand Store, imagery and messaging) to determine the most effective executional approach, rather than relying on opinion or precedent.
* Monitoring set-up - set up monitoring using Compass (or equivalent) to measure content effectiveness and implementation.
* Reporting on impact — track and report on content performance against strategy objectives, feeding learnings back into future audits and strategy.

**Creative Briefing & Review**  

* Strategic foundation - develop the strategy and messaging that underpins paid social, display and

marketplace advertising content.  

* Creative briefs - write and own briefs for Designers producing static and video ad assets, translating strategy into clear creative direction.
* Creative review - review creative output against the brief, brand guidelines and platform requirements before client delivery.

**Client Management**  

* Client-facing delivery - present content strategy, recommendations and audit findings directly to client stakeholders.
* Estimates & scoping - prepare estimates and scopes of work for content workstreams.
* Briefs — shape and write content and creative briefs in response to client requirements.
* Feedback management — manage client feedback through to resolution, balancing client expectations against strategy and platform best practice.
* Proposals — contribute to and help prepare proposals and pitch content for new and existing client business.

**Quality & Output Review**  

* Senior review — review the SEO Executive's and Designers' work before it is sent to the client, checking it against strategy, brand guidelines and platform requirements.
* Direction — give feedback and direction to keep output consistent and on-strategy.

**AI-Enabled Working**  

* AI as a working method — use AI tools proficiently for content and competitive audits, for generating recommendations, and for producing or accelerating creative and written content — not only as a subject of strategy.
* Continuous improvement — identify and recommend where AI tools can improve the speed or quality of content production and audit work across the team.

**Requirements**
----------------

**What You Bring to the Role**

* Proven experience in Amazon content strategy and execution (listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store, Amazon Posts), ideally within an agency or managed services environment.

* Working knowledge of content requirements across at least one other marketplace or major retailer platform (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C.

* Experience running content audits — analysing reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries and customer/AI-agent queries — and scoring content quality (e.g. IDQ or equivalent) against best-in-Class standards.

* Experience translating audit findings into content strategy: comms objectives, key messaging, messaging hierarchy, and content requirements for imagery and copy.

* Experience developing or briefing A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups, working closely with designers.

* Experience designing and running A/B tests to determine the most effective executional approach, and setting up performance monitoring (e.g. Amazon Compass or equivalent) to track results.

* Strong understanding of how AI assistants and platform shopping agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Rufus)surface and rank product content, and how content should be structured to support this.

* Confident, credible client-facing communicator — comfortable presenting strategy, leading feedback conversations, and owning estimates and proposals.

* Experience briefing creative teams for paid social/display advertising, across both static and video formats.

* Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI tools for research, auditing and content production, not just familiarity in principle.

* Strong copywriting and content editing skills, with a close eye for brand and platform compliance.

* Comfortable reviewing and giving constructive feedback on the work of SEO and design peers.

**Desirable**

* Experience across multiple international marketplaces or retail media platforms.

* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, to collaborate effectively with the SEO Executive.

* Experience contributing to new business pitches or proposals.

* Category experience relevant to Luzern's enterprise brand client base.

**Benefits**
------------

**What We Offer**  

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Hybrid Working Model
* Great working environment with a passionate, collaborative team
* Continuous learning & career development
* The opportunity to work with some of the world's leading brands across the most exciting marketplaces

We are committed to equal opportunities and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Youtube Strategist & Channel Manager
description:
**TheSoul Group** is a leading creator business platform positioned at the heart of the creator economy. Our original videos, animations, and editorial stories inspire audiences in **21 languages**, across **60 platforms** and **20 websites**.  
Together with our network of **talented creators**, we reach over **5 billion followers** and generate more than **100 billion monthly views** on social media.

As a global powerhouse in digital media, we drive viral success for creators and brands worldwide through a wide range of services, leveraging our expertise in content distribution, localization, and social media management. We’re the creators behind global phenomena such as **5-Minute Crafts** and **BrightSide**.

We’re a dynamic, remote-first global team, fostering award-winning creativity, a no-red-tape approach, and great vibes!  
  
TheSoul Group is launching the YouTube channel for an established TV series in the food and outdoor space, bringing its content to a new digital audience.

YouTube is the main stage, and **views and subscribers are the KPIs that matter most**. TikTok, Instagram and Facebook grow alongside it, both as channels in their own right and as a way to send viewers to YouTube.

As our **YouTube Strategist & Channel Manager**, you'll set the strategy and run the channel day to day. You read the data, decide what comes next, and work hand in hand with a dedicated editor so every new video builds on what performs.

**Strategy & data**

* Track channel performance weekly: views, subscribers, retention, CTR, traffic sources and returning viewers
* Turn insights into **clear, data-led briefs for the editor**: which topics and moments to use, which hooks to test, what length works best
* Find the formats and topics the audience responds to, and adjust the plan to match
* Lead the channel to **YouTube monetisation eligibility** and track progress against it

**Running the channel**

* Support the channel and account setup for a **US audience**; set up playlists, keywords and a standard for titles and descriptions
* Own the publishing calendar: **2 long-form videos and 14 Shorts a week** on YouTube, plus regular posting on TikTok, Instagram and Facebook
* Grow TikTok, Instagram and Facebook: adapt content per platform and test formats, posting times and captions
* Write titles, descriptions and captions; brief thumbnails and A/B test them every week
* Refresh underperforming videos with a new title, thumbnail or opening
* Spot trends early and bring relevant ideas into the plan
* Prepare cuts for client review and approval in Frame.io

**Community**

* Manage comments and messages across all platforms daily
* Build an engaged community and turn recurring questions and feedback into content ideas

  
**Requirements**  

* **3+ years growing YouTube channels hands-on**, both long-form and Shorts, with before-and-after numbers to show for it
* Strong analytics skills, and the ability to turn data into clear creative direction for an editor

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**What we're building**
=======================

We're empowering small teams with technology that makes it easier to market and grow businesses. Our current focus is to help consumer brands shift from "workflow automation" to "agent management" within their marketing operations. Shadow is the AI coordination layer — providing shared AI memory, centralized agent control, and model orchestration for marketing teams.

**Why join Shadow?**
====================

* **Product Ownership** You'll ship production code daily and help steer key product and technical decisions.
* **Shape the Engineering Culture** You'll influence how we work—tools, processes, standards, and hiring.
* **Work with Challenger Consumer Brands** Talk directly to customers (CEOs, CMOs, VP's) of fast-growing consumer brands—some doing $80M–$500M in revenue.

**The agency behind the product**
=================================

Shadow is built alongside Darkroom — a performance marketing agency that's been operating for 10 years, employs 100+ people, runs 100+ clients at a time, and has worked with over 1,000 consumer brands. The agency is both our proving ground and our first user, which means the data you build with is real marketing data at real volume from day one — not a synthetic demo.

**This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).**

**The role**
============

You’ll own features end-to-end at Shadow, from the first conversation with a user to the polished screen in production. You’ll design in Figma and in code, and ship it yourself.  
You’ll work forward-deployed. You’ll sit with the subject-matter experts who use Shadow every day, like media buyers, strategists and creatives, to learn how they actually work and where they get stuck. Then you’ll turn what you learn into features that fix it.  
You’ll also keep Shadow feeling like one product. As new features land, you’ll make sure every screen, from dashboards to agent conversations, follows the same system and meets the same bar.

**Core Tech & Tools**

* **Languages & Frameworks:** Python, Node.js, React (TypeScript)
* **Datastore:** PostgreSQL
* **Cloud & Infra:** Google Cloud Platform, Airflow, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes
* **ML/AI:** LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering

**What you'll do**
==================

* Own features end-to-end: find the problem, shape the solution, then design, build and ship it.
* Embed with subject-matter experts to learn their workflows and challenges firsthand.
* Turn what you learn into product: agent conversations, performance and creative dashboards, the marketing calendar, and whatever comes next.
* Own UI/UX consistency across the whole app. Keep the design system current in Figma and React, and hold every new screen to it.
* Sweat the details, including type, spacing, motion, loading and empty states.
* Prototype fast, in code, in Figma or with AI tools, and put ideas in front of experts within days.
* Invent interaction patterns for agentic work. That means streaming answers, showing the agent’s reasoning, approving changes before they touch a live ad account, and admitting when data is missing.
* Turn dense, multi-channel data into screens a marketer can read in seconds.
* Bring the new Shadow brand into the product, working with our brand partners.

**Must haves**
==============

* Shipped product UI you’re proud of, plus a portfolio or live work that shows both the design and the code.
* Strong React, TypeScript and CSS (Tailwind a plus). You can own a frontend codebase, not just individual components.
* Real visual and interaction design skill: typography, layout, color, motion and micro-interactions.
* Curiosity about how other people work. You can spend a day with a media buyer and come back with the real problem, not just a feature request.
* A systems mindset. You notice when two screens solve the same problem differently, and you fix it.
* Equal comfort in Figma and in your editor, and the judgment to know when to skip Figma.
* Taste for data-dense interfaces. Your dashboards, tables and charts stay calm under a lot of information.
* Daily use of AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code, with opinions on how AI products should feel.
* Comfort with ambiguity. You’d rather ship and learn than polish in private.
* Clear writing. You can explain the why behind a design to engineers, experts and non-designers.
* Most people who fit this have 5+ years across design and some experience with frontend engineering.

**Nice to haves**
=================

* Forward-deployed, solutions or customer-facing work, or research with expert users.
* You’ve built a design system that other engineers rely on.
* Data visualization work in D3, Visx, Recharts or hand-rolled SVG.
* Motion work, such as spring animation or Framer Motion.
* Experience with LLM APIs, streaming interfaces or agent products.
* Time spent around marketing, ecommerce or analytics tools, or running ads yourself.

**What we offer**
=================

* **Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every employee exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
-------------------------------

We are an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
Head of Marketing

Town Web · HeyGov  
Remote · Full-time contractor

**The Quick Version**

Have you ever seen a company create their own National Holiday as part of its marketing efforts?

We did!

Speaking of silly stuff, we even wrote and produced our own comedic commercial about the real pains that our customers have, and it helped make one of our tools the fastest growing AI tool in the industry!

Ultimately we want our marketing to be funny, human, and memorable, because honestly a lot of the stuff out there in the government industry (which is where we compete) is boring.

Now we're looking for someone exceptionally creative to lead our marketing department — a person with the freedom to take big creative swings and the resources to execute their own.

Our brands — Town Web, HeyGov, and ClerkMinutes — form a suite of tools built specifically for municipal clerks, and each one is crafted to be exceptional at its job. If you're a highly effective, exceptional marketing professional, we'd love for you to apply. Below are more details about who we are and what we're trying to achieve.

Here's a video to tell you more about this role!

**The details**

Who we are

We're a small, bootstrapped company approaching $3M in ARR, competing against large, private-equity-owned firms with far deeper pockets. That's why our marketing has to be exceptional on two fronts at once: creative work that is unique and memorable, and follow-through to match it — multi-channel campaigns, disciplined measurement, and sophisticated execution that turns attention into pipeline.

Our customers are municipal clerks at cities, counties, and municipalities of all sizes. They are busy, under-resourced, deeply practical, and they talk to each other (which as you can guess is why we are emphasising the need to have exceptional marketing!)

We build focused products for the clerk specifically, designed to work together as a suite. ClerkMinutes became one of the most widely adopted tools in its category largely on the strength of marketing that looked like nothing else in this space, and your job is to push that further across the whole portfolio. We run on EOS, and the marketing department's cadence — L10s, quarterly Rocks, scorecards — will be yours to run.

What you'll own

* Strategy and positioning across the portfolio, and the department's EOS operating cadence
* Demand and revenue — building a qualified pipeline for Sales through targeted campaigns and similar initiatives. This is how success is measured.
* Full-channel execution — conferences, webinars, direct mail, PR, and outbound alongside digital and paid. Clerks trust people who show up in person, so you will too.
* Lifecycle marketing — from first touch through trial to customer, along with the tech, tracking, and attribution behind it
* The quality bar — you're the final day-to-day reviewer on copy, design, campaigns, and launches
* Go-to-market with Product and Sales — new product launches and targeted campaigns that get us early beta testers, help build awareness for product pilots, and than formal product releases.

Who does well here

Isn’t it clear we’re looking for somebody extremely creative and ambitious!? Are you “THE ONE?”

We’re looking for a creative strategist and an enthusiastic builder who can lead the team from the front line. Think of a special-forces team leader: they plan the mission, and when it's time to move, they're also the first one through the door. That's the posture this role needs — you set the strategy, and then you're in the weeds executing it right alongside the team.

And there is a team. You'll work directly with our copywriters, internal product managers, the sales team, and the people who handle data connection and attribution through Salesforce and our other marketing tools. You'll have a team around you, but want to be clear: we’re not looking for a “manager of managers”.

AI tools like Claude or Codex are part of your daily workflow, and you rely on them to get competent quickly in unfamiliar territory, whether that's GEO, GA4, or something we haven't thought of yet. You also know how to work with a highly creative founder: turning a lot of ideas into focused priorities, pushing back when something won't work, and making sure the good ones actually ship.

This role suits someone who's comfortable working without a finished playbook, and who would rather be in the work than above it.

What we need to see

* Exceptional Enthusiasm
* Extremely Creative Energy
* You've led a marketing function and been accountable for its results
* You've made a traditional or crowded category stand out with ideas of your own
* AI is central to how you work, and you're comfortable enough with code to build or fix small things yourself
* Real paid acquisition experience across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and Bing, and you can run SEO and GEO by directing AI tools well
* Hands-on experience with direct mail, paid ads, conferences, PR, or other high-attention channels, and you're happy traveling to meet clerks and work conferences alongside Sales
* B2B SaaS background, and you've managed employees, contractors, and agencies

Nice to have: GovTech or public-sector experience, marketing more than one product at a time, and building measurement where little existed. EOS familiarity helps too!

How to apply

* Complete the Workable Form, and make sure to include your resume.
* There will questions to answer. Please make sure you answer them- we read these!

  
**Requirements**  
  
**IMPORTANT**

* Only applications submitted through the proper channel, which is Workable, will be processed.
* Taking the CultureIndex Survey is a requirement, we will not respond to any applications submitted without this.

title: Marketing Manager - Global
description:
**About Hub OS**

Hub OS is transforming how hotels operate. We're not just another communication tool. We're a complete operations system that manages everything from housekeeping and maintenance to guest requests and interdepartmental workflows, all in one platform.

Since 2015, we've helped 2,000 properties across 80 countries deliver great guest experiences with maximum efficiency. Our clients include iconic brands like Accor, IHG, Minor Hotels, Hesperia World and Eurostars Hotels, among others.

With headquarters near Barcelona and teams in the US, Australia, Japan, Singapore, Thailand and UAE, we're a truly global company with a collaborative culture.

Ready to shape the future of hotel operations? Join us!

**About the role**

Marketing is one of the best ways for us to grow, and we want to build it the right way. That's why we're looking for a Marketing Manager. Reporting to the VP of Growth, you'll own marketing end to end: strategy, brand, demand generation, content, customer stories, sales materials and events.

Our goal is simple. We want more hotels to know us, trust us and ask for a demo. You'll be responsible for building our brand and our visibility, turning that into inbound leads, and giving our Sales team the stories and materials that help them close deals faster.

This is a hands-on role. You'll define the strategy, and you'll also create, publish and measure the work yourself, using AI tools to move fast. You'll be our first dedicated marketing lead with a global scope, with a clear path to lead a team as the company grows.

You'll play a critical role in shaping how the hotel industry sees Hub OS.

**Your mission:**

Marketing Strategy & Brand

* Define and own the annual marketing plan, with clear goals, budget and calendar
* Define our ideal customer profiles, value proposition and positioning against competitors
* Build key messages for each type of customer and market
* Define our narrative style and tone of voice across all channels
* Own the brand guidelines and templates, so the whole company communicates in a consistent way
* Decide what we do in English and what we adapt to other languages and markets
* Follow what our competitors say and do, and share it with Sales and Product

Demand Generation & Visibility

* Own our website: landing pages, the path to "Book a demo" and continuous conversion improvement
* Lead our SEO strategy and our visibility in AI tools, so we are found and recommended when buyers search
* Own our presence on review and reputation sites such as HotelTechReport, G2 and Trustpilot, including a steady flow of new customer reviews
* Lead our LinkedIn strategy and company page
* Run email marketing and nurturing for leads who are not ready to buy yet
* Use paid channels in a focused way when they help amplify what already works
* Plan co-marketing activities with our technology and referral partners
* Organize our own webinars and online events when they make sense

Content Creation

* Create and run our blog, with a clear editorial line and a regular publishing rhythm
* Write white papers, guides and thought leadership content
* Create LinkedIn posts that get attention and move readers to act
* Produce our quarterly newsletter: product news, new features, partner and integration updates, spotlights on lesser-used modules and hotelier interviews
* Make sure every piece of content has a clear goal and a clear next step for the reader

Customer Stories & Sales Enablement

* Lead our customer success stories from start to finish: choose the hotel with Sales and Customer teams, contact the hotelier, run the interview, collect the data and write and design the story
* Collect testimonials and video quotes from happy customers
* Create and keep up to date the materials Sales uses in demos, events and meetings, such as decks, one-pagers and product sheets
* Work with Sales to understand what helps them win deals and shorten the sales cycle

Product Content & Adoption

* Review, edit and publish content for our Help Center, which is hosted in HubSpot. The Quality team owns the accuracy of the content, and you own the quality of the writing and the publishing
* Create content that explains the benefits of each module and feature, and how to set them up
* Produce product videos, including editing and AI voice-over
* Create campaigns and materials that help customers adopt modules they do not use yet, supporting upsell

Events & Trade Shows

* Be the owner of our trade shows and events from a marketing point of view, including the results
* Manage the relationship with event organizers: registration, event portal content and sponsorship options
* Own the stand design, merchandising, team outfits, catering needs and event materials
* Prepare pre-event meetings and outreach with the Sales team
* Measure the ROI of every event and recommend if we should continue or not
* Work closely with the Partnerships & Events Manager, who leads the production and logistics of each event

Data, HubSpot & Reporting

* Own the marketing setup in HubSpot: forms, workflows, email, lists, dashboards and attribution
* Define with Sales and RevOps what a qualified lead is, how leads are scored and how they are handed over
* Track and report on awareness (traffic, brand searches, LinkedIn growth, AI visibility), lead generation (inbound leads, demo requests, conversion by channel) and sales impact (content usage, customer stories, reviews, sales cycle)
* Find where visitors and leads drop off, and use data to decide what to do next
* Share clear reports with leadership: what works, what does not and what to change

Budget, Vendors & Tools

* Manage the marketing budget
* Choose and manage freelancers and agencies for specific projects, only when the impact is clear
* Own our marketing tools and AI stack, and keep looking for better ways to work

Cross-functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Quality, Product, RevOps and Partnerships & Events
* Align with regional teams across different time zones

**Required qualifications:**

* Proven experience in B2B marketing, ideally in SaaS or hospitality tech
* Experience building and running demand generation, from strategy to results
* Excellent writing skills in English, with the ability to create content that is clear, interesting and persuasive
* Hands-on experience with SEO and website optimization
* Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM and marketing automation tool
* Analytical mindset: comfortable with data, KPIs, attribution and reporting
* Daily use of AI tools for content, design, video and productivity
* Experience with LinkedIn as a B2B channel
* Basic design skills to create presentations, one-pagers and visuals with tools like Canva or Figma
* Experience with trade shows or events is a strong plus
* Fluent in English (written and spoken). Additional languages are a plus
* Organized and able to manage many projects at once

**You'll thrive in this role if you…**

* Are ambitious and see this role as a big step in your career
* Enjoy being both the strategist and the one who gets things done
* Love telling a good story and turning it into real business results
* Make decisions with data, and are not afraid to test, learn and change direction
* Are curious about new tools and always looking for smarter ways to work with AI
* Enjoy talking to customers and learning what makes them successful
* Are proactive and take action without waiting to be asked
* Enjoy collaborating across teams, regions and time zones
* Value autonomy and ownership, and enjoy the freedom to prioritize
* Would like to grow into a leadership role and build a team in the future

**What's waiting for you?**

### **Why apply?**

At Neo4j GraphAware, we help organisations make sense of complex data to uncover hidden relationships, investigate risk, and make better decisions. Our solutions support customers tackling some of the most demanding challenges in financial crime, intelligence analysis, and other mission-critical environments.

Following GraphAware's acquisition by Neo4j, we're entering an exciting new phase of growth. Combining GraphAware's specialist technology and industry expertise with Neo4j's global reach creates a significant opportunity to bring our solutions to new customers and markets.

We're looking for a **Solutions Marketing Manager** to help shape how we position, communicate, and bring these solutions to market.

### **Your mission**

As Solutions Marketing Manager, you'll be responsible for understanding our customers, markets, and technology, and turning that knowledge into compelling positioning, messaging, and sales enablement assets that help us win business.

This is a product marketing role focused on **industry solutions rather than individual products**. Your initial focus will be on our Financial Crime Intelligence solution, helping financial institutions detect complex risks and investigate financial crime. Over time, you'll have the opportunity to work across other solutions, industries, and customer segments.

You'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, whether that's developing a new value proposition, equipping sellers for customer conversations, or shaping the messaging for a go-to-market campaign.

#### **Key responsibilities:**

* **Customer and market understanding:** Develop an understanding of our target industries, customers, and use cases. Research customer challenges, industry trends, and buying behaviours to identify target segments, develop ideal customer profiles and buyer personas, and inform our go-to-market strategy.
* **Positioning and messaging:** Own the positioning and messaging for our solutions, translating complex technical capabilities into clear customer value propositions. Develop messaging frameworks, use-case narratives, proof points, and persona-specific messaging, ensuring consistency across sales materials, campaigns, web pages, and other customer touchpoints.
* **Sales enablement:** Equip our sales teams with the knowledge and assets they need to identify opportunities, engage prospects, and win business. Develop pitch decks, solution overviews, discovery and qualification guides, objection handling, competitive battlecards, and demo narratives.

* **Curiosity, adaptability, and continuous improvement:** You enjoy learning about unfamiliar industries, getting to grips with new technologies, and finding better ways of working. You're confident experimenting with AI tools and automation to improve your productivity and the effectiveness of the wider team.
* **Strategic thinking with hands-on execution:** You're comfortable thinking about the bigger picture, but equally happy rolling up your sleeves to create a pitch deck, refine a message, or solve a practical problem.

description:
**Moon Active**, a leading global mobile game developer entertaining millions worldwide, is seeking a highly skilled and creative **Generative Content Creator** to join the in-house video creative team of our Marketing Art Studio.

In this role, you will own video ad creatives end to end, from brief to delivery, across our portfolio: Coin Master, Travel Town, Reality Bay, Family Bay and more. You will create everything from scroll-stopping hooks and gameplay mechanics to rich narrative storytelling ads, at the pace and volume performance marketing demands.

You will direct generative tools (such as **Seedance, Kling, Veo, Nano Banana 2, ChatGPT Image 2, ComfyUI, Suno, ElevenLabs**, and others) alongside **After Effects and Photoshop**, combining the speed of AI with the storytelling fundamentals that make a shot work.

Apply today if you are passionate about video, storytelling, gaming and cutting-edge tech!

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own Video Ads End to End: Take a brief and run it on your own, from concept, art and AI generation through sound, edit and delivery, across gameplay-driven ads, story-driven narratives, scroll-stopping hooks and reskins.
* Learn What Wins: Study our ads' performance data alongside market trends and competitor creatives, and turn those insights into stronger hooks, angles and fresh ideas for every brief.
* Maintain Brand Consistency: Ensure all AI-generated output strictly adheres to each game's visual style guide, character roster, quality standards, brand identity and IP/copyright guidelines.
* Stay Ahead of AI Advancements: Research, test and bring emerging image, video and audio models to the team to continuously speed up our creative workflows.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Hands-On Video Production Experience: 3+ years of practical, professional work making video: shooting, animating, designing motion, building 3D or editing real productions from start to finish.
* Expertise in Generative Video and Image: Hands-on experience with platforms like Seedance, Kling, Veo, Runway, Nano Banana 2 and ChatGPT Image 2, or similar. You translate film fundamentals (shot types, lenses, camera moves, lighting and action beats) into precise AI generations.
* Adobe Finishing Skills: Strong command of After Effects for basic compositing, stitching shots, quick fixes, layers, masking, tracking and color; Premiere for timeline and editing work; and Photoshop for art and image work.
* Strong Creative Fundamentals: A deep feel for story, timing and emotion, and a solid grasp of color, composition, lighting and anatomy to spot and fix imperfections in AI outputs.
* Adaptive, Independent Mindset: A dynamic, out-of-the-box problem solver who adapts quickly as tools evolve, runs their work without waiting to be told and hits deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Ownership and Team Communication: Takes personal responsibility for every deliverable, raises issues early, and communicates clearly and openly with teammates, Leads and Creative Producers.

**Advantages**
--------------

* Node-Based AI Pipelines: Experience building custom pipelines in ComfyUI for precision that presets can't give.
* Building Your Own Tools: Familiarity with Claude Code, Cursor or basic scripting (Python, JavaScript, ExtendScript) to automate pipelines and speed up production.
* 3D Software and AI Integration: Familiarity with Blender, Cinema 4D or Maya, and incorporating 3D assets into AI pipelines.
* Game UI and Gameplay Motion: Ability to create mock gameplay, game UI and interactive mechanics using a mix of AI generation and After Effects motion graphics.
* Performance Marketing Experience: A background in UA video ads or marketing creatives for mobile games.

title: Technical Owner
description:
**TripleTen** is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As a Technical Owner you’ll own every technical decision behind our programs, from the first conversation with a course author to the bug that never reaches a learner. This is a technical partner role, not a coding job: you weigh each decision against cost, time to learner, and bugs shipped, and you lead one engineer who writes autotests. The role is fully remote and full-time, for candidates based outside the US.

  
Requirements:  
  

**Must have**

* **End-to-end technical ownership.** 3+ years in engineering, QA automation, or technical operations, including choosing a product’s setup and living with the trade-off after launch.
* **Solid mid-level coding.** Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, Git, CI, containers, and REST APIs: enough to read unfamiliar code, fix bugs, and write autotests.
* **English for requirements work.** Strong enough to run requirements sessions and write specs engineering teams accept without a round of questions.

**Nice to have**

* **Leading engineers.** Leading or mentoring at least one engineer, ideally in test automation.
* **EdTech and content validation.** LMS or autograded courses, QA or release work, or agents that check content for accuracy and freshness.
* **Automation and data stack.** Claude Code, MCP, n8n or Make; SQL and dashboards.

  
Brand:
  
TripleTen  
  
What you will do:
  

* **Own each program’s technical setup.** Know its environments, services, providers, and autotests, and keep a written map of what each program depends on.
* **Shape new and updated programs.** Collect requirements from authors and constraints from product, test the options, and land on a workable trade-off.
* **Replace what no longer fits.** Find, cost, and run the switch when a tool, provider, or setup is outdated or too expensive.
* **Manage providers.** Compare offers, negotiate terms, and own integrations with external providers.
* **Lead autotest coverage.** Set coverage and priorities for the autotest engineer, and write or fix tests yourself when needed.
* **Be our customer to engineering.** Write specs with acceptance criteria for automation, API, and platform needs, and chase each one to done.
* **Cut bugs reaching learners.** Trace each bug to where it entered, close the gap with a test, check, or process change, and track the trend.

  
What we can offer you:
  

* **Ownership.** Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.
* **Remote and flexible.** Fully remote collaboration
* **Digital office.** Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

title: Product Engineering Lead, Keet (100% Remote, Worldwide)
description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We're taking Keet to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up at global scale.

You lead the teams that build Keet's features: the API team, which adds feature-focused APIs to Keet's core, and the frontend team, which builds the React app on top, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product.

You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for distributed, local-first systems, so you can work fluently on top of a P2P engine without needing to build it yourself.

### **Responsabilities**

### **Engineering**

* Run the API and frontend teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.
* Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.
* Own the technical design of features and the API surface between Keet's core and the app.
* Make sure the API team works closely with our deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches the engine.

### **Product Partnership**

* Work alongside Keet's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.
* Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.
* Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially where P2P opens doors that centralized apps can't.
* Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

### **Leadership**

* Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.
* Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.
* Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

* Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally in chat, calling, or social apps.
* Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.
* Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. Offline-first and eventual consistency should feel natural. You don't need P2P protocol expertise, because our core abstracts it away.
* Deep JavaScript and React.
* Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.
* Bonus: experience with local-first apps, CRDTs or sync engines, offline-capable mobile or desktop apps, or open source.

* Good testing discipline across application, data and AI components
* Experience with CI/CD, containerisation and cloud infrastructure, ideally Microsoft Azure

* Demonstrated experience delivering AI-enabled systems beyond isolated proofs of concept
* Proven ability to ship iterative, user-focused solutions with appropriate attention to reliability and safety

**Job Description**

As an AI Value Architect for LASER, you will own the Day-2 value, adoption and expansion lifecycle for a portfolio of strategic HPE Private Cloud AI customers. You will act as a trusted **technical advisor** and AI value partner after initial deployment, helping customers turn early onboarding outcomes into broader internal adoption, stronger champions, clearer AI roadmaps and measurable business impact. You will be GEO-aligned and customer-present while operating as part of a globally coordinated team. This is a customer-facing technical sales role, not a delivery or consulting role: you will help customers understand what is possible with Private Cloud AI, review progress against their roadmap, uncover blockers, identify new internal use cases and champions, and work closely with Sales, Pre-Sales, Forward Deployed Engineering, Product and Support to turn validated needs into clear next steps.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

**Continuous Value Creation**
-----------------------------

* Own a portfolio of strategic Private Cloud AI customers beyond initial onboarding and drive continued internal adoption, value realization and expansion of Private Cloud AI across business units.
* Discover and shape new AI, GenAI and agentic AI use cases across business units, moving customers from initial workloads to broader production adoption.
* Provide architecture guidance for new workloads across inference, RAG, AI agents, model serving, fine-tuning, data pipelines, observability, governance and security.
* Evangelize Private Cloud AI inside the customer organization by enabling technical and business champions, sharing relevant roadmap updates, and helping teams understand where Private Cloud AI can support their next AI initiatives.

**Structured Adoption Cadence**
-------------------------------

* Establish a programmatic customer cadence with quarterly value, adoption and roadmap reviews involving customer stakeholders and relevant HPE account teams.
* Run outcome-focused business and technical reviews that ask practical adoption questions: what was achieved since onboarding, how much of the roadmap has progressed, where the customer is stuck, what blockers exist, and what technical or commercial actions are needed next.
* Plan and lead regular onsite engagements at strategic customers; travel frequently within LASER as a core part of the role and selectively worldwide.
* Maintain clear account plans, actions, risks, value hypotheses and expansion signals across the portfolio.

**Expansion & Proof**
---------------------

* **Identify**, **qualify** and **technically shape** expansion opportunities by recognizing where customers need additional Private Cloud AI capacity, new capabilities, platform expansion or related services to execute their AI roadmap.
* Run targeted roadmap, architecture, scaling and adoption workshops when expansion triggers emerge, focused on clarifying the customer’s next AI priorities and required Private Cloud AI capabilities.

* Partner with local Sales, Pre-Sales and Partners through opportunity progression while remaining a trusted **technical and commercial advisor** who is comfortable discussing investment needs, expansion options and customer outcomes.

**Build the Global Playbook**
-----------------------------

* Design customer workshops, discovery guides, assessment tools, reference architectures and proof patterns that can be reused across customer sites and GEOs.
* Create the operating model, templates, metrics and governance for a new global AI value and expansion motion.
* Capture field learnings, customer roadmap signals, adoption blockers and expansion patterns, feed them back to Product and global teams, and continuously improve the playbook.
* Operate effectively in a build-from-scratch, startup-style environment with high ownership, ambiguity and pace.

* Expansion creation: qualified, sales-accepted opportunities for additional Private Cloud AI systems and related services.
* Program scale: reusable workshops, assets and operating practices adopted across the global team.
* Customer trust: sustained executive and practitioner engagement with strategic accounts.
* Customer value: additional use cases activated, stronger internal champions, measurable roadmap progress, broader adoption across business units, stronger customer self-sufficiency and increased platform utilization.

**What You Need to Bring**

**Technical & AI Expertise**
----------------------------

* Strong hands-on knowledge of enterprise AI and GenAI architectures, including LLM inference, RAG, vector databases, AI agents, model endpoints, evaluation, guardrails and LLMOps/MLOps.
* Familiarity and first experiences with agent harness such as OpenClaw, NemoClaw, Hermes and OpenCode.
* Experience designing or implementing production AI solutions using Python, Linux, containers, Kubernetes, Helm, APIs, identity and access controls, and object/file storage.
* Knowledge of data engineering and ML platforms such as Airflow, Kubeflow, MLflow, Ray, model serving frameworks and observability tooling.
* Working knowledge around GPUs, Power Cooling and Networking.
* Ability to reason end-to-end - from customer outcome and data readiness through application architecture, platform sizing, security, operations and scale.
* Experience with NVIDIA AI Enterprise technologies, HPE Private Cloud AI, or comparable enterprise AI platforms is strongly preferred.

**Customer & Commercial Skills**
--------------------------------

* Demonstrated success in a customer-facing technical sales or advisory role such as AI Solutions Architect, Value Architect, Pre-Sales Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Customer Engineer or Field CTO-style role.
* Ability to translate complex AI technology into business value, facilitate workshops with technical and executive stakeholders, and influence without direct authority.
* Strong **commercial curiosity and judgment**: able to recognize expansion signals, ask direct investment-oriented questions, build a credible technical value case and collaborate with Sales without compromising trusted-advisor status.
* Strong program and account management skills across multiple strategic customers, with disciplined follow-through and concise executive communication.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional Spanish and Portugese are an advantage.

**Ways of Working**
-------------------

* Builder mentality: comfortable creating a new motion, assets and processes rather than inheriting a mature playbook.
* High ownership, bias for action and comfort operating in ambiguity.
* Collaborative and low-ego, with the ability to work across GEO and global teams.
* Willingness and ability to travel frequently for onsite customer engagements across LASER, with occasional international travel.

**Accessibility**

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

title: AI Product Manager
description:
**Tu misión:** comprimir la distancia entre idea y realidad validada. Tienes la autonomía y las herramientas —IA, automatización, entornos low-code— para construir tú mismo lo que quieres explorar, ponerlo delante de usuarios reales e iterar rápido, dejando el terreno preparado para que el squad continúe con las preguntas difíciles ya respondidas.

Para eso, necesitas algo más que soltura técnica: entender de verdad el dominio —contabilidad, fiscalidad, nóminas— para saber qué merece la pena construir y por qué.

Eres quien convierte un "creemos que esto puede funcionar" en un "sabemos que funciona, aquí está la prueba".

**Lo que ofrecemos**

* Salario: 50 – 60K + Variable
* Ubicación: Madrid, modelo híbrido (varios días en oficina, resto flexible/remoto)
* Beneficios flexibles para el día a día
* Presupuesto de formación dedicado y revisiones periódicas de desempeño
* Herramientas AI-first, plataformas de automatización, entornos low-code y hardware de última generación

**Perfil que encaja**

* Tienes experiencia real construyendo: software funcional, automatizaciones o workflows con IA que gente real ha usado.
* Te manejas con soltura en Cursor, Claude u otros asistentes de IA para código, n8n, Zapier o similares.
* Sabes estructurar problemas ambiguos, priorizar con claridad y traer orden al caos.
* Tienes buen criterio de producto con sesgo hacia la validación: priorizas aprender por encima de la perfección.
* Entiendes bien al usuario y tienes buen instinto de UX, tanto para nuevos usuarios como para power users.
* Actúas con ownership y sesgo hacia la acción: construyes lo necesario para responder preguntas con autonomía.
* Sabes calibrar el nivel de esfuerzo justo: cuándo ir rápido para aprender y cuándo elevar la calidad.
* Influyes sin autoridad formal: alineas a ingeniería, diseño y datos a través de claridad y confianza.
* Tienes buena intuición de datos para interpretar señales de prototipos y experimentos.

**Requisitos imprescindibles**

* Experiencia demostrable construyendo productos, automatizaciones o workflows con IA usados por personas reales.
* Soltura con herramientas modernas de creación: Cursor, Claude/asistentes de IA para código, n8n, Zapier o similares.
* Capacidad probada de trabajar en entornos ambiguos y con alta autonomía.

**Adicionalmente, valoramos**

* Experiencia diseñando o analizando experimentos A/B, con criterio para elegir la herramienta de validación más adecuada en cada caso.
* Experiencia en entornos early-stage o entrepreneuriales, con capacidad de moverte entre múltiples áreas a la vez.

**Tu día a día**

* **Construir y validar rápido:** levantas prototipos funcionales y workflows con IA —automatizaciones de contabilidad, fiscalidad, herramientas internas— y los pruebas tú mismo desde el primer momento.
* **Poner todo delante de usuarios reales:** ejecutas tests ligeros con asesores y clientes, recoges feedback e iteras hasta tener evidencia sólida de que algo funciona.
* **Preparar el terreno para el squad:** defines qué señales o resultados demuestran éxito, y documentas los aprendizajes para que el equipo construya sobre una base ya validada.
* **Multiplicar al equipo:** compartes herramientas, patrones y formas de trabajar que ayudan a todos a construir y validar más rápido.

description:
**Barcelona / Hybrid**  
**Tendios**

At Tendios, we are building the intelligence layer for public procurement. Our platform helps companies identify and win public tenders, while helping public institutions improve procurement processes and tender management.

Tendios is at a turning point. Over the next three years we have the opportunity to grow from a local Catalan player into a global company, multiplying our revenue, our team and our customer base across many new countries. Events are where we meet our customers, build our brand and generate demand across the public procurement ecosystem. That is why field marketing is a key area at Tendios.

We are looking for an outstanding Senior Field Marketing Manager who will own our events strategy end to end, in Spain and internationally, and become one of the public faces of Tendios.

You will join the Marketing team, reporting directly to the Global Head of Marketing. This is an autonomous, high-ownership role at the intersection of brand, demand generation and public-sector relationships.

### **Your Mission**

Turn Tendios' events into a growth engine: build brand awareness, generate qualified pipeline and position Tendios as the reference in AI for public procurement, in Spain and in every new market we enter.

This role is not only about organising events. It is about owning the stage: designing memorable experiences, taking the microphone and building the relationships that open doors for Tendios.

### **Responsibilities**

**Events strategy and end-to-end management**

* Define and own the annual events calendar for Spain and international markets
* Manage every event end to end: concept, budget, organisers, vendors, logistics, stand production, onsite execution and follow-up
* Design and run Tendios' own events, from breakfasts and workshops to flagship forums
* Lead Tendios' event presence in new international markets

**Public speaking and brand representation**

* Act as a Tendios spokesperson: present, moderate panels and host our own events
* Identify and secure speaking slots and event sponsorships at key sector gatherings
* Represent Tendios in front of public-sector buyers, suppliers and the media

**Webinars**

* Own Tendios' webinar programme end to end: strategy, calendar, topics, speakers, promotion, delivery and lead follow-up
* Use webinars to reach new audiences in Spain and international markets
* Measure the impact of each webinar on registrations, attendance, leads and pipeline

**Strategic relationships for field**

* Manage relationships with event organisers, public entities, associations, chambers of commerce and speakers
* Turn these relationships into speaking opportunities, co-hosted events and webinars

**Internal collaboration**

* Work closely with Sales, Customer Success and Product so that every event serves commercial goals
* Equip the Sales team with the materials and plans they need before, during and after each event

### **Requirements**

We are looking for someone excellent, detail-oriented and passionate about events. Someone who feels at home both behind the scenes and on stage.

#### **Experience**

* 8+ years in event management, ideally in B2B or B2G
* Proven end-to-end management of events and webinars, in Spain and internationally
* Experience in public procurement: you understand how public tenders work and how the public sector buys
* Proven experience in public speaking.

SaaS, tech or GovTech experience is a strong plus.

#### **Skills**

* Excellent communication skills, written and spoken
* Great attention to detail: every event reflects the quality of our brand
* Autonomy and ownership: you set priorities, make decisions and deliver results
* Strong relationship-building skills
* Budget and vendor management
* Experience with HubSpot or similar CRM and event management tools

AI as a productivity ally

* You use AI tools in your day-to-day work to plan, create content, analyse results and work faster and better

#### **Languages**

* Spanish, English and Catalan: mandatory
* Portuguese, French and/or Italian: highly valued

Availability to travel 30–40%, including international travel.

**Success in this role will be measured by the impact of field marketing on business metrics and revenue funnel, as well as, brand.**

* **Pipeline generation:** leads, SQLs and pipeline generated or influenced by events and webinars
* **Revenue impact:** closed-won deals and revenue influenced by field activities
* **Brand presence:** speaking slots, sector visibility and Tendios' positioning at key events
* **Efficiency:** cost per lead and ROI for each event and webinar

#### **What we offer**

* Permanent contract with competitive salary + variable, reviewed every 6 months
* Flexible schedule and hybrid work (minimum 1 office day per week)
* 24 working days off + your birthday + 1 additional day
* A senior role leading a key area, with real influence on our international expansion
* Bright office in central Barcelona
* Growth-mindset culture, autonomy and a toxicity-free environment
* Immediate start

#### **Why join Tendios**

Tendios is at the beginning of its international journey, and field marketing will be decisive in it. Your mission will be to make Tendios the name everyone remembers at every public procurement event, in Spain and beyond. If you love events, feel at home on stage and want to help build a global company, we want to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
At Cirql One, we are building the **foundational layer** that connects enterprise data to AI: a layer that doesn’t just relay information, but genuinely understands it, making **business meaning** explicit, trusted, and actionable at scale.

The problem we’re solving is deceptively hard. SAP runs the core operations of **most of the world’s largest companies**. The data is reliable. The meaning, however, is buried inside 30 years of configurations, customizations, and undocumented logic that no AI system can interpret on its own. We’ve spent decades inside these environments. We know the problem intimately, and we’ve built our company around a single conviction: before AI can truly scale inside the enterprise, **business meaning must be made explicit.**

Cirql One is that missing link: an **enterprise semantic intelligence layer** that gives AI models and agents a shared, business-accurate understanding of enterprise data. Our vision is to become the **system of reason** sitting above SAP, where intelligence, metrics, and AI automation are defined, governed, and executed.

As our product designer, you'll own design across the platform and define how enterprise intelligence becomes legible: shaping the interfaces through which humans and AI navigate business meaning together, from the ground floor, alongside a team that takes both craft and mission seriously. That is our promise.

**Tasks**
---------

* **Own the UI layer.** Define how semantic models, metrics, governance rules, and data lineage are represented, versioned, and navigated in the platform.
* **Own the design foundations.** Build and maintain our design system, visual language, and component library, and keep design and code in sync with engineering.
* **Translate complexity.** Turn ambiguous requirements into scalable interaction patterns that work for data engineers and business stakeholders alike.
* **Ship end-to-end.** Work directly with engineering and product from early concept to shipped product. No handoffs.
* **Design for AI.** Build interfaces where humans and AI think together: natural language exploration, structured reasoning, governed outputs.
* **Research and synthesize.** Conduct user research and usability testing with enterprise customers; translate findings into design decisions with clear rationale.
* **Defend your decisions.** Articulate design rationale confidently across technical and non-technical contexts: founders, engineers, and customers.

**Requirements**
----------------

* **Enterprise design depth.** 7+ years of product design experience, including 4+ years on complex B2B software: data platforms, developer tools, or analytics applications.
* **Systems thinker.** Able to design coherent patterns at scale, hold a large design vision, and break it into shippable pieces without losing the thread.
* **Self-directed.** Comfortable as the sole designer: setting your own priorities, making calls without a design team to lean on, and actively seeking critique from engineers, product, and customers.
* **Strong portfolio.** End-to-end process from research and problem framing to interaction design and high-fidelity execution, on genuinely hard problems.
* **AI-first by default.** Comfortable prototyping with AI tools and in code (we use Claude Code heavily); experienced building interfaces where humans and AI collaborate on complex tasks.
* **Collaborative partner.** Direct track record of working with engineering through the build cycle, not as a handoff, and making the people around you better.
* **Clear communicator.** Articulates design rationale precisely to engineers and non-technical stakeholders; invites feedback and adapts without losing direction.

Strong plus:

* Background in **data visualisation**, dashboard design, or **developer-facing tools**.
* Experience designing **natural language** or **AI-assisted interfaces**.

**Benefits**
------------

* **Competitive compensation.** Fair and attractive pay that reflects the seniority and impact of the role.
* **Real ownership.** You'll report to our Head of R&D and shape product direction directly with our CTPO and CEO. We're scaling deliberately, and your influence grows with the product.
* **People who care.** Everyone on the team is deeply invested in the problem and committed to doing the work well.
* **Full transparency.** No filtered updates. Everyone knows what’s being built, how the business is doing, and where we’re going.

If that sounds like your kind of problem, we’d like to hear from you.

Connect Centre insights to Polaris, Compass, and the Quarterly Risk Report to enable earlier risk surfacing and sharper, market‑level action.

title: Head of Industrial Innovation
description:
Quiénes somos

TK Elevator (TKE) is a global leader in vertical transportation and urban mobility, providing engineering — from design through installation, maintenance and modernization — for elevators, escalators, moving walkways, passenger boarding bridges, stairlifts, platform lifts and home elevators. From our engineering and manufacturing site in Mieres, Asturias, TKAS offers a full portfolio of airport apron and gate mobility solutions. title: Regional Design Producer Lead - ( Madrid )
description:
**Regional Design Producer Lead - ( Madrid )**

Seen & Heard is a global creative agency with studios in Newcastle and London, delivering design, video production, creative communication and brand adaptation for global brands. Now we're going further. This is a brand-new role and a rare opportunity for a designer who's ready to step up, take the lead and shape how great creative lands across an entire region.

**THE ROLE**

As Regional Design Producer Lead, you'll be the **guardian of cultural and creative relevance** for your region. Global marketing toolboxes and their localisations are created in our UK design hub. Your mission is to make sure that work doesn't just arrive in your markets, it truly lands.

This is a Design Producer role first. Creative judgement and output sit at its heart, with project management running alongside. Yes, there's plenty of coordination, and you'll need to be brilliantly organised to do it well. But the real magic is this: looking at an asset built for everyone, knowing instantly how it will and won't work in your markets, and directing what needs to change. That cultural instinct is exactly why this role lives in the region, not the hub.

You'll also be the person who brings the region together. Markets get what they need faster, and for less, when their requirements arrive as one set rather than one at a time. You'll pull those requirements together, sharpen them along the way and get them in on time, then make sure the finished work gets back out to the markets just as smoothly.

This is leadership without line management: you'll lead through influence, expertise and great creative judgement. It's the perfect next step for a designer with a strong creative eye who's ready to start delivering through others, and who wants to grow with our business. You'll embody our values of **curiosity**, **partnerships**, **insight**, **agility** and **integrity**, and solve problems through beautiful design, rather than treating design as just an output.

**Where you'll fit in**

You'll report directly to a Director.

You'll partner closely with the client's creative operations lead for your region. They own the workflow, approvals, budgets and reporting. Within all of that, you're the one who **owns brief quality, cultural judgement and market consolidation**.

You'll also be part of a growing network of regional producers. They're your peers, with no reporting line either way: the people you'll swap ideas with, cover for and build a genuine support network alongside.

Expect two to three days a week in the client's office in the region, with the rest of the week working from home. And because this role is brand new, you'll have room to help shape exactly what that looks like as working relationships in the region settle.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Cultural Relevance**

This is the heart of the role, and the part that simply can't be done from the UK. It's why you'll be based in the region.

* Alongside the marketing teams in the countries, decide what adapts, what has to be made from scratch, and what is not right for a market at all.
* Check what comes out of the hub for cultural fit, inside the hub’s quality gate rather than as another approval on the end of it.
* Say when something will not work, say why, and say what would. Flagging a problem without an answer is a job half done.
* Hold a position when a market asks for something that would damage the work or the brand, and know when to concede.
* Know what is going on in the region. Retail landscape, salon landscape, competitors, language, trends and what the markets are reacting to.

**Markets and Briefs**

Every market in the region briefs through you, making you the region's creative gatekeeper. A half-finished brief costs everyone time, so you'll set the bar for brief quality and make sure every brief that reaches the hub is ready to fly.

* Be the contact for the markets in the region, and build relationships with them that go further than email.
* Quality-gate every brief before it reaches the hub. Push back, and help markets get a brief to the point where it can be worked on.
* Refuse variations that are off-brand, inappropriate or not worth what they cost. Explain why rather than simply saying no.
* Consolidate requirements so the hub gets one set from the region rather than several. These requirements need to land alongside the other regions as the model expands so scale can be leveraged in the hub.
* Coordinate with the global team what the markets keep asking for, so the next toolbox has it built in.

**EXPERIENCE**

* Producing or managing creative work across more than one market, in an agency, a brand, an in-house studio or a market team.
* Working inside established creative or operational systems, and adapting them for market or business unit.
* Running briefs/requirements and stakeholders across several countries or departments.
* Running feedback and approval rounds to a deadline, and holding people to them.
* Creative automation or AI-assisted production/operations, hands-on and current, with a clear view of what AI does well and where it does not add value.
* Reporting on volumes, progress and spend accurately and on time.
* Fluent English, and fluent in the language of the country this role is based in.

**SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES**

* Creative judgement. Can look at a piece of work and say why it will not land in a market, and what would.
* Able to hold a position with a market, with the hub or with a client colleague, and to know when to concede.
* Highly organised. Several markets converge on this role and nothing can be allowed to fall through it.
* Comfortable being the only Seen & Heard person in the room, being able to represent the company and the work.
* Clear about the difference between a preference and a problem.
* Writes a brief someone can start work from.
* Generous with what they know, and curious about markets other than their own.

**DESIRABLE**

* A design background, and enough hands-on Adobe Creative Cloud to make a small amend without asking.
* Conversational skills in additional languages from the region.
* Beauty, fashion or FMCG background, and an understanding of salon and retail.
* Experience of a hub-and-spoke or centralised production model, from either end of it.
* Localisation or transcreation specifically, rather than general production.
* Working knowledge of a DAM or creative workflow platform.
* Experience of a business going through growth or structural change.

**What we offer**

* **Pension:** 3% matched contribution
* **Holiday:** 23 days plus bank holidays, with time off between Christmas and New Year guaranteed
* **Sick pay:** 5 days at full pay each year
* **Flexible working:** hybrid options that work for you and the team
* **Wellbeing:** free gym classes in Newcastle and rooftop sauna access in London
* **Learning and development:** monthly lunch-and-learns, plus funding and time off for relevant courses

**READY TO LEAD?**

If you're a designer who's ready to step into leadership, bring creative judgement to a whole region and help shape a brand-new role from day one, we'd love to hear from you.

Buscamos un/a **Bid Manager Transversal (Cross-Solutions)** para unirse a nuestro equipo. En este rol, serás la pieza clave encargada de orquestar y gestionar propuestas complejas que abarquen **todo el portfolio de soluciones de Devoteam**.

No te limitarás a una sola tecnología; tu misión será integrar piezas de Cloud, Data, Ciberseguridad o plataformas empresariales para crear propuestas de valor globales, coherentes y ganadoras.
