title: LEATHER DEVELOPMENT & SOURCING MANAGER
description:
### **Position**

Are you an expert in luxury leather craftsmanship with a passion for driving innovation and speed-to-market? We are looking for a **Leather Development & Sourcing Manager** to join our Development team.

In this pivotal role, you will bridge creative vision and technical execution, translating design briefs into proprietary brand signatures while maintaining the highest standards of quality, sustainability, and efficiency.

### **Job responsibilities**

  

* **Drive Rapid Development & Innovation:** Spearhead end-to-end development cycles from the initial design brief to industrialization, successfully optimizing innovation lead times while maintaining strict adherence to the collection milestone calendar without quality degradation.
* **Translate Creative Vision into Brand Signatures:** Direct exclusive touch, finishes, color depth, and natural aging characteristics, ensuring high first-time-right color and handfeel approval rates and consistent Maison signature finishes across bulk production.
* **Quality Assurance & Technical Validation:** Balance acceleration in time-to-market with rigorous technical validation, comprehensive testing, quality assurance, and root-cause analysis for leather behavior in handbag construction.
* **Supplier Management & ESG Integration:** Lead supplier management, negotiation, and cross-functional decision-making while embedding robust ESG practices, full traceability, and regulatory compliance into daily operations.

### **Profile**

* 15+ years of proven experience in leather development, research, and tanning within a fast-paced luxury environment.
* Deep knowledge of tanning, finishing, grading, and leather behavior in handbag construction. A strong eye for luxury aesthetics, handfeel, grain, and color nuance.
* Exceptional communication, high cross-functional influence, and the ability to seamlessly translate creative briefs into precise technical specifications.
* Fluency in English and Spanish are a must; knowledge of Italian and/or French is a strong advantage.

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

  

Are you ready to shape the future of luxury leather goods? Apply now!

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: General Manager
description:

* **Deliver exceptional residential service standards**

You recruit, mentor and empower a high-performing team which goes through fostering a culture of accountability, warmth, and excellence in a residential environment.

You make sure to align with local regulations and brand expectations, you guarantee the peace of mind for residents.

You act as an ambassador of the residence within Madrid, you curate exclusive local partnerships and bespoke lifestyle offerings to enrich residents everyday living, foster connection, and express the unique energy of SLS living.

title: Social Media Lead - SportyTV & Sports Media Brands
description:
**About Sporty Group**
----------------------

Sporty Group is a global sports entertainment company, home to leading brands like **SportyBet**, **Football.com** and **SportyTV**. We operate at the intersection of **sports, content, community and technology**, building products and media experiences that connect fans with the moments that matter.

Our media brands, led by **SportyTV**, bring fans closer to the game through highlights, stories, analysis, personalities and football culture, across every major social platform.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We're looking for a **Social Media Lead** to drive social strategy and coordinate the social team behind **SportyTV and our sports media brands**. This role combines **team leadership**, a **sports journalism mindset** and **strong editorial judgement** to make our channels a go-to destination for football fans.

You'll set the editorial direction, run day-to-day publishing operations, and lead a team of social media managers, community managers and content creators, making sure our output is **fast, accurate, engaging and built for growth**.

You'll work closely with **Content, Video/Production, Design, Brand, Marketing, Partnerships, BI and Country teams**, and report to the Social Media Director.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Team Leadership & Coordination**

* Lead, coordinate and develop a team of social media managers, community managers and content creators across SportyTV and our media brands.
* Set priorities, assign coverage and run workflows and shift planning for match days, live events and breaking news.
* Give clear feedback, run regular editorial meetings and raise the team's creative and editorial standards.
* Build scalable processes (calendars, briefs, approval flows, playbooks) that keep the team fast and consistent.

### **Editorial Strategy & Sports Coverage**

* Define and execute the social and editorial strategy for **SportyTV and Football.com**, aligned with global brand guidelines and business priorities.
* Own the editorial calendar around major football and sports moments (EPL, UCL, LaLiga, AFCON, World Cup, transfer windows, etc.).
* Apply a journalistic approach to social: newsworthiness, storytelling, fact-checking, source verification and speed without sacrificing accuracy.
* Lead real-time and reactive coverage of match days, breaking news, transfers, controversies and trending moments.

### **Content & Formats**

* Oversee content across Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, YouTube (incl. Shorts), LinkedIn and Telegram.
* Develop and scale repeatable content series and franchises: highlights-led narratives, analysis, interviews, explainers, football culture and personality-led formats.
* Work with video, production and design teams to deliver platform-native content with strong hooks and retention.
* Ensure tone of voice, quality and brand consistency across all channels.

* Work with presenters, journalists, pundits, creators and sports personalities to grow reach and credibility.
* Support partnerships, rights-holder relationships and co-branded activations with clubs, leagues and media partners.

* Track KPIs: reach, views, watch time, engagement, follower growth, retention and sentiment.

* **5+ years** of experience in social media, with at least **2 years coordinating or leading social media teams**.

* **Excellent English (C1/C2 or native)**: you'll write, edit and approve content in English and it's our main working language. Spanish or other languages are a plus.

* Confident using analytics and social listening tools to guide decisions.
* Strong organisation, stakeholder management and the ability to lead a team in a fast-paced, high-output environment.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience with live coverage of major tournaments.
* Experience working with audiences in Africa, Latin America or other international markets.
* Hands-on video editing or production experience.

If you're interested, we encourage you to apply! Every application is reviewed by a member of our team (AI is not used in our recruitment process), and we aim to respond within 48 hours.

As **Wholesale Assistant** , you will support the Wholesale Manager and Account Executives in the daily management of wholesale operations, ensuring clients receive exceptional service and accurate, timely communication throughout the order lifecycle. * Support with the management of RTV processes, quality issues, and credit notes.

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field.
* At least one year of relevant work experience in a similar role.
* Fluency in both Spanish and English is required; additional languages are considered an asset.
* Strong analytical skills, excellent organisational abilities, and effective time management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
* Previous experience with fashion or luxury brands is a plus, but not essential.

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**
  
  
Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.
  
  
At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Head of Sourcing
description:
HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**
--------------------

**About Us**
------------

HBX Group is the world’s leading technological partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We bring together global and local brands across accommodation, transport, activities and payments, supported by a network of over 300,000 hotels and 60,000 travel partners worldwide. We are tech‑driven, customer‑focused, and powered by exceptional people. At HBX Group, we believe **tech + data + people** is what truly sets us apart.

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are seeking an experienced and results‑driven **Head of Sourcing** to lead the full Transfers Sourcing team (approx. 12 people). This role will take full ownership of operational performance, commercial delivery, and supplier governance, allowing the Director of Global Sourcing to step back from day‑to‑day management.

The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership experience at Head‑of‑level, with a proven track record of driving performance, managing complex supplier relationships, and navigating demanding stakeholder environments across HBX Group. This is **not a step‑up role** — we require someone who can immediately step in, lead confidently, and deliver.

Transfers experience is ideal, but strong travel sector sourcing backgrounds will also be considered. The role involves hands‑on leadership, supplier engagement, willingness to pick up the phone, and active “on‑the‑pitch” involvement when required. You will also directly manage two Sourcing Executive Administrators and ensure strong audit and governance discipline across the team.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Lead and manage the full Transfers Sourcing team (approx. 12 people), overseeing performance, delivery and professional development.
* Ensure strong audit, governance, and compliance standards across the sourcing function, including direct management of two Sourcing Executive Administrators.
* Drive commercial results by negotiating competitive rates, terms, and service delivery with transport suppliers.
* Oversee supplier relationships, ensuring quality, operational excellence, and adherence to SLAs.
* Collaborate closely with Pricing, Sales, Supplier Performance, Finance, and other HBX Group stakeholders.
* Maintain strong communication with suppliers, proactively resolving issues and escalating underperformance when necessary.
* Support hotel payment processes and liaise with Supplier Performance teams to ensure strong cross‑departmental alignment.
* Act as a hands‑on leader — comfortable making calls, joining operational discussions, and representing the department confidently.
* Identify growth opportunities within sourcing and champion new initiatives aligned with business strategy.

**Skillset and Experience Required**
------------------------------------

* Proven leadership experience at **Head‑of‑level**, with strong results‑driven delivery in sourcing or travel procurement.
* Experience managing transport or travel suppliers; Transfers experience highly desirable.
* Strong governance, audit, and compliance mindset within a sourcing function.
* Ability to manage and motivate a geographically dispersed and multicultural team.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills across all levels of HBX Group.
* Hands‑on, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast‑paced, high‑pressure environment.
* Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to balance cost, service, and operational impact.
* Highly organized, analytical, and confident handling complex supplier portfolios.
* Willingness to travel and to engage directly with suppliers when required.

*At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good.*  
*We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected.*  
*Join us and be part of a team where equal opportunities truly make a difference.*

You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.

* Within an innovative, engaging and multicultural environment.
* Have the opportunity to build strong and lasting business relationships and friendships from around the world.
* Have the opportunity in developing your career locally or within one of our beautiful working locations across the globe.

title: CISO AI
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking a forward-thinking security leader to become our AI CISO. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI security at a global scale, protecting our models, data, and infrastructure from emerging threats while fostering responsible and ethical AI innovation.

**About the job**

**Job purpose**

Your purpose is to build and run a holistic AI security program for AXA. You will establish the governance, risk management framework, and security controls to protect our AI/ML models and data, ensuring that AXA's use of AI is not only powerful but also secure and trustworthy.

**Main missions**

Your mission is to build the program around the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, adapted for AI:

* Govern: Develop and follow implementation the Group's AI Security Strategy, in line with responsible AI principles and emerging regulations (e.g., EU AI Act). Establish policies for secure AI development, data usage, and model governance
* Identify: Lead risk assessments methodology design on AI models and systems, focusing on unique threats like data poisoning, model evasion, adversarial attacks, and prompt injection. Ensure a consolidate inventory of critical AI assets
* Protect: Define security standards and architecture patterns for the AI/ML lifecycle, from secure data acquisition and feature engineering to model training and deployment. Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of models and training data
* Detect: Oversee the implementation of monitoring mechanisms to detect model drift, anomalous behavior, and security attacks against AI systems. Define AI-specific incident precursors for the SOC
* Respond & Recover: Define and test the incident response playbook for AI-specific security events, such as a compromised model or a severe data leak through a Generative AI service

**Expected skills & experience**

We are looking for someone with the following experience and skills:

**Experience**

More than 10 years of experience in Information Security or a related field, with demonstrated experience in a leadership role focused on data science, AI/ML, or the security thereof.

**Technical skills**

* Good understanding of the AI/ML lifecycle
* Knowledge of common AI frameworks
* Familiarity with AI-specific security threats (adversarial ML, etc.) and controls
* Knowledge of data privacy and emerging AI regulations is essential

**Soft skills / transversal skills**

Profile

* Fluent in English. Outstanding oral and written communication skills with proven ability to develop and present concise information
* Strong multi-cultural understanding
* Experience of interacting with Directors and all levels of management
* Team player and able to collaborate, influence and guide others

Strategic Mindset

* A passion for innovation balanced with a pragmatic, risk-based approach. Ability to think strategically and establish a new function in a complex, global organization
* Maintains a wider perspective, aligns actions and contributes to the enhancement of the overall organizational strategy, including outputs from benchmarking activities and reviews
* Understands and articulates the projected direction of the organization and how changes to it might impact the group
* Is aware of trends in the external environment and key differentiators vis-à-vis competition and uses this information to anticipate how these changes would impact the organization

Leadership / Stakeholder Management / Communication:

* A visionary leader capable of navigating ambiguity and influencing a wide range of stakeholders to adopt new security paradigms in a matrix organization
* Ability to build consensus and drive collaboration between highly technical data science teams, business units, AXA Group functions, and AXA entities.
* Exceptional ability to communicate in English, translating complex AI security concepts into clear, actionable guidance for diverse audiences from developers to senior executives

**Where will you be in the organization?**

**The department / team**

* The division: As the thematic CISO for Artificial Intelligence within Group Security, you will be AXA's leading expert on AI security. You will partner with data science teams, innovation hubs, and local CISOs to ensure our AI initiatives are secure, trustworthy, and compliant.

  

* The department / team: Operating within a global matrix structure, you will use your leadership and influence to embed security into the entire AI lifecycle across all AXA entities. Your mission is to make "secure AI" a core principle of every project, ensuring our innovation is built on a foundation of trust.

**What we offer**

We bring together the expertise, cultural diversity and creativity of over 8,000 employees worldwide and we’re committed to equal opportunities in all aspects of employment (gender, LGBT+, disabled persons, or people of different origins) and to promoting Diversity & Inclusion by creating a work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect, and where individual differences are valued.

description:

**At Ayvens we have an opening for an experienced AI Technical Lead.**

  

**What are you going to do?**

As our new AI Technical Lead, you will provide the technical leadership and hands-on MLOps expertise required to define, operationalize, validate and scale AI solutions across Ayvens. You will support strategic AI decisions while remaining directly involved in the MLOps implementation layer, covering technology choices, architecture, platform capabilities, infrastructure as code, integration, deployment, technical staffing and production readiness. You will translate business and governance needs into working MLOps patterns and ensure that AI solutions are secure, interoperable, scalable, maintainable and aligned with the target technology landscape.

You will report to the Director Data Science & AI.

  

**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Technical leadership and decision support: Act as the senior technical reference for AI and data science initiatives. Provide clear recommendations on architecture, platforms, build-versus-buy decisions, reuse opportunities, technical feasibility, engineering effort and delivery risks.
* AI platform strategy and architecture: Lead the evolution of the AI platform landscape, including MLOps, LLMOps, Azure AI services, AI Foundry, Databricks, the SG Agentic Platform and related engineering capabilities. Define and implement target patterns that enable secure and scalable industrialization.
* MLOps capacity and staffing: Assess the MLOps and platform profiles, skills, capacity and delivery model required to operationalize AI initiatives. Support workforce and sourcing decisions, challenge staffing assumptions and help structure effective collaboration between MLOps, Data Science, AI Engineering, Data Engineering, Architecture and infrastructure teams.

Contribute directly to reference MLOps implementations, platform configurations, deployment pipelines and reusable operational components. Ensure solutions meet quality, resilience, performance, interoperability and maintainability expectations.
* Industrialization and operations: Establish and implement engineering standards for CI/CD, testing, code quality, model and prompt evaluation, observability, monitoring, versioning, deployment, incident management, disaster recovery and lifecycle maintenance. Build and maintain reusable MLOps/LLMOps patterns for the operationalization of AI solutions.
* AI governance and compliance: Provide technical input to AI governance decisions and ensure architecture, security, privacy, MRM, AI Act and internal control requirements are translated into implementable engineering controls and evidence.

MLOps coaching and standards: Guide MLOps specialists and technical leads, promote reusable platform assets and reference architectures, and raise MLOps maturity through practical standards, platform reviews and knowledge sharing. Work closely with the AI Engineering team without owning AI application engineering delivery.

The ideal candidate is a senior MLOps and AI platform leader who combines deep hands-on operational expertise with strong judgment, communication and organizational influence. You can move comfortably from detailed MLOps implementation discussions to executive decision forums, and you can challenge platform, operationalization and resourcing assumptions with clarity and credibility.

* Typically 10+ years of relevant experience across technology, data platforms or AI, including substantial hands-on experience leading the MLOps architecture, industrialization and operation of production AI platforms in complex international environments.

* Demonstrated ability to assess engineering effort, staffing needs, required profiles and delivery capacity, and to advise on internal versus external resourcing models.

The candidate must be able to review deployment pipelines and platform configurations, create MLOps prototypes and support production operationalization directly.
* Hands-on experience with Azure and Databricks ecosystems, including Azure AI Foundry, MLflow, Unity Catalog, GitHub and agentic AI platforms. Practical experience creating and operating production-grade AI services is highly valuable.
* Strong knowledge of security, data privacy, model risk, responsible AI, resilience, disaster recovery and regulatory requirements relevant to enterprise AI.

Hands-on MLOps leadership: Willing and able to work directly within the MLOps team, inspect repositories, Infrastructure-as-Code configurations and deployment pipelines, troubleshoot platform and operationalization issues, build reference MLOps implementations and turn architecture decisions into executable platform standards and reusable assets.

Production MLOps/LLMOps engineering: Demonstrated experience moving models and GenAI solutions from experimentation into production, including packaging, deployment, orchestration, evaluation, observability, rollback, versioning, performance management and ongoing support.

AI interoperability and integration: Proven experience operationalizing AI solutions through well-designed APIs, event-driven integrations, model-serving interfaces and reusable platform services. Ability to integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, data platforms, authentication, logging and monitoring services.

Infrastructure as code and cloud automation: Strong practical experience designing modular Terraform structures, reusable modules, environment configurations, state management and automated cloud deployments. Experience integrating infrastructure as code into secure CI/CD pipelines is required.

* Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to present complex technical options, costs, risks and trade-offs clearly to both executives and engineering teams.

* Ability to coach MLOps and platform specialists, run platform and operational-readiness reviews, and create a culture of MLOps quality, accountability and continuous improvement.

title: Construction Manager
description:
International **Design and Build** group specializing in **complex buildings**, we are mainly involved in **turnkey construction**, renovation and extension projects in the **Datacenter**, **Critical Utilities**, **Industry & Cleanrooms**, **Wines, Spirits & Agri-Foods** sectors.

title: Director, Commercial Transformation

title: HSE Manager
description:
**Job Description**

**Who will you be working with?**

The Integrated Quality Systems Manager reports to the Quality Director & HSE and collaborates with Site Director and cross-functional teams to drive strategy and continuous improvement, manage Risks, and maintain compliance with regulatory and customer requirements. You will lead a team of quality, safety, environmental, and energy management professionals, including Engineers, Auditors, and Technicians.

**How will you make a difference?**

The Integrated Quality Systems Manager is responsible for the development, implementation, and maintenance of the company’s integrated management system, ensuring compliance with IRIS 22163, ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and ISO 50001 standards in addition to other normative or requirements such as EEM (European Entity in Charge of Maintenance). This role ensures that all processes, products, and services meet the highest quality, health, safety, environmental, and energy management standards.

**What will your typical day look like?**

**Integrated Management System (IMS):**

* Develop, implement, and manage the IMS to ensure compliance with IRIS 22163, ISO 45001, ISO 14001, ISO 50001, Wabtec’s WMS and other relevant standards.
* Conduct regular audits and assessments to ensure the effectiveness of the IMS, covering quality, health, safety, environmental, and energy management systems.
* Lead the internal audit program, including planning, execution, and follow-up on corrective actions across all relevant standards.
* Maintain all quality, health, safety, environmental, and energy management documentation, records, and reports in accordance with regulatory requirements.
* Keep informed of the Safety, Environment and Quality Management System methodologies and assure ease of implementation for the relevant content and the reliability of the products required by customers
* Maintain the IMS updated according to Wabtec standards to allow costs for the execution of the Projects deadlines and reach optimum levels.
* Represent the management of the company during certification process or surveillance audits regarding ISO’s, Special Process or External Audits.
* Coordinate with Management and ensure documentation related to the organization's Management Review and Business Plan - STRAP (context review, system and stakeholder changes, area and Site SWOTs, risk and opportunity management, changes or new developments in legal and other requirements, customer feedback, etc.).

**IRIS 22163 Specific Responsibilities:**

* Oversee the implementation and maintenance of the IRIS 22163 rail industry standard.
* Ensure that all rail-related processes meet the quality and safety requirements specific to the rail industry.
* Collaborate with relevant departments and functions in Wabtec to meet the specific demands and expectations of rail industry customers.

**ISO 45001 Specific Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement occupational health and safety policies, procedures, and programs in line with ISO 45001.
* Conduct risk assessments and hazard identification processes to mitigate potential workplace risks.
* Promote a culture of safety and ensure that health and safety objectives are established and met.

**ISO 14001 Specific Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement environmental management policies, procedures, and programs in line with ISO 14001.
* Ensure that environmental objectives are established, monitored, and achieved, including waste management, pollution, prevention, and resource conservation.
* undefined Lead initiatives to minimize the company’s environmental footprint. undefined

**ISO 50001 Specific Responsibilities:**

* Coordination and collaboration with the Production, Sustainability & Energy Mger in order to:Develop and implement energy management policies, procedures, and programs in line with ISO 50001.
* Monitor energy usage and implement strategies to improve energy efficiency and reduce consumption.
* Establish energy performance indicators (EnPIs) and drive continuous improvement in energy management.

**Regulatory Compliance:**

* Ensure compliance with local, national, and international regulations related to quality, health, safety, environmental, and energy management.
* Stay updated on changes in industry regulations, standards, and best practices.
* Liaise with regulatory bodies, certification agencies, and external auditors as needed.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across all departments to enhance product quality, operational efficiency, workplace safety, environmental sustainability, and energy efficiency.Implement and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to quality, health, safety, environmental, and energy performance.
* Facilitate root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) for any issues related to the IMS.

**Customer Interaction:**

* Collaborate with Sales team in the annual Customer Survey process in order to understand their requirements and expectations and manage internal action plan emanated from their feedback.undefined

**Health and Safety Management:**

* Develop, implement, and maintain health and safety policies and procedures in line with local regulations and industry standards.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable health and safety regulations, including those specific to the railway sector.

**Risk Management:**

* Conduct regular risk assessments and audits to identify potential hazards and implement corrective actions.
* Develop and enforce risk management strategies to minimize accidents and incidents.

**Training and Development:**

* Aligned with Wabtec processes, tools and guidelines, design and deliver awareness training programs on health and safety practices, ensuring all employees are equipped with the necessary knowledge and skills.
* Ensure locally mandated health and safety training for all employees according to Wabtec Iberica scope of activities.

**Incident Management:**

* Investigate accidents, incidents, and near-misses to determine root causes and develop strategies to prevent recurrence.
* Maintain detailed records of incidents and ensure proper reporting to relevant authorities**.**

**Regulatory Reporting and Documentation:**

* Prepare and submit regulatory reports and documentation as required.
* Keep up to date with changes in legislation and industry best practices, and adjust policies accordingly.

**Safety Culture Promotion:**

* Foster a positive safety culture by engaging with employees, encouraging feedback, and promoting safe working practices.
* Lead safety meetings and collaborate with various departments to address health and safety concerns.

**Emergency Preparedness:**

* Develop and implement emergency response plans, including evacuation procedures and crisis management strategies.
* Conduct regular drills and simulations to ensure preparedness for emergencies.

**What do we want to know from you?**

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, quality management, environmental science. Master in occupational health and safety, energy management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in quality management, health and safety, environmental management, energy management, or a similar role.

Key Competencies

* Quality Systems (ISO 9001, ISO IRIS 22163)
* EHS Systems (ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 50001)
* Experience with integrated management systems and internal/external auditing processes.
* Problem-solving (FTA, 8D, RCA..)
* Knowledge of the APQP – Project Management
* EEM (Entity in Charge of Maintenance) System is a plus
* Health and safety regulations and risk assessment methodologies
* Coordination of Entrepreneurial Activities (CAEs)
* Office Suite – Excel and Power Point.

Soft Skills

* Team maker, leadership.
* Process and Results oriented (50%/50%)
* Positive spirit, guide for others
* Effective communication and interpersonnel skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with various stakeholders and manage multiple priorities

Languages

* Fluent Spanish
* Fluent English

Availability for frequent regulatory assessment in plant and Field services (Barcelona, Valencia, Sevilla, Madrid areas)

title: Ingeniero/a de Proyectos de Instalaciones Farmacéuticas
description:

**¿Cuáles serán tus misiones?**
  

* Diseñar sistemas e instalaciones mecánicas en la industria farmacéutica (piping, generación de frío/calor, vapor, agua purificada/inyectable, etc.).
* Elaborar documentación técnica para el cliente: P&ID, listados, fichas técnicas, memorias técnicas, etc.
* Preparar documentación para licitaciones, comparativos técnicos y económicos.
* Desarrollar los proyectos garantizando el cumplimiento de la normativa farmacéutica, de seguridad y medio ambiente.
* Preparar las **URS** del proyecto en colaboración con el cliente.
* Asegurar que los proyectos cumplen los hitos de plazo y calidad definidos por el director de proyecto o el cliente.
* En algunos proyectos, liderar el equipo de proyecto, delegando responsabilidades a otros ingenieros/as y al equipo de delineación.

✍️ **Tu perfil**
  

* Experiencia previa como **ingeniero/a de proyectos** en el sector industrial y/o químico-farmacéutico, o en tareas de diseño de ingeniería conceptual, básica y de detalle.
* Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería (Química, Industrial, Ciencias de la Vida u otra disciplina técnica afín).
* Conocimiento fluido de **español** e **inglés**; se valorarán otros idiomas.
* Usuario/a habitual de Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project, PowerPoint, Adobe u otras herramientas ofimáticas.
* Disponibilidad para viajar puntualmente para visitas a clientes.

**Competencias**
  

* Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita.
* Pensamiento analítico y capacidad de resolución de problemas.
* Capacidad para priorizar tareas y cumplir plazos exigentes.
* Sólidas habilidades de gestión de clientes y orientación al servicio.
* Capacidad para trabajar en varios proyectos en paralelo.
* Perfil colaborativo, innovador, responsable y orientado al trabajo en equipo.

**Nice to have (se valorará positivamente):**
  

* Experiencia en los sectores salud / ciencias de la vida / farmacéutico.
* Familiaridad con **GMP, ISPE, FDA, OMS** y otras directrices y regulaciones farmacéuticas.
* Experiencia como ingeniero/a de proyectos en diseño y construcción de plantas farmacéuticas.
* Conocimientos técnicos de **HVAC, procesos, salas blancas, tuberías, control o electricidad** en la industria farmacéutica.
* Experiencia previa en diseño de instalaciones industriales, puesta en marcha o gestión de dosieres técnicos.

✨ **¿Qué ofrecemos?**
  

* Una comunidad internacional que reúne a más de 110 nacionalidades.
* Un entorno donde la confianza es central y el crecimiento interno es valorado.
* Un sólido plan de formación interna y certificaciones.
* Actividades de trabajo en equipo y un ambiente de trabajo excelente, con un equipo joven y dinámico.
* Horario flexible.
* Retribución flexible (seguro médico, cheque restaurante/transporte/guardería, según política local).

**Beneficios locales (según país y entidad de contratación):**
  

* Tickets restaurante.
* Programas de bienestar y beneficios para empleados.
* Opciones de trabajo flexible según política de la empresa.
* Seguro de salud y programas de bienestar, cuando aplique.

**La persona ideal comparte estos valores:**
  
**Boldness**: nuestro espíritu emprendedor y de aventura es lo que nos une y nos lleva al éxito.
  
**Trust**: la confianza es la base de nuestras relaciones y nos permite fomentar la libertad de expresión, la creatividad y la innovación.
  
**Performance**: nos guía en la mejora continua y en la búsqueda de resultados concretos.
  
**Commitment**: trabajamos con dedicación y responsabilidad para alcanzar nuestros objetivos.
  
**Independence**: Amaris Consulting pertenece a quienes la han creado y a quienes la desarrollan cada día.

Con tu candidatura, podrás tener la oportunidad de unirte a una empresa que apoya a sus partners en los sectores Automotive & Motorsport, Avionic & Aerospace, Defence, Railway, Industrial, Home Automation y Robotics, con actividades de ingeniería mecánica y electrónica en las áreas de Development & Design, Testing & Validation, System Engineering, R&D y Project Management.

**Diversidad e inclusión**
  
Amaris Consulting promueve la igualdad de oportunidades y evalúa las candidaturas en función de las competencias, la experiencia y el potencial. Damos la bienvenida a candidaturas cualificadas sin discriminación por razón de género, identidad o expresión de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico, nacionalidad, religión o creencias, edad, discapacidad, estado civil o familiar, o cualquier otra característica protegida.
  
Si necesitas ajustes razonables durante el proceso de selección, háznoslo saber: haremos todo lo posible por apoyarte.

**Who are we?**
---------------

**Amaris Consulting** is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success.
  
  
At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:
  
  
**Brief Call**: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!
  
  
**Interviews** (the average number of interviews is 3 - the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!
  
  
**Case study**: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem-solving scenario, etc.
  
  
As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience.
  
We look forward to meeting you!

title: Ingeniero/a Senior de Diseño de Interiores Ferroviarios

description:

Convertir la estrategia de testing del Creative Strategist / Head of Growth en un flujo constante y fiable de assets publicados. * Volumen de assets producidos por mes, desglosado por formato y canal
* Cumplimiento de la cadencia de entrega semanal
* Velocidad de testing creativo (compartido con Creative Strategist)

**Perfil orientado y requerimientos:**

**Experiencia y background:**

* 2-4 años en producción de contenido, coordinación creativa o UGC en entornos DTC o performance marketing
* Experiencia gestionando creadores/as con capacidad demostrada de obtener resultados positivos en las colaboraciones
* Haber trabajado en producción de alto volumen y alta cadencia, no en proyectos puntuales o hero assets
* Comprensión básica de paid social y qué métricas validan un concepto en Meta, TikTok y Amazon
* Muy valorable: experiencia trabajando codo a codo con un equipo de paid social o growth donde el contenido se mide por resultados
* Muy valorable: experiencia en health, beauty, wellness o alimentación

**Conocimientos clave:**  

* Criterio creativo propio: sabe cuándo una toma no vale, da feedback concreto y pide repetición
* Mentalidad de escala: optimiza para rango y velocidad, sabe cuándo algo es suficientemente bueno para testear

* Rigor absoluto en claims: ante la duda, se pregunta, no se publica
* Coordinación transversal con equipos que no le reportan, sin perder velocidad de entrega
* Don de gentes para construir relaciones de confianza con creadores/as
* Organización y fiabilidad: el equipo puede contar con ella para que lo prometido llega cuando estaba prometido
* Mejora continua: busca activamente cómo producir más con los mismos recursos sin perder calidad

#### **¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?**

* Salario acorde con *mercado* según know-how
* Cultura de colaboración, aprendizaje y confianza
* Posibilidad clara de crecimiento con el proyecto
* Modelo de trabajo híbrido (4p+1tt)
* Retribución flexible con nuestro partner Cobe*e*
* Descuentos top en todos los productos de Baïa
* Programa Baïa Benefits enfocados en tu bienestar físico y mental (te detallamos más adelante)

#### **¿Quiénes somos?**

En **Baïa Food** tenemos claro que con nuestro trabajo, cada día contribuimos a un gran propósito: **Acompañar a las personas en su camino hacia el bienestar para que puedan disfrutar de una vida más plena**. Pero, ¿Cómo lo hacemos? A través del desarrollo de **suplementos alimenticios innovadores basados en evidencia científica** y buen sabor, **sin azúcares ni edulcorantes.**

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
**About us**

Do you live to create? Looking for your next big challenge? How about a breath of fresh air? As part of the Omnicom Agencies Group, the 14 Agency network handles all global advertising for CUPRA and SEAT car brands. With offices in 11 countries and counting, 14 is a place for those who like to bend the rules. It's a place for rock'n'roll. At the heart of Barcelona, and beyond.

It is also a place where a diverse mix of talented people want to come, to stay and do their best work. Our dedication to promoting diversity, multiculturalism, and inclusion is clearly reflected in our teams and across all of our work. Diversity is more than a commitment for us — it is the foundation of what we do.

**Role Purpose**

We are looking for a Social Media Strategist to join the CUPRA Global Social Strategy team. Someone with an insatiable curiosity about digital culture, platforms, and communities, and the ability to translate all of that into strategy.

Someone who experiences the internet beyond their feed; who understands the lore, knows what's behind the screenmaxing, and recognizes when something is "that's so AI." Someone who scrolls with curiosity, knows how to separate the noise from the signals that matter, and connects what's happening online with what's happening in the real world.

As we prepare for opening, we are looking for an exceptional Executive Chef to join our Executive Leadership Team and help shape the culinary identity of this landmark resort.

This is an opportunity to do much more than lead a kitchen. We are seeking a culinary leader who can create memorable dining experiences, develop innovative concepts, build an outstanding brigade, and establish a food culture that celebrates the energy, creativity, and natural abundance of Ibiza.

Working closely with the Food Beverage leadership team and wider resort stakeholders, you will help define and deliver the culinary vision of ZEST across restaurants, bars, Pool Club, in-room dining, banqueting, and special events. * Demonstrated success managing multiple restaurants and diverse culinary concepts within a complex hospitality environment.
* Strong understanding of Mediterranean cuisine, local sourcing, seasonality, and international food trends.
* Proven experience developing successful restaurant concepts, menus, and guest dining experiences.
* Strong commercial acumen with expertise in food cost management, labor control, purchasing, budgeting, and profitability.
* Experience recruiting, developing, and leading large culinary teams.
* Previous hotel or resort pre-opening experience is highly desirable.
* In-depth knowledge of HACCP, food safety regulations, and Spanish/EU compliance requirements.

* Creative and visionary culinary leadership.
* Passion for exceptional food quality and guest experiences.
* Strong commercial and business acumen.
* Inspirational leadership and team development skills.
* Operational excellence and attention to detail.
* Innovation, adaptability, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management abilities.
* Alignment with ZEST values, culture, and service philosophy.

  

**Benefits**

At ZEST, we believe exceptional culinary experiences are at the heart of unforgettable hospitality. As Executive Chef, you will have the opportunity to create and lead a food program that becomes a defining part of the guest experience and a benchmark within Ibiza's luxury hospitality scene.

* Competitive executive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunity to join the Executive Leadership Team of a landmark luxury resort.
* Be part of a pre-opening project and shape the culinary identity from day one.
* Creative freedom to develop concepts, menus, and experiences that reflect the ZEST brand.
* Opportunities for professional growth, development, and industry recognition.

* The opportunity to make a lasting impact on one of Ibiza's most exciting luxury hospitality destinations.
* Work within a culture driven by the ZEST Effect, where passion, creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do.

**Why Join Us?**

This is far more than a traditional Executive Chef role.

You will join the team responsible for launching one of Ibiza's most exciting new luxury lifestyle resorts, helping define its culinary identity, dining concepts, guest experiences, and long-term reputation from day one.

If you are excited by the opportunity to build something exceptional from the ground up and create culinary experiences that guests remember long after they leave, we would love to hear from you.

description:
Job Requisition ID: 20804

Date Posted: 16 October 2026

Grade Band (learn more): A2 - A4

This is a **fixed-term appointment** with an initial duration of 4 years. Depending upon performance and organisational needs, the appointment may be extended up to a possible maximum duration of 8 years.

  

**Location**
  
ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands with a resident assignment to ESAC, Villanueva de la Cañada, Spain.

**Description**
---------------

The Directorate of Human and Robotic Exploration Programmes (D/HRE) is a programme directorate within the ESA matrix structure. Through a partnership between humans and robots, D/HRE is dedicated to exploring destinations in space where humans are already living and working —– or will live and work in the future —– for the purpose of scientific research, economic development, international cooperation and public inspiration.

The Science Operations Department (SCI-S), within ESA’s Directorate of Science (D/SCI), hosts the scientists and engineers who oversee the space missions from study to the end of operations, develops the science operation systems for the missions and operates the missions in space, and archives and curates their data during operations and beyond. The Department provides support to D/HRE in the curation, archiving and dissemination of data from its planetary missions, such as the Rosalind Franklin Mission (RFM) and other Mars or lunar experiments. Its main objective is to maximise the scientific output of the missions for the benefit of humankind.

You will be assigned as Archive Scientist for ESA planetary missions under the direct responsibility of the Chief Exploration Scientist reporting functionally to the Head of the Science Archives Development and Operations Section, also known as the ESAC Science Data Centre (ESDC) in the Data Science and Archives Division within the Science Operations Department (SCI-S).

You will have further functional reporting lines within the mission(s) you support, initially the ESA ExoMars RFM and Comet Interceptor.

**Duties**
----------

You will be responsible for the definition and specification of the scientific archive for the supported ESA planetary missions, initially the ESA ExoMars RFM and Comet Interceptor, and for the follow-up and monitoring of its implementation and operation with the goal of maximising the scientific return of the missions. You will work in close collaboration with the planetary mission project scientists, the other mission archive scientists, the ESDC Software and Data Systems Architect and the members of the Planetary Science Archive User Group.

  

As Archive Scientist, your specific responsibilities will include:

  

* ownership of use cases and drivers for the mission archives, including:
  + interfacing with the Project Scientist, the Science Operations Centre (SOC) team, other archive science leads and other archive scientists, as well as the external stakeholders, such as the instrument teams and the mission scientific community, to provide the science use cases that drive the mission archive and determine the priorities for implementation;
  + providing scientific support and steering the development and operations of the archives for the supported ESA planetary missions, providing the ESDC development team with an archive user requirements document as a baseline for implementation;
* chairing and coordinating a mission-level Data Archive Working Group (DAWG);
* monitoring the implementation, testing and expected performance of the archive based on use cases gathered by the mission team and derived requirements; in particular, defining and performing the end user acceptance testing of the different archive versions prior to their release to the scientific community;
* with the help of the instrument operations scientists, supervising and coordinating the definition and provision of science data products and any higher-level data products from the community or instrument teams as needed, including liaising on submission schedules and content;
* liaising with any internal and external providers to ensure the completeness of all levels of data products with maximum science quality, contributing to the optimisation and refinement of the archive products when possible;
* encouraging and contributing to the science exploitation of the missions’ data products through archive usage;
* participating in archive scientist meetings and user groups and sharing ideas and proposals for the strategy and promotion of the ESA science archives;
* supporting the scientific community with archive- and data product-related matters.
  

As a scientist in the Department, you will be required to actively pursue personal scientific research, publishing articles using archival data, and to actively participate in the Department’s research activities.

**Technical competencies**
--------------------------

Experience in science data management and archiving systems

Experience working with planetary science data in a research setting, preferably including data from surface/in situ planetary missions

Experience in coordinating the scientific community and managing multiple interfaces at international level within a large multidisciplinary team.

Experience in science operations, preferably in the context of ESA missions

**Behavioural competencies**
----------------------------

Result Orientation
  
Operational Efficiency
  
Fostering Cooperation
  
Relationship Management
  
Continuous Improvement
  
Forward Thinking

**Education and professional experience**
-----------------------------------------

A PhD in a relevant domain is required for this post, together with one year of relevant professional experience.

**Additional requirements**
---------------------------

The following are assets for this position:

  

* Experience in promoting science to the wider scientific community and general public;
* Understanding of user needs in relation to complex software systems;
* Experience in science operations, preferably in the context of ESA missions;
* Experience in agile and DevOps methodologies, human factor engineering (UX design) and associated technologies and their use in modern software engineering.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusiveness**
  
ESA is an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.

At the Agency we value diversity, and we welcome people with disabilities. Whenever possible, we seek to accommodate individuals with disabilities by providing the necessary support at the workplace. The Human Resources Department can also provide assistance during the recruitment process. If you would like to discuss this further, please contact us via email at contact.human.resources@esa.int.

  

**Important Information and Disclaimer**
  
In principle, recruitment will be within the advertised grade band (A2-A4). However, if the selected candidate has less than four years of relevant professional experience following the completion of the master’s degree, the position may be filled at A1 level.

Applicants must be eligible to access information, technology, and hardware which is subject to European or US export control and sanctions regulations.

During the recruitment process, the Agency may request applicants to undergo selection tests. Additionally, successful candidates will need to undergo basic screening before appointment, which will be conducted by an external background screening service, in compliance with the European Space Agency's security procedures.

Note that ESA is in the process of transitioning to a Matrix setup, which could lead to organisational changes affecting this position.

The information published on ESA’s careers website regarding working conditions is correct at the time of publication. It is not intended to be exhaustive and may not address all questions you would have.

  

**Nationality and Languages**
  
Please note that applications are only considered from nationals of one of the following States: Austria, Belgium, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the United Kingdom and Canada, Cyprus, Latvia, Lithuania and Slovakia.

According to the ESA Convention, staff shall be recruited on the basis of their qualifications, taking into account an adequate distribution of posts among nationals of the Member States.

The working languages of the Agency are English and French. A good knowledge of one of these is required. Knowledge of another Member State language would be an asset.

title: Director de Software Delivery
description:
Buscamos un **Director de Software Delivery**

**Perfil buscado**

* Más de 12 años en ingeniería y entrega de software, de los cuales al menos 5 en dirección de delivery, DevOps o plataforma.
* Experiencia implantando CI/CD, release management y metodología de SDLC en organizaciones grandes y con múltiples proveedores.
* Experiencia en gobierno de APIs y conocimiento práctico de MCP y del desarrollo asistido por IA.
* Perfil con base técnica sólida, con credibilidad ante los equipos y capacidad para exigir estándares a los proveedores. No se busca un perfil exclusivamente metodológico o de agile coach.

**Encaje en la organización**

Una de sus funciones es mediar entre Run y Change y gobernar un calendario unificado de releases para ambos.

Su eficacia depende sobre todo de las áreas que entregan y operan el software fuera del área del CTO.

**Fuera del área del CTO**

* Dominios de producto. Son el principal interlocutor. Aplican la metodología en sus proyectos, sean internos o externalizados, y la exigen a sus proveedores. Software Delivery les da un proceso claro y les acompaña en su adopción.
* PMO. Alinea la planificación y el seguimiento de proyectos con la metodología y con el calendario de releases.
* SRE. Define con Software Delivery los criterios de paso a producción, la observabilidad y el rollback, y aporta las métricas de fallo de cambios y tiempo de recuperación.
* Infraestructura. Provee los entornos y la infraestructura sobre los que se ejecutan los pipelines y los entornos no productivos.
* Soporte. Recibe cada release con la comunicación y el traspaso a Run adecuados, y aporta las incidencias posteriores a cada subida como indicador de calidad.
* IT4IT. Provee y opera las herramientas del ciclo de vida (requisitos, repositorios, CI/CD, gestión de servicios), conforme a los estándares definidos por Software Delivery.

**Dentro del área del CTO**

* Arquitectura y UX. Definen sus estándares; Software Delivery garantiza que intervienen en cada proyecto mediante puntos de control obligatorios.

description:
**Company Description**

Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. Our optimism transforms outcomes.

**About Sia Experience-Marketing Advisory**

Sia Experience is the end-to-end marketing and customer experience arm of Sia. Agile and collaborative, our Marketing AdvisoryBusiness Line is recognized for delivering high-impact, growth-focused solutions by blending marketing, CX, creative, AI, and deep industry expertise.

As strategic partners, The Marketing Advisory team empowers clients across technology, luxury, consumer goods, finance, energy, and more to scale operational excellence and drive brand-led growth through AI- and data-driven strategies. Our teams lead full-funnel marketing transformations—from strategy and go-to-market execution to experience design, performance measurement, and sustainable impact.

It’s an exciting time to join us. SiaX has long been the agency behind some of the world’s biggest brands—now we’re expanding, becoming one of the most recognizable names for companies that demand bold, business-driving creative. We’re shaping SiaX into the go-to agency of the future. This is your chance to be part of that growth, working alongside top-tier creatives, consultants and agency leaders to continuously evolve what a modern, full-service agency can be. Opportunities like this don’t come around often—if you want in on the next level, this is it.

 **Job Description**

Contract roles are geared toward independent professionals interested in temporary or project-based work.

**Sia Title:** Project Consultant (Exempt Contractor)

**Project Title:** Senior Lifecycle & CRM Strategy Leader

**Project Length:** This is a contract role that could span 6 months with the possibility of extension

**Project Hours:** 40 hours per week

**Location:** Remote

**Rate:** $90-110/hr The expected compensation for this contract is per year. The exact pay rate will vary depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to skills, experience, and location.

**About the role**

We’re seeking a senior lifecycle and CRM leader to build a coordinated customer-growth capability for a digital-presence services business serving entrepreneurs, small businesses, freelancers, and customers building and managing an online presence. The portfolio spans domain registration, website creation, web hosting, professional email, security, and digital marketing solutions.

The business is evolving from product- and campaign-led communications toward a more integrated lifecycle model. You will assess the current state, define the highest-value customer journeys, and establish a practical roadmap connecting customer and account data, setup and service signals, marketing technology, content, measurement, and cross-functional execution.

The work should help customers move from purchasing a domain or digital service to successfully establishing, activating, managing, protecting, and growing their online presence. It should strengthen service activation, time to value, complementary-service adoption, renewal readiness, retention, expansion, and win-back. You will serve as a senior advisor while remaining hands-on in shaping the first wave of journeys, tests, and operating practices.

**What You’ll Do**

* Assess the end-to-end digital-presence lifecycle. Map the experience from domain search and purchase through account setup, website creation and launch, hosting and professional email activation, security adoption, ongoing management, renewal, cancellation or lapse, win-back, and expansion into relevant adjacent services.
* Build the lifecycle strategy and roadmap. Define lifecycle stages, customer and business outcomes, journey priorities, and a sequenced plan balancing immediate improvements with longer-term data, technology, content, and operating-model needs.
* Design high-value customer journeys. Develop coordinated programs for onboarding, service activation, website launch, customer education, renewal preparation, lapse prevention, retention, service recovery, win-back, and expansion into complementary digital-presence services.
* Advance segmentation and trigger strategy. Define actionable audiences and triggers using customer profile, domain and service purchases, setup milestones, website launch status, account activity, billing and renewal status, support interactions, engagement, and service-portfolio signals.
* Connect CRM, service, and channel data. Determine the data, identity, consent, automation, and integration capabilities required to coordinate experiences across email, web, account experiences, service interactions, and other available channels.
* Improve personalization and next-best-action decisions. Deliver relevant setup guidance, website-launch support, education, security and renewal reminders, complementary-service recommendations, and re-engagement based on where customers are in building and managing their online presence.
* Establish experimentation and measurement. Define baselines, test plans, controls, and reporting for setup completion, service activation, website launch, time to value, multi-service relationships, engagement, renewal, lapse prevention, retention, win-back, customer value, and incremental commercial impact.
* Create the lifecycle operating model. Clarify decision rights, ownership, intake, prioritization, approvals, production, reporting, and optimization across marketing, product, ecommerce, customer care, data, analytics, creative, and technology.
* Move the first wave into delivery. Translate recommendations into journey maps, briefs, audience and trigger definitions, content requirements, test designs, measurement plans, and a prioritized delivery backlog.
* Build sustainable internal capability. Create reusable frameworks, governance, documentation, and working rhythms that enable internal teams to continuously improve lifecycle programs.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A clear lifecycle and CRM maturity assessment covering journeys, data, segmentation, triggers, channels, technology, content, measurement, and team capability.
* A prioritized roadmap tied to customers establishing, activating, managing, protecting, and growing their online presence, with measurable outcomes across time to value, renewal, retention, expansion, and win-back.
* A defined first wave of journeys with owners, requirements, dependencies, tests, and measurement.
* A more connected experience for customers holding one or multiple services across domains, websites, hosting, professional email, security, digital marketing, billing, renewals, and support.
* Clear governance and operating rhythms across the functions supporting the customer experience.
* Internal teams equipped to sustain and improve the lifecycle capability.

 **Qualifications**

* Approximately 15+ years across lifecycle marketing, CRM, retention, customer engagement, marketing automation, customer journey, or growth CRM.
* Senior Director or VP-level experience advising executives and influencing cross-functional decisions.
* Experience building a lifecycle capability from a low-maturity starting point, not only optimizing an established program.
* Deep experience with recurring-revenue digital services, especially domain registration, web hosting, website building, professional email, online security, digital marketing, ecommerce enablement, or adjacent small-business services.
* Ability to connect customer strategy with data, identity, consent, marketing technology, service signals, support interactions, content, execution, and measurement.
* Experience designing journeys from purchase through setup, activation, launch, ongoing value realization, renewal, expansion, retention, service recovery, lapse prevention, and win-back.
* Fluency in segmentation, event-based triggers, journey orchestration, personalization, experimentation, and incremental measurement.
* Experience managing lifecycle complexity across customers who may own a single service or a portfolio of interconnected digital-presence services.
* Ability to balance executive counsel with hands-on development of journey maps, briefs, audience definitions, test plans, roadmaps, and operating processes.
* Availability for a fully remote, full-time contract engagement aligned to Pacific Time working hours.

 **Additional Information**

**Work Authorization**

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.

title: Director, Brand Design
description:

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive "sick-care" to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against "we caught it too late again".
  
  
Reporting to the VP, Design & Experience, the Director, Creative will lead Prenuvo's Creative function and oversee a multidisciplinary team of contributors. This leadership role is responsible for the Creative function as a whole; its people, capabilities, priorities, creative vision, quality, and effectiveness. The Director, Creative will oversee Prenuvo's creative expression across brand, campaigns, paid media, social, web, content, motion, physical environments, events, partnerships, and emerging experiences.
  
  
Your role is both directive and integrative. You'll set the creative vision and quality bar while leading through your team, giving them the clarity, ownership, and autonomy to independently direct programs, disciplines, and bodies of work. You'll partner closely with Marketing, Growth, Product Design, Clinical, Commercial, CX, and other subject-matter experts to ensure creative work is compelling, accurate, and responsive to the needs of a healthcare environment.
  
  
You'll combine a strong creative point of view with organizational leadership—building the team and capabilities we need, establishing scalable creative practices, and partnering across the company to turn brand and business strategy into exceptional creative work. This is a fully remote position open to candidates authorized to work in the United States. Occasional travel may be required for team gatherings, productions, events, and other business needs.
  
  
**This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).**
Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people's lives!

+ Ensure the Creative organization has the right talent, partners, processes, and resources to deliver against company priorities.

title: Head of Marketing
description:

Founded by sisters Louisa and Rebecca, Regalrose is a British-born ecommerce jewellery retailer with over 15 years in business. Specialising in uniquely designed jewellery and accessories with a fierce edge and dreamy-dark twist, Regalrose is going from strength to strength as demonstrated by our exceptional growth over the last few years. We have built up a loyal community of passionate fans and customers, delivering our products to over 80 countries worldwide. We are now looking for an outstanding and experienced Head of Marketing to join our team in our offices, located in St Albans.

**About You**

You will be a driven, self-motivated marketing leader with at least 8 years’ experience in a similar role, ideally in e-commerce or retail. You will have owned a marketing commercial plan and budget, run paid media, CRM, social and affiliate channels through agencies, and traded an e-commerce website. You will be obsessed with numbers and optimisation, highly organised, and confident giving data-led feedback to a creative team.

**Requirements and Skills**

As Head of Marketing, you will own what we do, when, where and how much – and whether it worked. You will set the marketing commercial strategy, own the health of the customer base, run the go-to-market plan across every channel, and own online trading on the Regalrose website. You will work as a peer to the Head of Creative, who owns how our marketing looks, sounds and feels.

**The Role and Accountabilities**

Overall goal: Achieve the annual marketing and online sales targets – revenue, new customers, retention, ROAS and MER – within budget, while growing the size and value of the customer base.

Commercial strategy & customer base:

* Own the marketing commercial strategy, plan and budgets; report performance to the MD and senior leadership.
* Own customer base health: size, value per customer, LTV, CAC, acquisition, retention and reactivation.

Go-to-market planning & launches:

* Own the master brief, Notion timelines and launch schedule, aligned with production and e-commerce calendars.
* Set asset requirements, provide past performance insight, and schedule and execute every launch in full.

E-commerce & online trading:

* Own the website, apps, trading strategy and sales targets (conversion, AOV).
* Sort rules, category organisation, cross-sells, upsells, product listings, UX, personalisation, CRO and A/B testing.

Channels:

* Paid media: strategy, agency, budget and reporting against ROAS and MER.
* Social: strategy, platform mix and new channels, delivered through the Social Media Executive.
* CRM (Klaviyo): strategy, lists and segmentation, formats and reporting.
